name: Antigravity System
description: Tạo ra các trường phản trọng lực hủy diệt nghiền nát hoặc nâng bổng vạn vật xung quanh, làm chủ không gian trọng trường tuyệt đối.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Antigravity
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have learned how to use your technique to manipulate gravity, allowing you to make a small gravitational field around yourself. As an action for 3 cursed energy, you can reverse gravity in a 10 foot-radius 30 foot-high cylinder centered on you for all creatures but yourself until the beginning of your next turn.

All creatures and objects that aren’t anchored to the ground in the area fall upward. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall. If a solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it and take the remaining height as fall damage. If an object or creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration. At the end of the duration, affected objects and creatures fall back down, taking fall damage.

The height of the cylinder increases to 50 feet at 3rd level, 100 feet at 11th level and 200 feet at 18th level. Fall damage from this technique ignores any type of fall damage reduction or immunity. Fall damage die becomes d8 at 3rd level and d10 at 6th level.

features.name: Gravity Field
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gained the following benefits through practicing your technique.

Light Fall. As a reaction for 1 CE to falling, you and creatures equal to your proficiency bonus within 120 feet have their rate of descent slowed to 60 feet per round and take no fall damage when you land.

Focused System. When you use your innate technique, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your CE modifier + your proficiency bonus to be unaffected by your technique.

Disorienting Gravity. Any creature that is lifted upwards by your Antigravity must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they make any attacks at disadvantage and cannot maintain concentration while within your field.

features.name: Antigravity Shield
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned to defend yourself from attacks using your antigravity. As a reaction for 2 CE, you can encase yourself in a field of antigravity, causing attack rolls against you to be made at disadvantage and any damage other than psychic is reduced by your CE modifier + your level until the beginning of your next turn. If you are taking the Dodge action, you can use this reaction on another creature within 5 feet.

features.name: Boosted System
features.description:
At 11th level, you master all aspects of your technique and gain the following improvements to your Antigravity:

Lasting Field. You can spend additional CE up to your modifier to increase the range by 10 feet and the duration by 1 round per CE.

Sweeping Gravity. Creatures with a Dexterity score below your CE save DC cannot make a Dexterity saving throw against your technique.

Nauseating Gravity. If a creature fails a saving throw against your Disorienting Gravity, they are also stunned until the end of their next turn.

Hard Fall. Fall damage from your field becomes d12 bludgeoning.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Zero Gravity
features.description: At 18th level you have learned how to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice are affected by and fail all saving throws against Antigravity, which can be released by you at will.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Zero Gravity
domain.description: At 18th level you have learned how to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice are affected by and fail all saving throws against Antigravity, which can be released by you at will.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Không Trọng Lực Giới

feats.name: Levitation System
feats.description: As an action for 2 CE, you can cast Levitate. You can spend an additional 2 CE to force the creature to make the save at disadvantage.

feats.name: Dense Antigravity Shield
feats.description: For an additional 3 CE, your Antigravity Shield instead reduces all damage against you by half your Antigravity’s maximum height fall damage dice until the beginning of your next turn.

feats.name: Antigravitational Flight
feats.description: As an action for 3 CE, you can give yourself or another creature you touch a 60 feet hover speed for 10 minutes.

descriptionEn: You can create devastating fields of antigravity.

name: Auspicious Beast Summon
description: Trùm kín khuôn mặt để trở thành vật trung gian giáng linh sức mạnh của tứ đại linh thú thần thoại: Giải Trĩ, Linh Quy, Kỳ Lân và Long Mã.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Auspicious Beast #1: Kaichi
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, as an action using 1 Cursed Energy, you summon a yellow drill horn for 1 minute. This horn can be used to make an additional melee Cursed Energy attack against a creature within 30 ft as part of your turn, dealing 1d6 piercing damage on a hit. The damage increases to 1d8 at 3rd level, 1d10 at 6th level, 1d12 at 11th level, and 3d6 at 18th level. You can only have one Kaichi at a time.

features.name: Auspicious Beast #2: Reiki
features.description: At 3rd level, you summon dark water to assist yourself. You can use a bonus action to spend 1 Cursed Energy and double your movement until the end of your next turn. Additionally, as a reaction for 2 Cursed Energy, you gain a +5 bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.

features.name: Auspicious Beast #3: Kirin
features.description:
Once you reach 6th level, you gain a power to help you last longer in battles. As a bonus action, for every 1 Cursed Energy you spend you gain 5 temporary hit points.

While you have these temporary hit points, you ignore exhaustion. However, after activating, your movement is 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Auspicious Beast #4: Ryu
features.description: When you get to 11th level, you gain the last and most powerful Auspicious Beast. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you unleash the full power of a dragon. When you use this action, you summon Ryu within 30 ft of you. A creature where Ryu is summoned must make a Strength saving throw or take 8d10 piercing damage. Ryu lasts for up to 10 minutes or until you are unconscious and you can command Ryu as a bonus action. Otherwise Ryu takes the dodge action and defends itself. You can summon one Ryu at a time. Once destroyed, you cannot summon Ryu again for 10 minutes.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Auspicious Beasts’ Realm
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your Cursed Technique to an extreme. While in this domain, all of your Auspicious Beasts are constantly active without side effects. Attacks made by Kaichi and Ryu always hit. Kirin refreshes at initiative 20 as if you spent Cursed Energy up to your CE modifier.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Auspicious Beasts’ Realm
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your Cursed Technique to an extreme. While in this domain, all of your Auspicious Beasts are constantly active without side effects. Attacks made by Kaichi and Ryu always hit. Kirin refreshes at initiative 20 as if you spent Cursed Energy up to your CE modifier.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thụy Thú Linh Vực

feats.name: Double Up
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have a Auspicious Beast #1: Kaichi
feats.description: Your proficiency with your technique and bond with Kaichi improves. You can summon up to two Kaichi horns at the same time as part of your action. This lets you make an additional attack with your horns.

feats.name: Zero Friction
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Auspicious Beast #2: Reiki
feats.description: Your proficiency with your technique and bond with Reiki improves. While your movement speed is increased by Reiki, you gain a +3 bonus to AC and don’t provoke opportunity attacks.

feats.name: Maximum: Kirin’s Flames
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Auspicious Beast #3: Kirin
feats.description: Your proficiency with your technique reaches a crescendo, and your bond with Kirin improves. Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have Kirin activated, you can force them to take fire damage equal to twice the damage taken.

descriptionEn: By covering your face you can become a medium for the spirit of the four auspicious beasts. These four beasts give you great abilities.

name: Black Bird Manipulation
description: Thuật thức điều khiển bầy quạ đen trinh sát và phát động đòn quyết tử Thần Phong (Bird Strike) buộc đối phương đánh đổi sinh mạng.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Cursed Crows
features.description: At 1st level, you have learned how to imbue crows with cursed energy to use them as part of your technique. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can imbue a raven with cursed energy if it's restrained, grappled, or incapacitated. It then becomes one of your cursed crows, it will become charmed by you and will follow your orders. As an action, you can close your eyes giving you the blinded condition unless you have blindsight, while you see through one of your crows. While seeing through your crows, you can use your passive Perception instead of the crows. You can only see through one crow at a time and can switch between them as an action or stop as a bonus action. You start with 3 cursed crows.

features.name: Omen of Death
features.description:
When you reach 3rd level, you are constantly followed by an omen of death, giving you an aura of terror. As a bonus action, you force each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 ft to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

You have advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.

features.name: Raven’s Eye
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your crows have been enhancing your sight. You will gain +1 to your passive perception for every crow you currently have. In addition, you can switch between crows as a bonus action and can stop seeing through them at will.

features.name: Bird Strike
features.description: Beginning 11th level, your mastery of Black Bird Manipulation has made you develop its most powerful technique. As an action for 8 Cursed Energy, you can order one of your crows to launch themselves at a creature from their flying speed range. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 10d10 necrotic damage and have one of their limbs damaged, rolling a d6 to see the damaged limb. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and do not have a limb damaged. The crow dies afterwards.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Black Mahakala
features.description: If you reach 18th level, you gain your domain expansion. At Initiative 20, you can choose up to three targets to suffer the full effects of Bird Strike for no cost. The crows still die afterwards.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Black Mahakala
domain.description: If you reach 18th level, you gain your domain expansion. At Initiative 20, you can choose up to three targets to suffer the full effects of Bird Strike for no cost. The crows still die afterwards.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Hắc Ma Cáp Lạp

feats.name: All Seeing
feats.description: You have improved your ability to manage information. While you see through the crows you don’t gain the blinded condition. You gain 10 ft of blindsight for every cursed crow within 60 ft of you that is not incapacitated.

feats.name: Scavenger
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Omen of Death
feats.description: You have learned from the opportunistic way of the crows. Once per turn when you hit a frightened creature with an attack, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

feats.name: Maximum: Kamikaze
feats.description: Through trial and error, your mastery over Bird Strike has reached new heights. Whenever you use Bird Strike you can choose between either increasing the damage die size to d12 or to roll an additional d6 to damage a limb.

descriptionEn: You were born with a simple ability many called weak, the ability to control and see through crows.

name: Black Box
description: Mở chiếc hộp đen phong ấn cổ xưa, phóng xuất ngọn lửa hủy diệt Fūga (Hỏa Lực Khai) thiêu rụi toàn bộ sinh linh trong nháy mắt.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Dark Cube
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can spend 2 cursed energy as an action to create an immovable 10 feet opaque black cube within 30 feet of you for 1 minute or until you end it as a free action. If a Large or smaller creature is within range, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or be trapped within the cube. A creature inside your cube has full cover against attacks outside the cube and creatures other than you are blinded if there isn’t a source of light inside the cube.

The cube has an AC equal to your Cursed Energy save DC + 5, hit points equal to your proficiency bonus times twice your Cursed Energy modifier and immunity to psychic and poison damage.

features.name: Black Box Reinforcement
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level you can reinforce your barriers with cursed energy. You can spend additional cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to give your Dark Cube a reinforcement for every cursed energy spent:

Persistence. Your Cube gains 10 additional hit points for every 1 reinforcement, +1 bonus to AC for every 2 reinforcements and lasts an additional minute for every 3 reinforcements.

Toughness. Your Cube reduces all damage taken by 1 for each reinforcement.

Size. For every 2 reinforcements, you can make your Dark Cube 5 feet larger, allowing you to fit more creatures. (10 ft < 15 ft < 20ft)

At 11th level, you can spend up to twice your CE modifier on reinforcements.

features.name: Perfect Cube
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to create a nearly indestructible Dark Cube. For an additional 5 CE, you can create a Perfect Cube (this cursed energy counts towards the Cube’s Reinforcements).

Your Perfect Cube has resistance to all damage and ignores features or abilities that deal higher damage against objects and structures or would destroy, see into, or invade your barrier.

features.name: Maximum: Midnight Armor
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned to manifest your barrier around yourself. You can spend 6 cursed energy as an action to manifest parts of your cube around your body like armor for 1 minute or until the armor is destroyed:

You gain the hit points of your barrier as temporary hit points.

Your AC equals your Dark Cube’s AC.

Your unarmed strikes can use your CE modifier for attack rolls and deal 3d8 + CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit.

You can spend additional cursed energy up to twice your cursed energy modifier to also gain the benefits of any reinforcement other than Size.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Primordial Gap
features.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. In your domain all of your Dark Cubes automatically count as Perfect Cubes. At initiative 20, you create 3 Perfect Cubes, potentially trapping 3 creatures within your domain inside Perfect Cubes. They are treated as having Reinforcements up to your CE modifier. These cubes disappear when your domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Primordial Gap
domain.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. In your domain all of your Dark Cubes automatically count as Perfect Cubes. At initiative 20, you create 3 Perfect Cubes, potentially trapping 3 creatures within your domain inside Perfect Cubes. They are treated as having Reinforcements up to your CE modifier. These cubes disappear when your domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nguyên Sơ Hạp Tử

feats.name: Instant Manifestation
feats.description: You have learned a trick to instantly deploy your technique. Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against being trapped by your Dark Cube and you can create a Dark Cube around yourself as a reaction to being hit with an attack, causing it to take the damage in your stead. If you take the dodge action on your turn, you can also use this reaction to create a 10 feet cube around yourself and another creature within 5 feet.

feats.name: Offensive Creations
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Black Box Reinforcement
feats.description:
You have focused on using your technique to devastating effects and have learned offensive applications of your cursed technique:

Crushing Cube. As an action for 4 CE, you target a 30 feet tall, 10 feet wide square cylinder within 30 feet. All creatures in range must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure they take 5d10 necrotic damage and fall prone as they are crushed under a massive Dark Cube. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not prone.

Block Strike. As a bonus action for 2 CE, you cover your fist or other part of your body with a Dark Cube for 1 minute. You can make a melee cursed energy attack with your unarmed strikes. On a hit you deal your proficiency bonus in d4s + your CE modifier in necrotic damage.

Dark Press. As an action for 5 CE, you can create a Dark Cube in front of you that explodes in length on one side. All creatures in a 10 feet wide 60 feet long line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d8 necrotic damage and are pushed back to the edge of the line. If they impact a solid object or structure, they take the remaining distance as fall damage.

feats.name: Sealing Cube
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Midnight Armor
feats.description: When you trap a creature in a Perfect Cube, you can choose to seal the output of the creature, as a Reduced Output Effect. Any Reduced Output such a creature possesses increases by 6 levels while trapped within your Perfect Cube.

descriptionEn: You can create incredibly tough black cube barriers.

name: Blazing Courage
description: Bằng niềm tin bất khuất, thắp lửa cho vũ khí và trái tim bằng dòng Chú lực rực cháy, gia tăng sát thương cận chiến uy mãnh.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Ignition
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your technique allows yourself to ignite your weapon in flames, increasing your fire power. You can spend up to your proficiency bonus as a bonus action while holding a melee weapon, igniting said weapon in flames for 1 minute. For the duration, the weapon deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a hit per CE spent, and emits bright light for 5 feet and dim light for another 10 feet.

This increases to 1d8 per ce spent at 6th level and again to 1d10 at 11th level and 1d12 at 18th level. Mantle of Courage

Starting at 3rd level, you can strengthen both yourself and your weapon. When you use Ignition, you ignore any detriments or penalties of the weapon or can use it on yourself for your unarmed strikes, potentially recreating a lost limb for the duration.

While Ignition is active, you can spend 3 CE as a free action on your turn. You emit an aura of flames within 10 feet of you for 1 minute, giving you resistance to fire and cold damage. An enemy that enters your mantle or starts their turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking your Ignition damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

features.name: Eternal Flames
features.description:
At 6th level, when you spend at least 3 ce on Ignition, you can increase the weapon’s range by 10 feet, ignore resistance to fire damage and when you miss with a weapon attack by 2 or less, you deal half your Ignition damage.

This increases to 3 or less at 11th level and 4 or less at 18th level.

features.name: Maximum: Conflagration
features.description:
At 11th level, while your technique may be simple, that does not mean it isn’t powerful. While holding a melee weapon you can spend 10 ce as an action to swing your weapon, creating a 30 feet cone of intense flame and heat. All creatures within range must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 fire damage and being knocked prone on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

If a creature fails by 5 or more, they gain severe burns and take additional fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus from any source of fire damage until they finish a long rest.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Fire of the Heart
features.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. Any melee weapon you are holding is treated as having the maximum cursed energy used for Ignition and is imbued with your domain’s guaranteed hit. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain suffer the damage of your Mantle of Courage.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Fire of the Heart
domain.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. Any melee weapon you are holding is treated as having the maximum cursed energy used for Ignition and is imbued with your domain’s guaranteed hit. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain suffer the damage of your Mantle of Courage.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Xích Tâm Hỏa Vực

feats.name: Ferocious Courage
feats.description: Once per turn, you can choose to deal additional fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Blazing Heart
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Mantle of Courage
feats.description: When you use Mantle of Courage, all creatures of your choice in range gain 5 temporary hit points and again at the start of your turn for the duration.

feats.name: Soulfire
feats.description: You have learned to burn even the soul. When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 3 CE to cause all fire damage dealt on your turn to ignore immunity to fire damage and reduce a creature’s maximum hit points until they complete a long rest.

feats.name: Technique Release
feats.description: When you hit with an attack while Ignition is activated, you can release the technique, ending the effects of Ignition on the weapon in exchange for doubling your fire damage for this attack. If used with Maximum: Conflagration, it instead deals a number of additional damage die equal to the CE spent on Ignition.

descriptionEn: Through your beliefs, you set both your weapon and heart alight with your blazing courage.

name: Blood Manipulation
description: Bảo thuật gia truyền danh giá của gia tộc Kamo và Choso, thao túng huyết dịch bản thân từ áp suất, quỹ đạo bay đến cường hóa thể lực vượt bậc.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Blood Constructs
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have been blessed with the Innate Technique of the Kamo clan, making you begin with the most basic technique, the blood constructs. You can pull blood from an available source to create a semi-solid construct. As an action for 1 CE and 1 HP, you can create a small construct smaller than a 5ft by 5ft space. For every 5 ft the price increases by 1 CE and HP. You can ignore the HP cost if you have an alternate source of blood. These constructs have HP equal to your level times CE spent.

Once as part of a long rest, you can spend $100 and hit points up to your proficiency bonus to fill a Blood Bag with your own blood. This Blood Bag counts as a source of hit points for your Blood Manipulation features. A Blood Bag lasts 5 days outside of refrigeration before it goes bad. You can have a number of Blood Bags equal to your Constitution modifier at once.

features.name: Blood Techniques
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your blood in a manner fit for battle. When you use a Blood Manipulation feature, you can ignore the HP cost if you have an alternate source of blood. You gain three of following techniques and gain an additional two at 6th and 11th level:

Crimson Binding: As an action for 1 CE and 1 HP, you unleash a red blood net, forcing a target Large or smaller within 30ft to make a Strength saving throw or be restrained. They can repeat the save at the start of their turn.

Slicing Exorcism: As an action for 1 CE and 1 HP you  spin a ring of blood and unleash it as a projectile. Make a ranged CE attack against a target within 60 ft, on a hit you deal 1d10 + CE modifier necrotic damage. If used with Convergence, the attack still deals your CE modifier on a miss of 5 or less.

Blood Edge: You can spend CE up to your Cursed Energy modifier to create a melee weapon as a free action which counts as magical for overcoming resistances. For every two Cursed Energy used the weapon gains an additional damage tier(d10->d12->2d8) and lasts 1 minute. If used with Convergence, it only gains the benefit of the damage tier increase.

Crimson Rain: As an action for 3 CE and 2 HP, you pick an area within 60 ft, that spot becomes the center of a 15 ft radius of a rain of blood spikes. All creatures in that radius must make a Dexterity Saving throw taking 3d10 piercing damage on failure or half as much on a success. If used with Convergence, a target is also knocked prone on a failed save.

Blood Burst: For 1 CE and 1 HP upon hitting with a weapon attack once per turn, you cover your strike with blood, causing it to explode on impact. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 4d6 necrotic damage.

Blood Meteorite: As an action for 1 CE and 3 HP you create a solid crystal of blood launched like an asteroid. You can make a ranged CE attack against a target in 30 ft. On a hit, this attack deals 4d4 + CE modifier in bludgeoning damage.

Blood Geyser: As an action for 3 CE and 3 HP, you can choose a 5 feet space within 10 ft of yourself and saturate it with blood. When a creature starts their turn there or enters that area, all creatures within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d10 bludgeoning damage and get launched 30ft in the air or half as much on a success.

features.name: Flowing Red Scale
features.description:
At 3rd level, you can control body temperature, pulse rate, and the number of red blood cells to give yourself greatly increased physical capabilities. You can spend 3 Cursed Energy as a bonus action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

Your walking speed is doubled

You gain a +2 bonus to your AC

You advantage on Dexterity saving throws and Strength checks

You gain an additional action on each of your turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

features.name: Convergence
features.description:
At 6th level, you compress and condense blood to its absolute limit. Before you use a blood manipulation technique with a casting time of one action, you can spend your bonus action, reaction and movement to enhance the technique's potency, gaining the following benefits:

You deal additional damage die equal to your proficiency bonus

Your damage die increases by 1 level(d10->d12->2d8)

The range increases by 30 feet

If you spend an additional turn using your action, bonus action, reaction and movement to charge up Convergence before using your technique, you gain these benefits an additional time and gain advantage on the first technique attack roll or can force creatures to make their first saving throw against your technique at disadvantage.  Certain Blood Techniques may have additional or different bonuses if used with Convergence that are listed with each technique.

Alternatively, instead of spending time to compress blood, you quicken the process with cursed energy. You can spend 1 additional CE when using a Blood Technique to gain additional benefits. Slicing Exorcism, Blood Burst and Blood Meteorite deal 1 additional damage dice on a hit. Crimson Binding increases the DC by 1. Crimson Rain and Blood Geyser deal 1 additional damage per damage dice.

At 11th level, the additional CE you can spend increases to 2, which causes these bonuses to double if spending 2 instead of 1. At 18th level, this becomes 3 CE, which can cause these bonuses to triple. You cannot use both methods of Convergence on the same technique.

features.name: Piercing Blood
features.description:
Beginning at 11th level, you can compress your blood into a deadly supersonic beam. As an action for 8 CE and 5 HP, you unleash a 100ft line of blood. Creatures in range must make a Dexterity save taking 10d8 piercing on a failure.

If used with Convergence, you can continue shooting the beam for an additional round. Any creature that enters the lingering Piercing Blood must make the saving throw. As an action you can swing the line, making it into a 130 feet cone forcing an additional Dexterity save and the technique ends.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Bloodbath
features.description: When you reach 18th level, you gain your domain expansion.  At Initiative 20, all creatures take 4d12 necrotic damage as their blood attacks them from the inside. While in the domain your blood manipulation techniques can use hit points from other creatures within the domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Bloodbath
domain.description: When you reach 18th level, you gain your domain expansion.  At Initiative 20, all creatures take 4d12 necrotic damage as their blood attacks them from the inside. While in the domain your blood manipulation techniques can use hit points from other creatures within the domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Huyết Trì Địa Ngục

feats.name: Blood Production
feats.description: You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Blood Manipulation features. This does not regain HP.

feats.name: Poisonous Blood
feats.description: Your blood has grown to be harmful to others. If you hit a creature by 5 or more than their AC or a creature fails a save against a Blood Manipulation technique by 5 or more, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. They can make a Constitution save at the end of their turn to cure the condition.

feats.name: Blood Crystallization
feats.description:
You gain the ability to harden your blood to a solid, even if it risks thrombosis and further increases your versatility. As a bonus action for 3 CE. you gain the following for 1 minute:

As a reaction, you can add a +5 to your AC against an attack.

Your unarmed damage dice increases by two levels (d8<d10<d12<2d8)

You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On a 2 or lower you gain a level of exhaustion.

feats.name: Flowing Red Scale: Stack
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Flowing Red Scale
feats.description:
The power of the Flowing Red Scale has reached new heights. As a bonus action for 6 CE or while Flowing Red Scale is active for 3 CE, you instead gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

Your movement speed is tripled

You gain a +4 bonus to AC

You have advantage on Dexterity and Strength saving throws and Strength checks and once per round you can reroll a check or save

You gain one extra action and reaction.

feats.name: Supernova
feats.description:
You can create small orbs of condensed blood that explode like a buckshot. As an action, you condense your Piercing Blood into a tiny orb of blood in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet, which stays there for a maximum of 1 minute before exploding. You can create as many orbs as your proficiency bonus in an action with each having its own cost, spending 5 CE and 5 HP for each, and can choose for them to explode immediately upon creation or manually as a reaction to a creature entering the range of explosion.

The orb then explodes, forcing every creature within 10 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw for each orb. On a failure, the target takes 8d8 piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage and aren't knocked prone.

feats.name: Wing King Imitation
feats.description:
You condense your blood into wings resembling veins as a bonus action for 10 CE, gathering the wings behind you and gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

Your walking speed is quadrupled

You gain a flying speed equal to half your walking speed

As a free action on your turn, you can unleash lines of blood. This takes shape as three ranged Cursed Energy attacks against a creature within 60 feet. Each attack deals 3d10 + your CE modifier in necrotic damage.

While using Wing King, you cannot use Piercing Blood.

descriptionEn: You were born with a complex ability held and practiced by the Kamo family, you can control your blood.

name: Boogie Woogie
description: Thuật thức tráo đổi vị trí của Aoi Todo: chỉ bằng một tiếng vỗ tay, hoán đổi tức khắc tọa độ của hai vật thể hoặc sinh vật sở hữu Chú lực.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Boogie
features.description: At 1st level, you have created a unique technique to switch places with your others, extremely simple yet effective. You can switch places with a willing creature or magical object within 30 feet of you by clapping for 1 Cursed Energy. You can use this technique as an action or bonus action, or you can also swap as a reaction for 2 additional Cursed Energy.

features.name: Woogie
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you have extended the grasp of your technique as well as its versatility. Your Boogie gains the following bonuses:

Unwilling creatures can be switched

You can make two creatures other than yourself swap places

Enemies teleported are disorientated and lose their reaction

features.name: Clap Back
features.description:
Beginning at 6th level, “The act of applause is an acclamation of the soul”, you have gained a deeper understanding of your technique and how it can be used, your Boogie gains the following benefits:

Your range increases to 45 feet.

The Cursed Energy cost is reduced by 1 Cursed Energy for all Boogie Woogie techniques (min cost of 1).

You can use Boogie once per turn as a free action for 1 cursed energy.

features.name: Round of Applause
features.description:
When you reach 11th level,  you have understood the true depths of Boogie Woogie, your Boogie gains the following:

Your range increases to 60 feet

When you switch places with an ally who was previously in melee range of an enemy right before the switch, your next attack roll has advantage, the same goes if you teleport an enemy into range or an ally into range.

You can use Boogie on up to four creatures at once.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Standing Ovation
features.description: Reaching 18th level, you have mastered the beat of Boogie Woogie, you gain your domain expansion.  Within your domain, you can use Boogie as a free action an unlimited number of times on your turn (not limited to once per turn) without spending CE.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Standing Ovation
domain.description: Reaching 18th level, you have mastered the beat of Boogie Woogie, you gain your domain expansion.  Within your domain, you can use Boogie as a free action an unlimited number of times on your turn (not limited to once per turn) without spending CE.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nhiệt Liệt Hoan Nghênh

feats.name: Boogie Down
feats.description: Your Boogie has increased in speed and the unpredictability of your Boogie. You gain 2 additional reactions which can only be used to Boogie. Additionally, when you Boogie the next attack made against you has disadvantage.

feats.name: Beguiling Tactics
feats.description: The tricky timing and misdirection with Woogie has improved. After getting swapped, the enemy creature must make an Intelligence save or be stunned until the end of their next turn. On a success, a creature gains advantage on future saves against this feature. Additionally, as an action you can fake clap, forcing a creature that has experienced your technique to make an Insight check versus your Deception or Performance. On a failure, they waste their next attack by attacking in the wrong direction.

feats.name: Maximum: Best Friend
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Round of Applause
feats.description:
Boogie Woogie, as effective as it is in solo combat, only reaches its full potential not with an ally, but with a best friend. At the start of combat, you can choose one ally as a Best Friend. When fighting with that ally, you gain the following benefits:

When you switch the place of your Best Friend with an ally who was previously in melee range of an enemy, on top of advantage, the attack will have its critical range increased by 3.

Swapping your Best Friend has no cost.

When flanking with your Best Friend, you and your Best Friend gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to your proficiency bonus.

descriptionEn: You were born with a simple although tricky ability to swap places with your opponents with a clap.

name: Body Manipulation
description: Bí thuật tà ác của Kenjaku: cấy ghép não bộ vào thi thể kẻ khác để đoạt xá, kế thừa toàn bộ thuật thức bẩm sinh và ký ức của thể xác mới.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Graverobber
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have a rather disgusting technique, which is frowned upon by the majority of sorcerers. When you have a humanoid creature's corpse, you can spend 1 cursed energy during a long rest to put your brain on that creature through a transfer technique. While on the creature's body, you lose any racial features of your old body but keep all of your class features. You gain the following benefits while inside the body:

The creature’s innate technique features are now yours.

The creature’s cursed energy features are now yours.

The creature's racial features are now yours.

The creature's ability scores overwrite yours but you keep your Charisma, Wisdom, and Intelligence scores.

The creature's proficiencies and languages are now yours.

When you change into that creature's body, it will look the same outside of having a scar on its forehead, which is a sign your brain is inside its body. You can pull the top of your head to show your brain, which is a normal brain with a human mouth. Other creatures can try to identify you're not the humanoid by making a DC 30 Insight check. Creatures who knew the body's owner before you stole it can do the roll with advantage.

features.name: Skill Theft
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd, your control over the body you take over increases. You can choose to take two of the body’s Innate Technique features. Cursed Energy features, or proficiencies from a body you have inhabited in the past. You cannot use Innate Technique features from different techniques at the same time. If you do, one of them deactivates until you are only using one innate technique. You can choose two more features at 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

ImmortalityAt the 18th level, your age is the same as the body you take over, making you immortal as long as you keep switching bodies.

feats.name: Flawless Acting
feats.description: Your acting skills from hopping bodies transfer to other uses. You must spend seven days and 25 gp to establish the history, profession, and affiliations for an identity. You can't establish an identity that belongs to someone else. For example, you might acquire appropriate clothing, letters of introduction, and official-looking certification to establish yourself as a member of a trading house from a remote city so you can insinuate yourself into the company of others.

feats.name: Memory Bank
feats.description: Memories fade and wane, you however have grown beyond that. You remember everything you experience, and you can store them in objects allowing anyone who touches them to experience them from your point of view.

feats.name: Maximum: Backup
feats.description: As much as you might as well be immortal, it never hurts to be prepared. As an action, after having a dead body prepared, you can prepare it as a backup. This backup works the same as the Clone spell (only for yourself), without the cost or time requirement.

descriptionEn: You were born with the horrifying but useful ability to swap bodies and take the abilities from that body.

name: Centipede Shroud
description: Triệu hồi Thức thần rết khổng lồ bao bọc lấy cơ thể như một lớp giáp gai bảo vệ và trói siết đối phương bằng nanh độc.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Cursed Centipede
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can summon your shikigami as a bonus action. You can command your shikigami on your turn as a bonus action. Your centipede can enter your space, floating around you as a shroud providing the following benefits:

On a hit with a melee attack, you deal an additional 1d10 damage as your Centipede fights with you.

You gain a bonus to AC equal to your proficiency bonus.

You can make an additional melee attack as a bonus action.

When you or the centipede take damage, you can choose to have the other take the damage instead. If this damage would reduce the centipede to 0 hit points, you take the remaining damage.

You can summon your shikigami for free once per long rest and again for 3 CE. You can only have one Cursed Centipede summoned at a time. The centipede cannot be targeted  with attacks directly while acting as a Shroud. However, if you are reduced to 0 HP, any remaining damage affects the shikigami.

features.name: Insect Storage
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can store items in the stomach of your centipede. You must have your centipede summoned to take items in or out of it and items can be no larger than a shield or polearm. Your centipede can store a number of pounds equal to twice your Cursed Energy score times your proficiency bonus and you can store or withdraw an item as an object interaction. If you die, the items stored in your centipede explode from your stomach.

features.name: Earthquake
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, as an action you can spend 3 CE to force all creatures within 30 feet to make a Strength saving throw if they are on the ground. On a failure, they take 6d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone. On a success, they take half as much damage. If your cursed centipede is summoned, you can instead do this as a bonus action. This damage increases to 10d6 at 11th and 14d6 at 18th level.

Additionally, you gain 5 stat points you can spend to increase your centipede’s ability scores (max of 22). You can now add your proficiency bonus to any saving throw or skill check it makes.

You gain 5 additional stat points at 11th level.

features.name: Hundred Leg Catastrophe
features.description:
At 11th level, your technique increases by leaps and bounds. As an action for 8 cursed energy, you can launch up to 3 giant centipedes at targets within 120 feet, making a ranged cursed energy attack roll for each. On a hit, they deal 8d10 necrotic damage and the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pushed or pulled 30ft closer or further (your choice) and falls prone.

Additionally, you can now have two cursed centipedes summoned at a time. While you have two cursed centipedes acting as your shroud, you can make 2 melee attacks as a bonus action and instead add 3 + your proficiency bonus to your AC.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Oomukade Banzai
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. Within your domain, your cursed centipedes’s attacks are guaranteed hits. At initiative 20, all creatures are restrained by cursed centipedes and can make a Strength (Athletics) check at the beginning of their turns to escape. The centipedes restraining a creature assists all attacks against the target, causing such attacks to deal an additional 2d10 damage. The cursed centipedes disappear once the domain ends or the creature is no longer grappled.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Oomukade Banzai
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. Within your domain, your cursed centipedes’s attacks are guaranteed hits. At initiative 20, all creatures are restrained by cursed centipedes and can make a Strength (Athletics) check at the beginning of their turns to escape. The centipedes restraining a creature assists all attacks against the target, causing such attacks to deal an additional 2d10 damage. The cursed centipedes disappear once the domain ends or the creature is no longer grappled.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Đại Ngô Công Vạn Tuế

feats.name: Dowsing Vibrations
feats.description: While your centipede shikigami is summoned, you gain 100 ft tremorsense while both of your feet are on the ground. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against creatures who are within your tremorsense (must be touching the ground). This increases to 150 ft at 6th level, 200 ft at 11th, and 300 ft at 18th level.

feats.name: Wu GongPrerequisite: Must have Insect Storage
feats.description: You have learned to concentrate the venom of your cursed centipede and add it to your attacks. When you or your centipede hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 CE to force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes your proficiency in d6s of poison damage and they are stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

feats.name: Centipede Festival
feats.description:
Through your bond with your shikigami, you have learned of its hunger for both flesh and battle, improving your teamwork even more:

When you or your centipede kill a creature within 5 ft, your centipede partially devours the corpse and regains hit points equal to your level + your CE modifier. At 11th level, your centipede can also feast on its cursed energy (unless it has none), causing you to regain 1 cursed energy.

You can spend 1 CE as a bonus action or as part of summoning it to give it temporary hit points equal to twice your level.

descriptionEn: Your technique summons a centipede shikigami to fight with you.

name: Clone
description: Tạo ra các phân thân hoàn hảo từ Chú lực với khả năng tác chiến độc lập, khiến đối thủ không thể phân biệt thực giả trên chiến trường.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: One Man Army
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can spend 3 CE as an action to create a clone within 5 feet of yourself for 8 hours. They are completely indistinguishable from you in every way. A clone has 1/4 of your hit point maximum (rounded up) as well as your AC and access to all your class features and cursed techniques, but not innate technique features. Any cursed energy or features used is treated as if you spent it. Your Clones act on your turn, but can only make one attack on their turn even if you have Extra Attack or bonus action attacks. You can replace any of your attacks on your turn with an attack from the Clone’s space. Your Clones do not have any of your items.

You can have a number of clones equal to your proficiency bonus at once and when a clone dies, the number of clones you can have is reduced by 1 for 1 minute.

features.name: Twice the Fun
features.description: At 3rd level, you can now create multiple clones as an action by spending 3 CE for each clone. When you make a melee attack against a creature while a Clone is within 5 feet of the target, you gain advantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Three is a Crowd
features.description: At 6th level you have become more skillful and efficient with the creation of your clones. Your Clones now have 1/2 of your total hit points. When one of your Clones is reduced to 0 hit points, you regain 1 cursed energy.

features.name: Four is a Party
features.description:
At 11th level, you have mastered the ability to choose which of your Clones is your actual body. Your Clones have hit points equal to yours and you can swap bodies with one of your clones as a bonus action for 1 CE, trading hit points and causing that Clone to become your new body. When you are reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright while you have a Clone active, you can instead transfer yourself into one of your clones, gaining the Clone’s current hit points.

Your Clones can now create one Clone by spending your Cursed Energy with each Clone counting against your limit.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Divide and Conquer
features.description:
Finally at 18th level you have perfected your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. You can now create one Clone as a bonus action without spending cursed energy once per turn (Your Clones do not gain this benefit). Within your domain, you can have an unlimited number of Clones. Your Clone’s attacks are guaranteed hits within your domain.

At initiative 20, an additional clone appears. All Clones created with your domain disappear when the domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Divide and Conquer
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level you have perfected your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. You can now create one Clone as a bonus action without spending cursed energy once per turn (Your Clones do not gain this benefit). Within your domain, you can have an unlimited number of Clones. Your Clone’s attacks are guaranteed hits within your domain.

At initiative 20, an additional clone appears. All Clones created with your domain disappear when the domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Phân Thân Chinh Phục

feats.name: Meant to be Expendable
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have One Man Army
feats.description: As a reaction to damage, you can spend 4 CE to summon a Clone, which shoves you 5 feet and takes the damage in your place.

feats.name: Unstoppable Legion
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Three is a Crowd
feats.description:
You have trained extensively in fighting together with your Clones, gaining the following benefits:

When flanking with a Clone, you deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus

You can create Clones as a bonus action for 1 extra CE per clone

When one of your Clones is reduced to 0 hit points, rather than waiting 1 minute, you only need to wait 1 round

feats.name: Maximum: Conga Line
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Four is a Party
feats.description: You can spend 8 CE as a free action on your turn to tag team an enemy with your Clones, making a Conga Line on your way to stomp them. You and all clones can immediately move 30 feet and take the attack action.

descriptionEn: Your technique allows you to create perfect clones of yourself.

name: Comedian
description: Thuật thức siêu thực của Fumihiko Takaba: biến bất kỳ điều gì mà bản thân cho là hài hước thành hiện thực tuyệt đối, vượt qua cả quy luật nhân quả.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Comedy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, reality bends around you to fit your idea of comedy. As an action for 1 cursed energy, you activate your technique for 1 minute while maintaining concentration. When you are damaged, you can spend 1 cursed energy to take no damage as some funny phenomena allows you to avoid damage (Eg. you open an umbrella to block an attack, you slip on a banana peel to dodge, etc). You also gain proficiency in Performance and at 11th level you gain Expertise.

A creature that knows how your technique works can make a contested Charisma (Persuasion) or Wisdom (Insight) check as an action to deconstruct your humor against your Charisma (Performance). If they roll higher, your technique deactivates as you lose confidence in your comedy and cannot use your technique. You can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the end of your turn to regain control of your technique and cause it to reactivate as normal.

features.name: Commit to the Bit
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have learned to use your comedy to supplement your abilities. You gain access to the following gags while your technique is active:

Blasting Off. On a hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 CE to cause the target to go flying up to 60 ft away from you and fall prone. This increases to 90 ft at 6th level, 120 ft at 11th level, and 200 ft at 18th level.

Props. As a bonus action for 2 CE, you create a number of items equal to your CE modifier that fit in a 5 ft cube that help with your current joke or bit. These items increase to a 10 ft cube at 6th level, 15 ft cube at 11th level, and 20 ft cube at 18th level. These props last for 1 minute or until your technique deactivates.

Powerful Punchline. As an action for 3 CE, you let loose a good punchline related to a joke you tell or a bit you have going. Choose a range and source of the punchline:

30 ft diameter sphere within 80 ft

60 ft long, 5 ft wide line

30 ft cone

All creatures within range must make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw based on the source of the punchline. On a failed save, a target takes your proficiency bonus + your CE modifier in d8s of bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, or psychic damage and an additional effect depending on the punchline (Eg. A bus runs someone over. Creatures in a 60 ft long, 5 ft wide line must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 bludgeoning damage and are pushed to the end of the line and knocked prone on a failed save or half as much damage and not pushed or prone on a success). This damage cannot kill a person since comedy isn’t funny if someone dies.

features.name: Comedic Foil
features.description:
At 6th level, you can even hijack the thoughts of others to go along with your jokes and skits. They find themselves saying things that lead into your jokes. A creature that starts their turn within 300 ft of you while your technique is active must make a Cursed Energy saving throw. On a failure, they cannot use any cursed techniques that would interfere with your current joke until their next turn.

Additionally, you can choose to not allow other creatures to interfere with your combat while your technique is active. This stops other creatures from rolling for initiative or affecting the battle in any way as some random reason prevents them from joining in. You can also choose to remove a creature’s ability to sense cursed energy while they are within 300 ft of you while your technique is active to stop them from being distracted from your jokes.

features.name: Maximum: Peak Comedy
features.description:
At 11th level, you can activate your technique at maximum efficiency. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you activate Comedy for 1 minute. During this minute you gain the following improvements:

Once per turn you can use your Gags without spending cursed energy. You can use Comedy’s negation for free a number of times equal to your CE modifier each round.

The number of props you can create becomes twice your CE modifier. This becomes thrice your CE modifier at 18th level.

The range and radius of your Powerful Punchline are doubled and you can spend 2 cursed energy to deal additional damage dice equal to your proficiency bonus.

As an action you completely change the scene and scenario into one fitting of the joke you tell, teleporting creatures within 100ft into a cutaway. A target in the cutaway must make a Wisdom save or cannot attack unless they make it fit into the cutaway gag.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Stand Up Comedy
features.description:
At 18th level, you have finally learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you can force a cutaway. Completely changing the scene and scenario into one fitting of the joke you are telling. A creature within your domain cannot attack you unless they can make it fit into the cutaway gag. If a creature does not act according to your jokes and gags, the audience boos them and they take 8d8 psychic damage. A creature can only take this damage once per round.

As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) while within your domain, you can tell a joke and make a Charisma (Persuasion) check. All creatures within your domain can make a Wisdom (Insight) check to criticize or attack it. A creature that chooses not to roll or rolls lower than you takes 8d8 psychic damage.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Stand Up Comedy
domain.description:
At 18th level, you have finally learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you can force a cutaway. Completely changing the scene and scenario into one fitting of the joke you are telling. A creature within your domain cannot attack you unless they can make it fit into the cutaway gag. If a creature does not act according to your jokes and gags, the audience boos them and they take 8d8 psychic damage. A creature can only take this damage once per round.

As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) while within your domain, you can tell a joke and make a Charisma (Persuasion) check. All creatures within your domain can make a Wisdom (Insight) check to criticize or attack it. A creature that chooses not to roll or rolls lower than you takes 8d8 psychic damage.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Sân Khấu Hài Độc Thoại

feats.name: Lasting Laughs
feats.description: Even when you’re the one telling the joke, you can’t stop laughing. For an additional 2 CE when you activate Comedy, you can make the technique last 10 minutes. This does not work with Peak Comedy.

feats.name: Super Gag
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Commit to the Bit
feats.description:
You have stepped up your game with some premium material you read online. You gain the following gags while your technique is active:

Written on your Face. As an action for 3 CE, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see. For 1 minute or when your technique ends, the target’s emotions and intentions are literally written on their face. The target has disadvantage on attacks against anyone who can see their face. Anyone that can see their face knows their general emotions and can tell whenever they are scheming or planning something by reading the doodles on their face.

Costume Switch. As an action for 2 CE, you apply a wardrobe change to a number of creatures equal to your CE modifier within 30 ft of you that you can see. This effect is purely cosmetic and cannot change their AC or movement and cannot give them any conditions. You can also change a property about them, such as giving them multiple eyes or arms. These changes are nonfunctional and a creature can take an action to make a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) against your CE save DC inspect these changes. On a success, they realize the changes are fake. This feature lasts for a number of minutes equal to your CE modifier before disappearing.

feats.name: Maximum: Laugh Track
feats.description: As a bonus action for 3 CE while your technique is active, you summon an invisible audience around you. For the next minute, creatures within 30 ft have disadvantage on saves against your techniques and you have advantage on ability checks and saves to maintain your technique.

descriptionEn: Why do you need an explanation? How about a joke!

name: Construction
description: Thuật thức tiêu hao lượng lớn Chú lực để vật chất hóa và tạo ra vật chất thật từ con số không, đỉnh cao là chế tạo Chú cụ hoặc Thể Hoàn Hảo.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Construct
features.description:
Beginning at 1st, you can create any kind of object you understand with your technique, although without much efficiency. As a bonus action for 3 CE, you create one non-magical weapon OR simple object that fits in a 3 ft cube in your hand or within 5 ft of you, as long as you have basic understanding and information of its properties.

You can spend additional CE to create an object with one additional object’s properties or increase the cube by 1 ft. (Eg. You create a greatsword mixed with a spear with both the Heavy, two-handed, and the Versatile and Thrown (20/60) properties. When mixing a light and heavy weapon, choose which property it will maintain.)

features.name: Cursed Creation
features.description:
At 3rd level, your construction technique has improved by a lot, you can now even create cursed objects. You can create a generic imbued Cursed Tool or a specific technique cursed tool you have seen for 3 cursed energy + 2 for every grade it has above 4. These cursed tools last a number of hours equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, before disappearing.

You can make a Special Grade (Legendary) Cursed Tool. However, due to the backlash of your technique, you will die afterward. You cannot be revived in any way, shape or form after using this feature.

features.name: Liquid Metal
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned how to create liquid metal, a substance with fluid form and changeable volume but stable physical properties due to semi-autonomous cursed energy. As part of creating a weapon with your construction, you can spend up to an additional 4 cursed energy to make them become fluid with volume for 1 minute. This allows you to extend the range of melee weapons 10ft per cursed energy.

In addition, whenever you attack with them in this increased range form their damage die tier will increase by 1 per additional cursed energy used. (1d8->1d10->1d12->2d6->2d8)

features.name: Insectoid Armor
features.description:
At 11th level, you realize you need a way to efficiently use your cursed energy despite being an inefficient technique. You have learned how to create armor that simulates the efficiency of an insect's bug body. As a bonus action for 10 cursed energy, you can surround yourself in this armor and gain the following benefits for 1 hour:

Your Strength, Dexterity, and Armor Class scores increase by +4, as a result of the efficiency of the constructs.

You will gain resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. This becomes immunity at 18th level.

Wings will sprout from your back, granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, you can now use a free action to dash on your turn.

Your unarmed strikes deal two additional damage dice and your unarmed strikes roll one additional damage dice on a critical.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Threefold Affliction
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have refined your technique to the maximum point, now gaining your domain expansion. While inside your domain, you can now create any of your items by spending no cursed energy. All of these items will deal two additional damage dice and attacks made with them cannot miss. However, these weapons will only last until the end of the domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Threefold Affliction
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have refined your technique to the maximum point, now gaining your domain expansion. While inside your domain, you can now create any of your items by spending no cursed energy. All of these items will deal two additional damage dice and attacks made with them cannot miss. However, these weapons will only last until the end of the domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tam Trọng Khổ Nạn

feats.name: Subtle Constructs
feats.description: After making a creation you can use underhanded tactics to trick your opponent. After making an item, you can make a Sleight of Hand check against their passive perception. On a success, your first attack or check using this creation has advantage.

feats.name: Imbue
feats.description: You have broken down your ability to create a cursed tool into its very essence, including imbuing cursed techniques into objects. At twice the cost of the normal creation of a Cursed Tool, you can imbue an existing item with that cursed tool's ability for one week. At 6th level this becomes 2 weeks, 3 weeks at 11th level, and a month at 18th level.

feats.name: Maximum: Perfect Sphere
feats.description:
Through research and creativity, you have created a Perfect Sphere with no contact area which generates infinite pressure. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you create a 10-foot diameter perfect sphere of metal that appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of you and lasts for 1 minute while concentrating. Any creature that touches or ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 8d12 force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the saving throw against the sphere’s damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn.

When you move the sphere, it destroys all barriers and non-magical structures in its way.

descriptionEn: Construction, as the name implies, allows the user to conjure objects from nothing.

name: Contractual Recreation
description: Đốt cháy các hóa đơn hoặc khế ước hợp đồng để tái hiện vật thể, phương tiện hoặc dịch vụ ghi trên đó vào thực tế.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Recreation
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have learned the basics of your technique in materializing things from receipts, paying the cost in cursed energy. You start with 5 receipts of your choice. To materialize from a receipt, you spend the required cursed energy as an action. The receipt then becomes ashes and you cannot use this technique if the receipts are wet. You can summon materializations within 100 ft.

Object. You summon an object from the receipt, spending cursed energy equal to its size.

Vehicle. You can summon a vehicle from the receipt, spending cursed energy equal to its size.

Reservation. You can use a reservation receipt for 4 cursed energy, giving you the same effects staying on said place for all of the duration would. For example, a 2 day spa reservation would give you the benefits of a long rest.

Structure. You can create a structure from a receipt for 20 CE.

If you create an object over a creature, they must make a Dexterity save against your CE save DC. On a failure they take 2d6 bludgeoning damage for every size larger than Tiny the object is. If the object is Huge or larger, a creature takes half as much damage on a successful save or is knocked prone and restrained under the object in addition to damage on a fail. Anything created through your technique lasts indefinitely.

features.name: Quick Spender
features.description: At 3rd level, you become better in using your technique with faster activation. You can now materialize receipts as an action or bonus action. At 18th level, you can materialize receipts as an action, bonus action or free action on your turn.

features.name: Splurge
features.description: At 6th level, you become even better with your technique and can use multiple receipts at a time. You can now use a number of receipts at once equal to your proficiency bonus, as long as you're holding them.

features.name: Contractual Control
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned how to manipulate your materializations using your mind. You can manipulate objects or vehicles as a bonus action by spending 3 cursed energy per object or vehicle manipulated. Anything you use this on disappears afterwards.

Objects. You can manipulate a number of objects you have summoned telepathically. You can move them in the air up to 60 ft, and can use them normally from afar.

Weapon. Once per turn when you take the attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with a melee cursed energy attack roll with said object if it was a weapon. On a hit, it deals 5 of the weapon's damage dice. This increases to 7 dice at 15th level and 10 at 18th level.

Vehicles. You can order a vehicle to ride up to 60 ft. A creature in the path must make a Dexterity save or take the vehicle damage dice (depending on size) and be knocked prone.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Black Friday At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. You can use Recreation and Contractual Control at no cursed energy cost within your domain. At initiative 20, you gain a random receipt. D4 (1: Object, 2: Vehicles, 3: Reservation, 4: Structure) The DM decides the nature of the receipt.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Black Friday
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. You can use Recreation and Contractual Control at no cursed energy cost within your domain. At initiative 20, you gain a random receipt. D4 (1: Object, 2: Vehicles, 3: Reservation, 4: Structure) The DM decides the nature of the receipt.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thứ Sáu Đen

feats.name: Surprise Present
feats.description: As a reaction against any hostile action taken against you, you can materialize one of your receipts for twice the cursed energy cost in a surprise attack. If using an object, you force the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage if they are within range. On a failure, they take bludgeoning damage depending on the object’s size. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage. If using a weapon, you can make an attack with the weapon against the attacker at advantage if they are within range. At 11th level, this can be used with Contractual Control with only the one Object or Weapon used as part of this reaction.

feats.name: Bulk Buyer
feats.description: You’ve learned that buying in bulk can lead to a sale! When you use two or more receipts as part of the same action, the CE costs are each reduced by 1 for every receipt you use (minimum cost of 1). If the receipts are of the same type, you gain advantage on attack rolls and ability checks using those creations for 1 minute.

feats.name: Master of Receipts
feats.description: You have become a master at utilizing your receipts. The cost of materializing is halved, and creations you use with Contractual Control can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus before they disappear.

descriptionEn: You can recreate the subject of contracts you find, like receipts.

name: Cursed Cannon
description: Phóng xuất những luồng đại pháo Chú lực cực đại từ mái tóc pompadour với xuất lực bùng nổ vô tiền khoáng hậu (Granite Blast).

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being Charisma or Wisdom.

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + CE modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Granite Blast
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your CE output is off the charts, and thanks to your technique allowing you to output it in a destructive death ray. As an action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to release a beam. Make a ranged cursed energy attack roll with a range of 150/600 feet. On a hit, it deals 2d6 + your CE modifier in necrotic damage. Before you make your attack roll, you can spend additional cursed energy up to your CE modifier to deal one additional damage dice per CE spent.

Beginning at 3rd level, the damage increases to 3d6, to 4d8 at 6th, to 5d10 at 11th, to 6d12 at 18th level.

features.name: Grape Choux
features.description: At 3rd level, your versatility with your blasts has increased. For 1 additional cursed energy, you can split your Granite Blast into different blasts, with damage dice spread evenly between them. Only two of the damage rolls can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll.

features.name: Dessert Deluge
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, your shots are malleable and extremely difficult to avoid. Once per attack roll, you can choose to spend up to 5 cursed energy points to add to the attack roll.

features.name: Maximum: Granita Lusso
features.description: At 11th level, your output reaches an all time high. As an action for 6 cursed energy, all creatures in a 10 ft wide 60 ft long line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take twice your Granite Blast damage or half as much on a success. You can spend additional cursed energy up to your CE modifier to deal one additional damage dice per cursed energy spent. Objects and structures within range take maximum damage. After using this, you fall under the effects of Technique Burnout until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Il Gran Dolce
features.description:
Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your technique to the maximum, gaining your domain expansion. While inside it, at Initiative 20, you can choose up to three targets to suffer the full effects of Granite Blast.

While in Technique Burnout after your domain ends, you cannot use any Innate Technique features other than Granite Blast.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Il Gran Dolce
domain.description:
Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your technique to the maximum, gaining your domain expansion. While inside it, at Initiative 20, you can choose up to three targets to suffer the full effects of Granite Blast.

While in Technique Burnout after your domain ends, you cannot use any Innate Technique features other than Granite Blast.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Đại Điềm Điểm

feats.name: Croquembouche
feats.description: You have realized a new way to utilize your massive output. Once per turn when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 CE to replace an attack with a use of your Granite Blast as a melee cursed energy attack. This cannot be used with Grape Choux.

feats.name: Highest Output Alive
feats.description:
You have never met anyone who can match you. When it comes to sheer output, you've always been overwhelmingly stronger.
