When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy, you can spend even more additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus.

Once per turn, you can ignore one of the requirements for activating Maximum Output (e.g. 5 minimum CE or having 20+ CE score). This does not allow you to ignore the additional CE cost of Maximum Output.

feats.name: Corona Macaron
feats.description:
You’ve learned to mold your cursed energy blasts into a fighting ring. As an action for 3 cursed energy, you create a 20 ft diameter ring centered on yourself for 1 minute. This ring follows you and provides half cover to creatures within the ring from outside attacks that pass through. This becomes three quarters cover at 11th level.

If a creature comes in contact with the outside of the ring, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the ring. Once a creature has been pulled inside, the ring is no longer centered on you and will not move. If you or the creature comes into contact with the ring, you take damage equal to your Granite Blast. You can only take this damage once per round. As an action, a creature inside can make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cursed Energy save DC to escape. On a success, they slip past the ring and can exit. On a failure, they take your Granite Blast damage and are pushed 5 ft towards you. You can end this technique as a free action on your turn.

feats.name: Parfait Singulier
feats.description: You have found a brand new and destructive pathway for your technique. When you use Granite Lusso, you can choose a number of creatures in range up to your Cursed Energy modifier, spending 1 cursed energy per creature. These creatures take additional necrotic damage equal to your Cursed Energy score. On a failed save, they are knocked prone and stunned until the end of their next turn.

descriptionEn: Cursed Cannon, as the name says, allows you to unleash blasts of cursed energy. As simple as it is, its power is undeniable.

name: Cursed Circuitry
description: Tạo ra mạng lưới vi mạch Chú lực siêu dẫn chạy khắp cơ thể, tối ưu hóa hiệu suất tiêu hao Chú lực và cường hóa phản xạ thần kinh.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Circuit
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, as a bonus action for 2 Cursed Energy, you can apply a Circuit to yourself or an object you touch for 1 minute. You can also apply your Circuit to another willing creature you touch for 5 CE for half the time. Your cursed circuit gives the following:

Efficiency. The base cost of a feature that requires cursed energy other than Cursed Circuitry features decreases by 1 (min cost of 1). If a feature’s effects depend on how much cursed energy you spend, one cursed energy you spend gives the effects of two. (Eg. Spending 2 CE on Cursed Strike counts as 4 CE). This cannot cause the cursed energy to be higher than your output limit.

Output. When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy to strengthen the effects, you can spend additional cursed energy up to half to your proficiency bonus (rounded up).

Enhancement. If you apply your circuit onto an Object or Cursed Tool, it instead gains one of the following benefits of your choice:

The item deals an additional 2d4 necrotic damage on a hit.

The item grants a +2 bonus to AC

The cursed energy cost of the tool decreases by 1 (min of 1)

You can only have 1 circuit at a time. This becomes 2 circuits at 3rd level, 3 circuits at 6th, and 4 at 11th level.

features.name: Pure Energy Efficiency
features.description: At 3rd level, your technique has further increased in efficient functions. A creature under the effects of your Circuit, only lose 4 cursed energy for every 5 CE spent at once (Eg. target uses Hollow Purple for 10 CE, they cast it and only lose 8 CE).

features.name: High Performance Circuit
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, you can now apply a high performing Circuit to yourself or an object you touch as a bonus action for 2 CE or a willing creature you touch for 5 CE. Your circuit now lasts for 1 hour or 10 minutes if applied to another creature.

Improved Efficiency. The base cost of a feature that requires cursed energy other than Cursed Circuitry features decreases by 3 (min cost of 1). If a feature’s effects depend on how much cursed energy you spend, 1 CE you spend counts as 3 CE (Eg. Spending 2 CE on Cursed Strike counts as 6 CE). This cannot cause the effective cursed energy to be higher than a feature’s output limit.

Increased Output. When a feature allows you to spend additional cursed energy to strengthen the effects, you can spend additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus.

Enhancement. If you apply your circuit onto an Object or Cursed Tool, it instead gains two of the following benefits of your choice:

The item deals an additional 2d6 necrotic damage on a hit, increasing to 2d10 at 11th level.

The item grants a +3 bonus to AC, increasing to +5 at 11th level.

The cursed energy cost of the tool decreases by 2 (min of 1). This instead decreases cost by 4 at 11th level.

features.name: Circuit Breaker
features.description: At 11th level, your Circuit now lasts for 8 hours or until you end it as a bonus action. Once per turn when one of your circuits ends, your next unarmed strike or attack with the item that held the circuit deals an additional 5d10 necrotic damage on a hit.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Deus ex Machina
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Within your domain, you are always under the effect of your Circuit. At initiative 20, creatures of your choice within your domain take necrotic damage equal to their current cursed energy as your domain saps their cursed energy into the circuit.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Deus ex Machina
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Within your domain, you are always under the effect of your Circuit. At initiative 20, creatures of your choice within your domain take necrotic damage equal to their current cursed energy as your domain saps their cursed energy into the circuit.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thần Cơ Giáng Lâm

feats.name: Closed Circuit
feats.description: Your technique specializing in energy efficiency has begun to develop your body. You no longer leave residuals of your cursed energy and creatures have disadvantage on checks to directly detect you through your cursed energy. As an action, you can concentrate for up to 1 minute to hide your cursed energy within your circuit, giving anyone a -5 to their skill checks to directly sense your cursed energy.

feats.name: Layered Grid
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Pure Energy Efficiency
feats.description: Your maximum number of circuits is doubled. Additionally, you can now apply multiple circuits to a creature or object, spending 1 CE per additional circuit. You can have a number of circuits on the same target up to your proficiency bonus. For every additional circuit, a creature’s benefits from Output instead increases by 1. An object instead gains additional Enhancements.

feats.name: Maximum: Overclock
feats.description:
While under the effects of your Circuit, you can cause overclock the Circuit, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

You reduce all damage taken by half your current cursed energy (minimum of 2 + your CE modifier).

If a feature’s effects depend on how much cursed energy you spend, you treat each one CE spent as five CE. This cannot cause the cursed energy spent to be higher than your output limit.

You deal an additional 2d12 necrotic damage on melee and ranged weapon attacks.

Once this minute ends, the circuit automatically ends as your technique becomes overheated and you cannot gain the benefit of a Circuit or apply a new Circuit for 1 minute.

descriptionEn: You can apply a circuit that allows for extremely efficient use of cursed energy.

name: Cursed Corpse Creation
description: Nghệ thuật tạo tác Chú hài tối thượng của Hiệu trưởng Yaga: dung hợp ba linh hồn độc lập để tạo ra Chú hài biến dị tự vận hành như Panda.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Cursed Corpse Creation
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your technique allows you to master the process of creating cursed corpses. A cursed corpse requires a cursed core to function, cursed energy for fuel, and a body. You start with either 2 completed tiny cursed corpses or 1 small cursed corpse.

Core. While you have enough money and access to materials, you can create up to a Small core as part of a long rest. At 3rd level, you can make a Medium Core, a Large at 6th level, Huge at 11th level, and Gargantuan at 18th level.

features.name: Cursed Core Size     | Cost        | Max Cursed Energy
features.description:
-------------------------------------------------------

Tiny Core            | $5,000      | 10

Small Core           | $30,000     | 25

Medium Core          | $100,000    | 50

Large Core           | $250,000    | 75

Huge Core            | $500,000    | 100

Gargantuan Core      | $1,000,000  | 150

Imbuement. While you have a core, you can imbue the core with cursed energy, allowing it to animate. You can imbue cursed energy into a core you touch as an action and grant it any amount of your cursed energy. However as shown in the table above it has a maximum amount it can handle. If the corpse uses cursed energy it comes from this pool and must be recharged by you. A tiny or small cursed corpse expends 1 CE for each day it is active. A medium or large consumes 5, huge consumes 10, and gargantuan consumes 20.

Body. The third thing you need is a body. The amount of materials and time needed for your cursed corpse is defined by its size. Your cursed corpse requires a core with a size matching the body. You can create up to a Small Cursed Corpse. At 3rd level, you can make a Medium Cursed Corpse, a Large at 6th level, Huge at 11th level, and Gargantuan at 18th level.

Cursed Corpse Size          | Cost                         | Time

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Tiny Cursed Corpse          | $1,000 worth of materials    | 30 min

Small Cursed Corpse         | $10,000 worth of materials   | 3 hours

Medium Cursed Corpse        | $50,000 worth of materials   | 24 hours

Large Cursed Corpse         | $75,000 worth of materials   | 72 hours

Huge Cursed Corpse          | $100,000 worth of materials  | 216 hours

Gargantuan Cursed Corpse    | $150,000 worth of materials  | 648 hours

Completed Cursed Corpse. After building your cursed corpse, it will use the following depending on what size it is. The cursed corpse inherits your proficiency bonus at the time of its creation. They regain their health normally on a short or long rest, and cannot be healed using Reversed Cursed Technique.

Cursed corpses are created for a niche and you allocate their stats during creation. Each score is a 6 before allocation and you have 27 points that you allocate between scores. Every increase costs 1 point, except for 14 and above, which cost 2 points each. The maximum score is as follows:

Ability       | Tiny | Small | Medium | Large | Huge | Gargantuan |

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Strength      | 12   | 14    | 16     | 18    | 20   | 24         |

Dexterity     | 18   | 16    | 14     | 12    | 10   | 8          |

Constitution  | 12   | 14    | 16     | 18    | 20   | 24         |

Intelligence  | 10   | 9     | 8      | 8     | 8    | 6          |

Wisdom        | 10   | 9     | 8      | 8     | 8    | 6          |

Charisma      | 10   | 9     | 8      | 8     | 8    | 6          |

You can command a number of cursed corpses up to your proficiency bonus as a bonus action to act on your turn to have them act. Additionally, you can command the same number of cursed corpses as an action to give them a complex command that allows them to function for much longer as long as they are following that command. A Cursed Corpse with the Autonomy Mutation does not require commands to act, but can be commanded as a free action on your turn.

features.name: Corpse Tactics
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have learned new ways to command your cursed corpses during combat. You can use one of these tactics as part of the bonus action you take to command your Cursed Corpses and lasts until the start of your next turn.

Cooperative Tactics. You give one of your Cursed Corpses advantage on an attack or saving throw on their turn.

Offensive Tactics. You cause one of your Cursed Corpses to deal an additional damage die on a hit.

Defensive Tactics. You let one of your Cursed Corpses take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

Guerilla Tactics. You let one of your cursed Corpses take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

Mobility Tactics. You let one of your Cursed Corpses take the Dash action as a bonus action.

features.name: Cursed Corpse Mutation
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your strong cursed energy has caused mutations to form. When you complete a cursed corpse, you roll a d20. On a roll of 20, your cursed corpse gains a random mutation.

features.name: D12 Roll   | Mutation         | Effect
features.description:
---------------------------------------------------------------

1          | Quick Movement   | Gains +20 ft bonus to walking speed.

2          | Adaptive Movement| Gains 30 ft climb or swim speed.

3          | Skills           | Prof in 2 skills or 1 saving throw.

4          | Hardened Frame   | Gains +3 bonus to AC.

5          | Weapon Usage     | Can wield weapons proficiently.

6          | Toughness        | Max HP increases by 2 x your level.

7          | Energy Capacity  | One core can hold +30 additional CE.

8          | Energy Usage     | Can use Basic CE Manipulation.

9          | Improved Ability | Gains +4 to an Ability and Max.

10         | Autonomy         | Doesn’t require commands (sentient).

11         | Core Capacity    | Can hold 1d4 additional cores.

12         | Self Generation  | Regains 1 CE per hour.

features.name: Maximum: Prized Creation
features.description:
At 11th level, you can put extra time and care into one of your favorite cursed corpses to make a masterpiece. You can choose one of your existing Cursed Corpses or when you make a new Cursed Corpse to be your Favorite. It gains the following:

It gains a +4 bonus to two of its Ability scores and their maximums for that score.

The damage die of all its attacks increases by one tier (D10<D12<2d8).

It gains 3 Mutations of your choice. You cannot select the same Mutation multiple times.

features.name: Perfect Creations
features.description: At 18th level, you can command all Cursed Corpses under your control as a bonus action on your turn regardless of numbers or distance. Additionally, your Cursed Corpses can continue functioning for a week after running out of cursed energy.

feats.name: Expert Maker
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must make Cursed Corpse Creation
feats.description:
You have spent your life learning your technique and learned tips and tricks that help you master the process. You can create a cursed core or body for 1/3 of the cost or time.

Soul ImbuementPrerequisites: Must have Cursed Corpse Creation

You have learned to copy a creature’s soul information into a Cursed Corpse. You can only have 1 soul imbued corpse at a time. This increases to 2 at 11th level and 3 at 18th level.

It takes 3 long rests to imbue someone's soul information into the core. You must have the person readily available or have a good memory of the person to turn their physical information into soul information. Once a corpse has been created, it takes 2 weeks to develop before it becomes sentient. It gains the Autonomy mutation and can choose a Cursed Energy feat as if it were a player. A corpse with this core is sentient and mimics the behavior of the soul they are imbued with, but it does not gain its memories.

feats.name: Cursed Tactician
feats.description: When you use Corpse Tactics, you can spend ce up to your proficiency bonus to use an additional tactics option for each ce spent. You can choose the same tactics option as part of the same bonus action, but you cannot use the same tactics multiple times on the same cursed corpse.

feats.name: Mutate Specialist
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Corpse Mutation
feats.description: You have learned the process to purposely force mutations to occur. When you roll for a mutation, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the roll. If you succeed, you roll for an additional mutation for every number higher than 20. You cannot gain the same mutation more than once.

descriptionEn: You create advanced cursed corpses that can function autonomously.

name: Cursed Speech
description: Bảo thuật gia truyền của gia tộc Inumaki: nén Chú lực vào từng lời nói để cưỡng ép thực tại tuân theo mệnh lệnh ngôn từ, đổi lại cổ họng chịu phản phệ nặng nề.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
At 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Power of Words
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have been born with the Inumaki clan’s snake eyes and fangs seal on you, and can now curse other people just by merely speaking. However, this takes extreme strain on your vocal cords. Your vocal cords have a number of hit points equal to 1/3rd of your maximum hit points(rounded up). You are unable to speak unless in terms of whatever meaningless concept you choose such as sushi ingredients. For every Cursed Energy you spend in a cursed word, your vocal cords lose one hit point. Your vocal cords hit points all come back in a short or long rest. If your vocal chords reach 0 hit points, you won't be able to regain the hit points unless you receive hit points from Reverse Cursed Technique or take a long rest. If you have 0 hit points you cannot use your cursed words, and will always be under one level of exhaustion. Your vocal cords will regain 1 hit point at the beginning of your turns unless they are at 0 hit points. Any kind of hit point gain you receive affects your vocal cords' hit points. You can the Cursed Words below(X=Cursed Energy Mod):

Sleep: Replace one of your attacks for 1 Cursed Energy to cast Sleep at 1st level. You can add 3d8 per 1 extra Cursed Energy added at 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

Return: As an attack, for 1 Cursed Energy, you make a summoned creature within 60 ft make a Charisma save against your save DC or be unsummoned. At 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 18th levels you can choose to spend +1 Cursed Energy for +1 to DC.

Run Away: As an attack, for 2 Cursed Energy, you force one creature within 60 ft to run away from you, but not into harm. At 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 18th levels you can choose to spend +1 CE for +1 to DC or +1 target per Cursed Energy.

Blast Away: As an attack for 4 cursed energy, you force one target to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are launched 60 ft back from the spot they were in, taking 1d8 force damage per 10ft traveled. At 3rd level, you can spend 1 additional Cursed Energy to add +10 to the distance the target is blasted away. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th.

Plummet: As an action for 6 Cursed Energy, you force a target to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, take Xd10 force damage and are knocked prone for 1 minute as a field of intensified gravity crushes them. They remove the prone condition if they succeed on a Strength saving throw on their turn. At 3rd level, you can spend +1 CE for additional Xd10 force damage. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th. (X = CE modifier)

Get Twisted: As an action for 8 Cursed Energy, you force a target to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure one of their legs or arms of your choice will be twisted, breaking the limb. In addition, the target will lose hit points equal to their Constitution score times half your proficiency bonus(rounded down). An arm twisted removes the ability to use that arm and reduces the creature’s Strength by 2, and twisting a leg halves movement and reduces Dexterity by 2. At 3rd level, you can spend 1 additional Cursed Energy to add a +1 to the DC. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

Get Crushed: As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you force a target to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are imploded which makes them lose xd12 maximum hit points and become paralyzed. They will keep being imploded for 1 minute, this can be ended early if they succeed on a Strength saving throw, on a failure they will keep losing xd12 of their maximum hit points at the beginning of their turns. The hit points lost will be regained at the end of a long rest. At 3rd level, you can spend 1 additional Cursed Energy to add a d12 to the amount of hit points lost. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

Don't Move: As an action for 12 Cursed Energy, you cast Power Word Stun at 8th level. You increase the HP limit by 25 HP per 1 point of Cursed Energy added at 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

Explode: As an action for 14 Cursed Energy, you force a target and every creature within 5ft. of it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they will explode from the inside out making them receive 3d8 force damage + xd6 fire damage. At 3rd level, you can spend 1 additional Cursed Energy to add a d8 to the force damage. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

Die: As an action for 16 Cursed Energy, you force a target with 30 times your Cursed Energy modifier hit points or less to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they die instantly. At 3rd level, you can spend 1 additional Cursed Energy to add a +1 to the DC and 10 hit points to the requirement. You can spend another +1 at 6th, 11th, and 18th levels.

features.name: Interjection
features.description: Beginning at 3rd, you have learned how to say one specific word quicker than the others. You can choose one of your cursed words to use as a Bonus Action or Reaction. You can change the chosen word at the end of a long rest.

features.name: Iron Chords
features.description: When you reach 6th level,  due to the constant usage of your vocal cords, they have gotten stronger. Your vocal cords' hit points increase to half your maximum hit points(rounded up).

features.name: Resounding Voice
features.description: At 11th level, you can spend 3 extra Cursed Energy to change the effect range of your technique into a 35-foot cone.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Echo Chamber
features.description: If you reach 18th level, you have honed your technique to a fine edge, gaining your domain expansion. While inside it, at Initiative 20, you can make all creatures fall under the effect of a word of your choice for no cost.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Echo Chamber
domain.description: If you reach 18th level, you have honed your technique to a fine edge, gaining your domain expansion. While inside it, at Initiative 20, you can make all creatures fall under the effect of a word of your choice for no cost.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Vọng Âm Cộng Hưởng

feats.name: Fighting Words
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Power of Words
feats.description: “Oh, them's fighting words”, you have found a way to make your words insulting. When using a word you can force the enemy to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you.

feats.name: Quick Tongue
feats.description: Your versatility and training have increased the amount of words you have and your speed. You can choose one more word to be under the effect of Interjection.

feats.name: Megaphone
feats.description: You have found a way to increase your power using an outside tool. For 3 Cursed Energy you can create or imbue a megaphone for 1 minute that causes your words to affect a 60-foot cone. The megaphone has hit points equal to twice your CE score and damages the megaphone instead of your vocal chords when used in this way. When reduced to 0 hit points, the megaphone turns to dust.

descriptionEn: This power is called both a blessing and a curse, you can speak your will to reality.

name: Cursed Spirit Manipulation
description: Thuật thức của Suguru Geto: thu phục và điều khiển hàng ngàn Chú linh đã bị đánh bại, biến chúng thành đội quân diệt trừ trung thành tuyệt đối.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Cursed Spirit Absorption
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you know the taste that no one will ever know, the taste of curses. As an action or reaction for 1 Cursed Energy, you exorcise a cursed spirit with 0 hit points, or a cursed spirit whose CR is less than your proficiency bonus within 120 ft that you can see and transform its soul into a small orb for you to eat. After that, you can summon it as an ally to fight for you. You can summon Cursed Spirits as an action by spending Cursed Energy equal to their CR. You can summon a number of cursed spirits as an action equal to your Cursed Energy modifier within 10 ft. They lose their free will and follow every command you give them. If reduced to 0 hit points they die and cannot be revived. They cannot use actions on their own. You must spend a bonus action to command each cursed spirit to attack, use cursed techniques, or do something more specific, such as 'protect that creature, grab that, kill that, etc. You can unsummon any number of curses as a bonus action, provided they are within line of sight.

You can only consume orbs without physical detriments if the curse has a CR lower or equal to your level. If you try to eat an orb out of a creature with a CR higher than your level, you must roll a DC 5 + the creature's CR Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, you absorb the curse and can use it after a short or long rest. On a fail, you gain 2 levels of exhaustion and receive Xd12 Necrotic Damage (X = curse CR) and cannot absorb it.

You're also able to absorb other sorcerer's cursed spirits as long as you kill the master first. You can have any number of cursed spirits, but for every 10 cursed spirits you consume, you must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, you will gain no aftereffects. On a failure, you will gain a level of exhaustion or two exhaustion levels if you fail the save by 5 or more. This becomes three levels of exhaustion if you fail the save by 10 or more.

features.name: Curse Infused Spirits
features.description:
Once you reach 3rd level, your Cursed Energy increases the power of your Cursed Spirits in the following ways:

Their Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores will gain a bonus equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

They regain all HP at the end of a short rest.

They become immune to the frightened or charmed condition.

Regardless of distance, you'll know if your cursed spirits were exorcised.

In addition, as a reaction for x Cursed Energy you can sacrifice a cursed spirit in exchange for reducing incoming damage by xd20, with x being the CR of the creature sacrificed in the process.

features.name: Perfect Control
features.description:
At 6th level, you have grown experienced with your cursed technique, giving you perfect control over your spirits and gain the following benefits:

The amount of cursed spirits it takes for you to make a Wisdom saving throw increases to 20.

Your cursed spirits cost is reduced by your Cursed Energy modifier (minimum cost of 1 CE).

Your DC for eating cursed spirits with a CR higher than your level is decreased by your Cursed Energy modifier

You can now summon cursed spirits as a bonus action.

features.name: Maximum: Uzumaki
features.description:
When you reach 11th level, as an action you can put any number of your cursed spirits in a spiral-like pattern(minimum 2), making them into a dark spiral that you can use in an attack. Every creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, on a success they take half damage, on a failure they take 2d12 Necrotic damage.

For every cursed spirit above 2, the area of effect will be increased by 5 feet, and the damage will increase by 1d12.

All of the cursed spirits that were used in the Uzumaki are killed. However, you can obtain the actions(including legendary actions)they have at a cost which must be paid when extracting them via Uzumaki. You can extract multiple actions from different curses as part of the process, but you must pay the cost for each action.

The cost for the actions is listed below and once extracted, the action can be used only once:

features.name: Domain Expansion: Womb Profusion
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned how to expand your domain. A tree of souls surrounded by four seated Buddhas at the cardinal points emerges behind you, as your barrier starts opening. The area targeted by this feature counts as difficult terrain for all creatures. You can use any of your cursed spirits without any cost. Cursed spirits within your domain must make a Charisma saving throw at the beginning of their turns or be instantly absorbed by you.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Womb Profusion
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned how to expand your domain. A tree of souls surrounded by four seated Buddhas at the cardinal points emerges behind you, as your barrier starts opening. The area targeted by this feature counts as difficult terrain for all creatures. You can use any of your cursed spirits without any cost. Cursed spirits within your domain must make a Charisma saving throw at the beginning of their turns or be instantly absorbed by you.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thai Tạng Biến Dịch

feats.name: Curse Restoration
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Curse Infused Spirits
feats.description: You have learned to weaponize the affinity cursed spirits have and utilize to regenerate and can activate it using your own cursed energy. Once per turn as an action, bonus action, or reaction you can spend up to your cursed energy modifier to restore 5 hit points per cursed energy spent to a cursed spirit you have summoned within 60 ft of you. At 11th level this becomes 10 hit points per cursed energy.

feats.name: Defensive Summoning
feats.description: Your reaction speed and control over your Cursed Spirits has increased. As a reaction, for 5 Cursed Energy you can summon a CR 5 or lower cursed spirit that takes as much of the triggering damage as it can. You take any remaining damage. If it survives, it then lands in an unoccupied area within 5 ft of you.

feats.name: Minimum: Uzumaki
feats.description:
Due to your extended studies, you have made a smaller version of Uzumaki that's more deadly and much harder to dodge. As a bonus action, you can spend two cursed spirits to create a miniature Uzumaki that fits in your hand. It can't be seen by the creature unless its passive Perception is 25 or higher, or the creature succeeds a Perception check. As an action or reaction for 5 Cursed Energy, you can release all the condensed energy from this Uzumaki at a target within 30 feet. Make a ranged cursed energy attack roll, on a hit the target takes Xd12 of necrotic damage(X being the combined CR of the 2 curses). Like Maximum Uzumaki, this ignores resistance and treats immunity like resistance. You have advantage on your attack roll if the target has not detected your Minimum Uzumaki.

Similar to Maximum Uzumaki, you can obtain actions, reactions, bonus actions, and legendary actions of the creature's technique.

descriptionEn: You are blessed with an amazing technique to control Cursed Spirits.

name: Cursed Transmutation
description: Biến đổi hình dạng, bản chất và cấu trúc Chú lực của bản thân, thích nghi linh hoạt trước mọi đòn tấn công nguyên tố của kẻ thù.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Basic Transmutation
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have learned to use your technique to alter the properties of items you touch. As an action you can spend an amount of cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to alter the shape or properties of a nonliving object you touch.

For each cursed energy point spent, you can affect up to a 5 ft cube of material per cursed energy spent (Metal costs an additional CE per cube). You can reshape the affected material in any way that fits within its original volume, allowing you to create cover, create difficult terrain, block passages, form platforms, or otherwise reposition the material to aid movement. At 6th level you can spend up to twice your Cursed Energy modifier, three times at 11th and four times at 18th.

A Transmuted Object has an AC of 10 and 5 hit points per 5 ft cube affected. The object’s durability increases if transmuting one of the following, as shown below:

features.name: Wood: +1 AC and +10 hit points per cube
Earth: +2 AC and +15 hit points per cube
Stone: +3 AC and +20 hit points per cube
Metal: +4 AC and +30 hit points per cube
features.description: Transmuted Objects automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws and are immune to poison and psychic damage.

features.name: Chemical Formulae
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have studied the structure of your technique and learned greater ways to utilize it:

Transmute Explosion. On a hit with a weapon attack, you can spend 2 cursed energy to transmute the attack and force the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save. This increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level and 6d6 at 18th level.

Transmute Self. As a reaction, you can spend cursed energy to transmute yourself in one of the following ways (X = CE modifier):

Harden (2 CE) You harden your body and gain a +4 bonus to AC until the start of your turn.

Shell (X CE) You create a shell over your body and gain 5 temporary hit points per cursed energy spent.

Slick (2 CE) You cover parts of your body in a solution and gain a 20 ft bonus to walking speed and do not provoke opportunity attacks until the start of your turn.

features.name: Areal Transmute
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to change the properties of larger areas. As an action for 6 cursed energy, you can transmute the ground beneath you in a radius of up to 30 ft in the following ways:

Slippery. You coat the area in a solution, forcing all creatures other than yourself to make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

Explosive. You destabilize the ground by adding protons. As an action on your next turn, you release an explosion forcing all creatures in range (including you) to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 4d6 fire damage or half as much on a success. This increases to 6d6 at 11th level and 8d6 at 18th level.

Spikey. You form physical spikes in the area. A creature that walks 5 ft through this area takes 2d4 piercing damage.

Shifting. You form random foot falls and hazards in the area, causing it to become difficult terrain.

features.name: Maximum: Railgun
features.description:
Starting at 11th level, you can compress matter and cursed energy into a hyper-accelerated projectile, launching it at a deafening velocity.

As an action, you spend 8 cursed energy and transmute a small piece of nonliving material you can touch or that is on your person into a railgun slug. Choose a point or creature you can see within 120 feet to be the target and make a ranged cursed energy attack against them

On a hit, the target takes 8d12 piercing damage or half as much damage if the attack misses and must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Cursed Energy save DC or be pushed up to 30 feet directly away from you and knocked prone. If the target impacts another object or structure it takes 2d12 bludgeoning damage. Objects and structures in the projectile’s path automatically take twice as much damage and are destroyed if reduced to 0 hit points. A creature in the projectile’s path must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d12 thunder damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Mandala of Dependant Origination
features.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, your entire domain is affected by an Areal Transmute of your choice and takes effect immediately. Additionally, you can use Transmute Self on willing creatures within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Mandala of Dependant Origination
domain.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, your entire domain is affected by an Areal Transmute of your choice and takes effect immediately. Additionally, you can use Transmute Self on willing creatures within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Duyên Khởi Mạn Đà La

feats.name: Amplified Transmute
feats.description: You have learned to amplify your transmutations with modified formulas and stronger cursed energy. The AC of a Transmuted Object increases by your proficiency bonus and has 15 hit points per 5 ft cube. This increases to 20 at 3rd level, 30 at 6th level, 45 at 11th level and 60 at 18th level.

feats.name: Additional Formulae
feats.description:
You can choose to gain two of the following options (This feat can be taken more than once):

Transmute Explosion (3 CE). As an action, you transmute the chemical composition of a 10 ft cube of air within 60 ft of you creating an explosion. All creatures within that cube must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5d6 fire damage or half as much on a success. This becomes 8d6 at 11th level and 14d6 at 18th level.

Modify Attributes (2 CE). As a bonus action, you swap your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution scores for 1 minute (can end it as a free action).

Pressurization (3 CE). As an action, you transmute the pressure of the air around you for up to 1 minute while concentrating. For the duration, you gain a 15 ft fly speed. This increases to 25 ft at 6th level, 40 ft at 11th level and 60 ft at 18th level.

Transmute Element (1 CE). When you deal a damage type from the following list, you can spend 1 CE to change that damage type to one of the other listed types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder.

feats.name: Transmute Aether
feats.description:
Whether through chance or experimentation, you have learned to transmute an unknown element that cannot logically exist. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you transmute a 5 ft sphere of air or material you touch into a 5 ft cube of Aether for 1 minute. Any creature other than you that comes into contact with or hits the Aether with a melee attack within 5 ft of it takes 20d4 necrotic damage. A creature can only take this damage once per turn and it ignores immunity and resistances. The Aether has an AC of 1 and 100 hit points.

You are able to touch the Aether harmlessly and pass through it as if it were difficult terrain. You can move or reshape the Aether as an action while it is within 100 ft of you. You can move it up to 30 ft and if the Aether enters another creature’s space, it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 20d4 necrotic damage. If you reshape the Aether, you can change its shape or split it into two smaller spheres. Touching these smaller cubes instead deals 10d4 necrotic damage.

You can only move one cube of Aether at a time no matter what size it is. While within 5 ft of Aether, you can spend half your movement to enter the Aether’s space and reappear from another Aether cube.

descriptionEn: You can change form, nature, and substance through your technique.

name: Dark Claw
description: Ngưng tụ Chú lực thành bộ vuốt hắc ám sắc bén xé toạc phòng ngự và để lại những vết thương hoại tử sâu hoắm trên da thịt đối thủ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Claw
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you have learned to harden your cursed energy into dark claws on your left hand. As a bonus action for 1 cursed energy, you form your claw for 1 hour. Your claws are natural weapons, which counts as a simple melee weapon you are proficient with. It deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the light and finesse property and can use your Cursed Energy modifier for attack and damage rolls. This increases to 1d8 at 3rd level, 1d10 at 6th level, 1d12 at 11th level, and 2d8 at 18th.

features.name: Claws Modifications
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have learned new methods of enhancement. You gain two Claw options and one more option at 6th, 11th, and 18th level.

Brutal Claws. Your claws deal an additional damage dice.

Elemental Claws. You can choose to change the damage type of your claws to one of the following types: fire, cold, lightning, thunder, acid. You can change the type during a long rest.

Absorbing Claws. On a hit, you can spend 1 CE to deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

Pure Claws. Your claws ignore resistances to damage.

Barbed Claws. Once per turn on a hit, you can spend 2 CE to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are bleeding and take 1d6 slashing damage at the start of their turn until a creature uses their action to staunch the wound or they regain hit points.

features.name: Ultimate Claws
features.description:
At 6th level, choose one of your Claw options to be replaced by its Upgraded Claw option. You gain an additional Upgraded Claw option at 11th and 18th level. You can have two Upgraded Claw options at a time and switch as part of short or long rest.

Brutal Claws. Your claws deal one additional damage dice on a hit and gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This increases to +3 at 11th level.

Elemental Claws. You can choose to change the damage type of your claws to one of the following types: fire, cold, lightning, thunder, acid. You deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus on a hit. You can change the damage type during a long rest.

Absorbing Claws. On a hit, you can spend 1 CE to deal an additional 2d6 necrotic damage. You regain hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt. This increases to 3d6 at 11th level.

Pure Claws. Your claws ignore damage resistances and immunities. At 18th level, you deal maximum slashing damage against a creature without immunities or resistances to your damage.

Barbed Claws. Once per turn on a hit with your claws, you can spend 2 CE to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are bleeding and take 2d6 slashing damage at the start of their turn. This ends if the creature uses their action to staunch the wound or regains hit points.

features.name: Maximum: Zenith Claw Option
features.description: At 11th level, you have learned that your claws have even more room for growth and can destroy cursed tools to strengthen your claws. As an action while holding a cursed tool, you must spend CE depending on the cursed tool’s grade and then crush it in your claws to destroy it. You can then use its abilities and bonuses as a Zenith Claw option.  You can only have one Zenith Claw option active at a time and can swap options as part of a short or long rest.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of the Five Clawed Dragon
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you stab your claws through space targeting a creature within your domain with a guaranteed hit with your claws while ignoring distance and dealing critical damage (cannot roll for Black Flash). All of your Claw attacks are guaranteed hits within your domain and you can swap any number of your Claw options at the beginning of your turn.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of the Five Clawed Dragon
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you stab your claws through space targeting a creature within your domain with a guaranteed hit with your claws while ignoring distance and dealing critical damage (cannot roll for Black Flash). All of your Claw attacks are guaranteed hits within your domain and you can swap any number of your Claw options at the beginning of your turn.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Ngũ Trảo Long Điện

feats.name: Close Combat Specialist
feats.description: When you hit a creature with a claw attack while within 5 ft, you can attempt to grapple the creature as a bonus action. While grappling a creature, you can cause the creature to take your claw damage at the start of their turn.

feats.name: Drill Claws
feats.description:
You have learned to control the length of your claws. As a bonus action, you lengthen your claws and increase your melee reach with them by 5 ft for 1 minute or until you retract them as a bonus action.

Additionally, you learn to shoot out your claws as projectiles. Once per turn when you take the Attack action you can spend 1 CE to replace one of your attacks with a Drill Claw attack. You make a ranged Claw attack using your Strength, Dexterity, or Cursed Energy modifier against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit, this attack deals 4d8 piercing damage. This increases to 6d8 at 6th level, 8d8 at 11th level and 10d8 at 18th level. The range of this attack doubles at 6th level.

feats.name: Cutting Edge
feats.description: You have learned to sharpen your claws with cursed energy. You gain a +1 bonus to critical range with your Claws and can reroll and 1s or 2s when rolling damage for your Claws. The bonus to critical range increases to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 18th level.

descriptionEn: You possess powerful claws that can do anything.

name: Deadly Sentencing
description: Triệu hồi Thức thần Thẩm Phán khai mở phiên tòa công lý bất sát, điều tra tội trạng, tịch thu thuật thức và tuyên án tử hình kẻ phạm pháp.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Judge’s Gavel
features.description: At 1st level, once per long rest, you can summon a magical gavel for free once per long rest. Otherwise, you can spend 1 Cursed Energy to resummon it to your hand. This weapon has 3 forms: a base form a light hammer, maul, and pole hammer (Reach, d10).

features.name: Domain Expansion: Deadly Sentencing
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, your will lets you expand your domain for free once per long rest. Within the domain, no offensive action can be taken by either party. The target must make a contested Persuasion check against you to prove their innocence. You gain a piece of Evidence determined by a d20 roll. If you succeed, they suffer the punishment based on your Evidence for 1 minute and the domain ends.

Confiscation: The target loses either their innate technique or any magic items(items first). A creature without loses their CE.

Death Penalty: Your Judge’s Gavel is replaced by the Executioner’s Sword which instantly kills the accused on a hit.

Your DM may impose bonuses or penalties to Evidence rolls if fitting.

Your domain is Non-Lethal and instead of a guaranteed hit, gains the benefits of Peace Treaty as listed in Non-Lethal Domains. If you manage to convict a target with Confiscation or Death Penalty, you are not affected by Technique Burnout when your domain ends.

features.name: Gavel Improvements
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your mastery over Judge’s Gavel has improved. You can now re-summon your gavel as a free action. You can also spend 2 CE to increase the size of the gavel for 1 minute. The damage dice increase by one tier (d8<d10<d12<2d8). As an action, you can swing the enlarged gavel down on a 10 feet diameter square within 5 feet of you, forcing creatures within range to make a Dexterity saving throw or take twice your gavel’s damage.

features.name: Better Evidence
features.description: At 11th level, when rolling for evidence you can roll two dice and pick the one you find more beneficial. This becomes 3 at 18th level.

features.name: Unstopping Justice
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have reached the peak of your technique, showing off to others that only with skill you can truly win. You can now use Deadly Sentencing a number of times equal to your CE modifier without spending Cursed Energy each long rest.

tables: Innocent: The person is innocent but accused of a heinous crime which is easily excusable. You fail unless the defendant admits to it for some reason, if so a dependent punishment can  apply.
Guilty: The person is guilty of a small crime with minimum evidence, your roll is normal.Confiscation
Very Guilty: The person is guilty of a crime, and you have good evidence,  your roll is at advantage.Confiscation
Severely Guilty: The person is guilty of a severe crime, and you have decent evidence.Death Penalty
Unforgivably Guilty: The person is guilty beyond a doubt of an unforgivable sin, you instantly succeed.Death Penalty, Confiscation

feats.name: Tool Versatility
feats.description: Through a broadening of your understanding over your gavel. On top of your normal forms, you can turn your Gavel into any melee weapon. You also gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls using your Gavel. This increases to a +2 bonus at 6th level and +3 bonus at 11th level. The Executioner’s Sword does not gain this bonus.

feats.name: Weight of Judgment
feats.description: When you hit a creature with your Judge’s Gavel, you can spend 2 cursed energy to deal double the weapon’s damage die. Additionally, the creature must make a Strength saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

feats.name: Judgeman Release
feats.description: Your attunement with Deadly Sentencing has allowed you to summon Judgeman outside the domain. As a bonus action for 5 Cursed Energy, you summon Judgeman for 1 minute. Every time your opponent attacks you, they are penalized for assault and the opponent gains a -1 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws. If a creature targets you with a cursed technique that is not an attack roll, they gain a -1 penalty to their CE save DC. These penalties last until Judgeman disappears.

descriptionEn: The technique you have is made for one purpose, justice.

name: Disaster Flames
description: Thuật thức hỏa diễm của Chú linh Tai ương Jogo: phun trào dung nham, dựng cột lửa thiêu đốt và tạo ra những ống địa hỏa bùng nổ hủy diệt.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

You regain all spent cursed energy on a long rest.

features.name: Flames of Disaster
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you have learned the basics of fire manipulation, being able to launch a wave of flames from your hands as well as the ability to cast Control Flames. As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you unleash a 15 ft cone which forces people to make a Dexterity save. On a failure, they take 2d8 fire damage or half as much damage on a success. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried. Your damage dice increases to 3d8 at 5th level, 4d8 at 11th level, and 5d8 at 17th level.

features.name: Erupting Volcanoes
features.description: Beginning 3rd level, with a better understanding of the flames you possess, you can now create volcanoes. As an action for 2 Cursed Energy per volcano, you can create a number of volcanoes up to your Cursed Energy modifier within 60 ft of you, with each volcano occupying a 5 ft circle. As a bonus action, you can force every creature in a 30 ft long and 5 ft wide line originating from each volcano to make a Dexterity saving throw as the volcanoes erupt and disappear. On a failure, they take Xd10 fire damage equal to proficiency and become restrained by the magma for 1 minute. On success, they take half as much damage and are not restrained. The creature can make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of their turns, ending the condition early on success. Any area targeted by this feature becomes difficult terrain.

features.name: Ember Insects
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned how to create small insect shikigami from your body. As an action for 4 Cursed Energy, you can create a swarm of Ember Insects Swarm within 5 ft. These shikigami act immediately after your turn.

features.name: Maximum: Meteor
features.description: When you reach 11th level, you have learned to extract the maximum from Disaster Flames, creating your Maximum. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you can fly up 120 ft in the air until the end of your next turn and create a single gigantic meteor. In the following turn you float down 120 ft harmlessly. Every other creature in a 120 ft radius centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 10d4 bludgeoning damage + 10d6 fire damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
features.description: At 18th level, you have learned how to expand your domain to create a massive magma dimension. Your domain is a huge volcano-like dimension, which irradiates extreme heat. At initiative 20, all creatures other than you within your domain take 10d8 fire damage.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned how to expand your domain to create a massive magma dimension. Your domain is a huge volcano-like dimension, which irradiates extreme heat. At initiative 20, all creatures other than you within your domain take 10d8 fire damage.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Cái Quan Thiết Vi Sơn

feats.name: Pyrokinesis
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Flames of Disaster
feats.description:
Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your flames. You gain the one of the following (This feat can be taken more than once):

Resistance to Fire Damage and when you roll damage for a technique that deals fire damage, you can reroll any 1s, but must take the new result, even if the new roll is a 1.

Two spells below 5th level dealing fire damage. The ce cost equals the spell’s level.

feats.name: Shooting Star
feats.description: Through focus and thorough planning, you have gained further ideas. As a bonus action, you can spend Cursed Energy up to CE modifier to gain a 60 foot fly speed that lets you hover for a number of rounds equal to your CE modifier per Cursed Energy spent. For example, if you spend 2 CE with a modifier of +3, you can fly for 6 rounds.

feats.name: Hellscape
feats.description: Your presence can now be felt, all around. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you can cause all non magical objects and structures of your choice in a 100 ft radius to melt. As an action you can either control move the lava 10 ft in any direction (must have area to spread to) or control it directly to make two cursed energy attacks against a creature within 60 ft of the Hellscape area, dealing 10d8 fire damage on a hit. Each creature that enters the lava or starts their turn touching the lava must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. The lava cools after 10 minutes.

descriptionEn: You are born with a great power, with nigh-endless possibilities, fire manipulation, allowing you to burn down everything in your way.

name: Disaster Storms
description: Thao túng phong ba bão táp và lốc xoáy cuồng phong, xé nát chiến trường và nghiền nát đối thủ bằng những luồng gió áp suất cao.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Storms of Disaster
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you have learned the basics of storm generation and can launch a wave of cutting winds from your hands as well as the ability to cast Gust. As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you unleash a 15-foot cone which forces targets in range to make a Dexterity save. On a failure, they take 2d8 slashing or thunder (your choice) damage or half as much damage on a success. Your damage dice increases to 3d8 at 5th level, 4d8 at 11th level, and 5d8 at 17th level.

features.name: Lightning
features.description:
At 3rd level, as an action for 2 cursed energy you can make a ranged cursed energy attack roll against a creature you can see within 60 ft. On a hit, you deal 3d6 lightning damage.

If another creature is within 10 ft of the target, you can make another attack against them, dealing half as much damage on a hit. This damage increases to 4d6 at 6th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 18th level.

features.name: Storm Creation
features.description:
At 6th level, you can spend 3 cursed energy as an action to create a localized storm centered on you in a 10 ft radius for 1 minute. You can spend additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus to increase the radius by 5 ft per cursed energy.

This area is difficult terrain and creatures that start their turn within range must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are knocked prone. Ranged attacks targeting a creature within this storm are made at disadvantage. When you deal lightning or thunder damage to a creature within this storm, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll.

features.name: Maximum: Divine Storm Sovereign
features.description: At 11th level, you have learned to greatly amplify your storms. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you fill a 100 ft diameter sphere within 300 ft that you can see with a thick storm for 1 minute. The sphere is considered difficult terrain and heavily obscured to all creatures other than you. In addition to the effects of Storm Creation, all creatures other than you that start their turn within range take 3d10 lightning damage. When you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 cursed energy to replace one of your attacks with a use of Lightning, targeting a creature within the storm sphere with a ranged cursed energy attack even if you can’t see them.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Heavenly Throne of the Raging Tempest
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures take 6d12 lightning damage. Any Disaster Storms technique you use within your domain targets all creatures within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Heavenly Throne of the Raging Tempest
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures take 6d12 lightning damage. Any Disaster Storms technique you use within your domain targets all creatures within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Cuồng Phong Thiên Tọa

feats.name: Aerokinesis
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Storms of Disaster
feats.description:
Through training and understanding, you have found new applications for your storms. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

Suffocation. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see. They must make a Constitution saving throw, taking your proficiency bonus in d6s of necrotic damage and start suffocating on a failed save. While suffocating their movement is halved and their attack rolls have disadvantage. If you are more than 30 ft away or lose concentration, the target stops suffocating.

Resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

feats.name: Flying Nimbus
feats.description: While using Storm Creation, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. When you use Storms of Disaster while flying, you can immediately move up to 10 ft without spending movement or provoking opportunity attacks.

feats.name: Squall
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Divine Storm Sovereign
feats.description: While you are within a storm of your creation, your movement speed increases by 20 ft and you can teleport to a different point within the storm as a bonus action. Additionally when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can instead melt into storms and reconstitute your form at a different point within the storm at 1 hit point. Once you reconstitute your body using this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

descriptionEn: You are born with an amazing power, with many possibilities, storm creation to ride the breeze.

name: Disaster Tides
description: Thuật thức thủy triều của Chú linh Dagon: triệu hồi dòng nước lũ cuồn cuộn và bầy Thức thần thủy quái Tử Du Thực tấn công không ngừng nghỉ.

features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Tides of Disaster
features.description: Starting at 1st level you have the ability of hydrokinesis. You can cast the Shape Water cantrip. You can spend 1 Cursed Energy as an action to roll a ranged cursed energy attack roll against a target within 80 feet, dealing 2d8 cold damage on a hit. This feature’s damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (3d8), 11th level (4d8), and 18th level (5d8).

features.name: Domain Expansion: Horizon of Captivating Skhanda
features.description:
At 3rd level, due to being a prodigy, you have already learned to expand your domain as a calm beach. Your domain can be opened for free twice per long rest, otherwise it costs 20 Cursed Energy. If you don’t catch hostile creatures in your domain, it lasts indefinitely.

Death Swarm. While in your domain, you can use Death Swarm. As an action for X Cursed Energy, you can summon a number of sea Shikigami up to your Cursed Energy modifier within sight range. As part of being summoned, they make one guaranteed hit attack. At 18th level, all Death Swarm shikigami attacks are guaranteed. These shikigami can use swimming speed as a flying speed and you can have up to your Cursed Energy score at once in your domain.

features.name: Water Defensive Ring
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can make a ring of water that protects you from any incoming attack. As an action for 6 Cursed Energy, you can create a ring of water around you, granting you temporary hit points equal to your Cursed Energy modifier times 15. This can also be used as a reaction to incoming damage for 8 Cursed Energy. While the ring is active, you gain immunity to cold damage and resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage. You can only use this cursed technique again after the current ring is over.

features.name: Flash Flood
features.description:
Starting at 11th level, with your studies you have learned how to condense the water that you create and use it as a ball of mass destruction. As an action for 6 Cursed Energy, you can choose one target within 30 feet of you. Make a cursed energy attack roll against it. On a hit, it will take 10d8 cold damage and be pushed 80 feet away from you.

You can instead as an action for 8 Cursed Energy choose a point within 30 feet of you. All creatures within a 10-foot radius circle of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 8d12 cold damage or half as much damage on a success. If the area is enclosed it is filled with 10 feet of water.

features.name: Maximum: Tsunami
features.description: At 18th level, you have reached the pinnacle of manipulating your tides, creating a massive wave that destroys everything in its path. As an action for 8 Cursed Energy, you can cast the Tsunami spell as an 8th-level spell.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Horizon of Captivating Skhanda
domain.description:
At 3rd level, due to being a prodigy, you have already learned to expand your domain as a calm beach. Your domain can be opened for free twice per long rest, otherwise it costs 20 Cursed Energy. If you don’t catch hostile creatures in your domain, it lasts indefinitely.

Death Swarm. While in your domain, you can use Death Swarm. As an action for X Cursed Energy, you can summon a number of sea Shikigami up to your Cursed Energy modifier within sight range. As part of being summoned, they make one guaranteed hit attack. At 18th level, all Death Swarm shikigami attacks are guaranteed. These shikigami can use swimming speed as a flying speed and you can have up to your Cursed Energy score at once in your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Đãng Uẩn Bình Tuyến

feats.name: Hydrokinesis
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Tides of Disaster
feats.description:
Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your water. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

Piercing Water: You make a small water beam made to pierce through enemies. As an action for 2 CE, you make a cursed energy attack against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit, they take 2d10 cold damage + 2d6 piercing damage and are forced to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked prone and will receive the damage rolled one additional time as a vital organ is hit. On a success, they don't take additional damage and are not prone.

Two water spells below 5th level. The ce cost equals the spell’s level in Cursed Energy.

feats.name: Shoal
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Horizon of Captivating Skhanda
feats.description: You have increased your technique’s potential. You can now use Death Swarm outside your domain without the sure hit effect. You can have a number of shikigami equal to your Cursed Energy modifier when used in this way. The number of shikigami increases by your CE modifier at 6th level (2x), 11th level (3x), and 18th level (4x).

feats.name: Typhoon
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Water Defensive Ring
feats.description:
The scale and power of the water ring surrounding you has increased. For an extra 2 cursed energy, it also creates a 20 ft radius sphere of whirling storm that is centered on and follows you. Each creature other than you in the sphere when it appears or that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The sphere’s space is difficult terrain.

Until the technique ends, you can use a bonus action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from you toward a creature within 60 feet, making a cursed energy attack. You have advantage on the attack if the target is in the sphere. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 lightning damage. Creatures within 30 feet of the sphere have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear.

descriptionEn: You are born with a great power, with great possibilities, and astounding potential, water manipulation.

name: Disaster Verdure
description: Thuật thức thảo mộc của Chú linh Hanami: điều khiển rễ cây, mầm gai hút cạn Chú lực và tạo ra những đóa hoa ru ngủ làm suy yếu ý chí chiến đấu.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Forests of Disaster
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, Starting at 1st level, you have begun to understand the power of nature. You gain the ability to manipulate nature at will. You can cast Druidcraft at will and gain the following cursed techniques:

Binding Plants. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can choose one target within 30 feet of you trapped by plants. The target must make a Strength saving throw, on a failure it will be restrained. It can make a Strength check to break free from the plants, on a success they are free from the binds, on a failure they remain stuck.

Piercing Roots. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can raise a bunch of roots from the ground to strike a target. You force all creatures in a 50ft line to make a Dexterity saving throw, on a failure they take 1d12 piercing damage, on a success they take half as much damage. This damage increases to 2d12 at 5th level, 3d12 at 11th level, and to 4d12 at 18th level.

Wall of Roots. As a reaction for 1 Cursed Energy, you rise deep roots from the ground to defend yourself or allies from attacks. As a reaction to you or an ally being targeted by an attack, you spring forth a wall of roots 10 ft tall and 5ft wide. The wall has an amount of hit points equal to your Cursed Energy modifier times your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Root Bundle
features.description: At 3rd level, you have learned how to create small wooden balls to launch and pierce your opponents. As an action, you can create a number of two wooden balls, at the price of two cursed energy. The wooden balls will have a number of hit points equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, an AC of 10 + your CE modifier, and will keep floating around you. As a bonus action, you can send one or more of your balls towards a target within 30 feet of you. Make a cursed energy attack roll, on a hit the balls create large branches that pierce through its target, dealing 2d10 piercing damage. Right after they hit or miss the balls will disappear. You can also spend your bonus action to stand on one of the balls, gaining flying speed equal to half your walking speed while standing on them.

features.name: Flower Field
features.description: At 6th level, you can create a circle of flower petals that surrounds your opponents and removes their will to fight. As an action for 5 Cursed Energy, you create a 30 ft diameter circle in a point within 100 feet of yourself, all creatures within that circle must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they are charmed for 1 minute as their will to fight is completely drained and their mind enters a state of tranquility and happiness. While charmed in this way, they are unable to take any kind of actions that would help in the battle. A creature can repeat the save at the beginning of its turn or when they take damage. Any attacks against a charmed creature is made at advantage, and any saving throws other than saves against this feature the creature makes are at disadvantage.

features.name: Cursed Buds
features.description:
At 11th level, you have studied the true nature of your innate technique, creating a new type of plant that feeds on cursed energy. As an action for 6 Cursed Energy, you can create and launch a number of cursed buds equal to your CE modifier toward one or more targets within 30 feet. Make a cursed energy attack roll for each, on a hit they will attach to the creature. At the beginning of the creature's turns it loses an amount of Hit Points equal to your CE modifier and you steal 1 CE from the target. If an affected creature uses cursed energy while infected with a cursed bud, they lose hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. An affected creature can attempt a Strength check as an action against your CE save DC to remove the curse bud.

You can instead spend 10 Cursed Energy to create a Large tree within 10 feet that will launch one cursed bud at every hostile creature within 30 feet. The tree has an AC equal to your Cursed Energy save DC, hit points equal to your proficiency bonus times your level and lasts for 1 minute, launching one cursed bud at creatures within range at the beginning of your turn.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Ceremonial Sea of Light
features.description:
At 18th level, you have refined your technique to the absolute and learned to expand your domain.

At initiative 20, creatures within your domain fall under the effect of Flower Field and take 2d4 Necrotic damage. You gain half of the damage as temporary Cursed Energy that disappears once your domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Ceremonial Sea of Light
domain.description:
At 18th level, you have refined your technique to the absolute and learned to expand your domain.

At initiative 20, creatures within your domain fall under the effect of Flower Field and take 2d4 Necrotic damage. You gain half of the damage as temporary Cursed Energy that disappears once your domain ends.

feats.name: Chlorokinesis
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Forest of Disaster
feats.description:
Through training and understanding, you have found new applications to your roots. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times):

You can transform your root wall into any of the other forms as a bonus action.

Two spells below 5th level dealing with nature. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

feats.name: Bouquet
feats.description: You have found a way to do more with less. As an action, for 3 Cursed Energy you can cause the effects of Flower Field on a single creature you can see.

feats.name: Sapping Roots
feats.description: Your power has increased and been honed. As an action, for 5 Cursed Energy you give yourself the ability to drain Cursed Energy for 1 minute. On a hit with a melee attack or if you damage a creature with your Innate Technique, they lose 1 cursed energy which you gain.

descriptionEn: You are born with an amazing power, with many possibilities, plant manipulation, allowing you to protect those you care about.

name: Disaster Vermin
description: Triệu hồi bầy đàn côn trùng Chú linh Kurourushi mang theo dịch bệnh gặm nhấm da thịt và sử dụng Đao Thổ Hồn hủy hoại linh hồn.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Vermin of Disaster
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, as an action for 2 cursed energy you create an Insect Swarm in a space you can see within 5 ft of you. You can command the swarm as a bonus action, otherwise it takes the dodge action. Your Insect Swarm is made up of actual insects created from your cursed energy, not shikigami and you can only have one Insect Swarm summoned at a time.

features.name: Earthen Insect Trance
features.description:
At 3rd level, your mastery over insects has grown. You can have a number of Insect Swarms summoned equal to your proficiency bonus and can command any number of them as a bonus action.

Additionally, you gain access to an insect shikigami with a large pouch. As an action, you can summon up to 2 shikigami, spending 2 cursed energy per shikigami to summon them in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of you. You can command the Shikigami and Insect Swarm as part of the same bonus action.

features.name: Almighty Swarm
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned the power of the almighty swarm. As part of the bonus action to command your Insect Swarms, you can order different swarms to move closer and combine into one Vermin Swarm if within 5 ft of each other, becoming 1 size larger for every additional swarm. The Vermin Swarm gains the combined hit points and damage dice of all the swarms together. The individual Insect Swarms that make up the Vermin Swarms still count against your maximum number of controlled swarms.

features.name: Parthenogenesis
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned that your instinctual hunger is not without reason, but exists to stimulate the desire to multiply. As an action for 8 cursed energy, you create an insect egg affixed to a wall/ceiling.
