The cost to create the egg decreases by 1 CE per creature devoured by you or a swarm in the last 8 hours (min cost 1).

The egg has an AC equal to your Cursed Energy save DC and hit points equal to twice your level. If you die within an hour of creating the egg, it births an identical copy of you from it with current hit points equal to half your hit point maximum. Your cursed energy is passed on after your death, giving your new body your remaining cursed energy from when you died. You do not regain any gear you had beforehand.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Brood Cathedral of the Crawling God
features.description:
Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, up to 3 creatures of your choice within your domain take 6d10 necrotic damage as eggs fester and burst from their skin.

A creature that dies within your domain is devoured and becomes an Insect Swarm. This Insect Swarm does not count against your maximum number of controlled swarms until the domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Brood Cathedral of the Crawling God
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, up to 3 creatures of your choice within your domain take 6d10 necrotic damage as eggs fester and burst from their skin.

A creature that dies within your domain is devoured and becomes an Insect Swarm. This Insect Swarm does not count against your maximum number of controlled swarms until the domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Bò Trườn Thần Điện

feats.name: Reinforced Vermin
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Vermin of Disaster
feats.description: As part of the bonus action you take to command your Insect Swarms, you can spend 2 cursed energy to reinforce one of your Insect Swarms with cursed energy for 1 minute. While reinforced, their size category increases by one and they deal an additional 2 damage dice on a successful Bites attack (only +1 if bloodied). If you use multiple Reinforced Insect Swarms to form a Vermin Swarm, it only gains these benefits once.

feats.name: Vermin Techniques
feats.description:
You have learned to better control the combined actions of your Vermin Swarms, allowing you to learn the following ways to use your Swarms:

Insect Cloak. While you are occupying the same space as one of your Vermin Swarms, you can treat the Swarm’s hit points as temporary hit points for yourself.

Grasping Hand. You can spend 3 CE to replace one of your attacks on your turn with a grapple check through one of your Insect Swarms against a creature within 5 ft of the swarm. Instead of an Athletics check, you make a Cursed Energy (Arcana) check. The grapple gains a +1 bonus and +5 ft of range per size category above Medium the swarm is. On a success, the creature is grappled and can be pulled into the Insect Swarm.

Transport Via Bugs. As an action for 6 CE, you form a link between one Large or larger Vermin Swarm within 10 ft and connect it to another Large or larger Vermin Swarm at any distance. Before the end of your turn, you can spend 5 ft of movement to walk into the space of the Insect Swarm within 5 ft, reappearing within 5 ft of the destination Insect Swarm.

feats.name: Festering Life Sword
feats.description: As a bonus action for 6 CE, you transform a weapon you are holding. It loses all previous benefits and becomes the Special Grade Cursed Tool: Festering Life Sword. You can only have one weapon transformed this way at a time and this tool disappears when you finish a long rest or die.

descriptionEn: You are born with a disgusting power, with many disgusting possibilities.

name: Dragon Vein
description: Hấp thụ địa mạch phong thủy từ lòng đất, gia cố thân thể tựa đá tảng ngàn năm và phóng xuất địa chấn long mạch chấn động mặt đất.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Flow of the Dragon
features.description: At 1st level you have formed a powerful connection between you and the earth that keeps you grounded. While your feet are touching the ground, you add your proficiency bonus to melee damage rolls and have advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being forcefully moved.

features.name: Ley Line Command
features.description:
At 3rd level, as a bonus action for 3 CE while your feet are touching the ground, you form a Ley Line connection for 1 minute. You gain the following benefits:

You are immune to magical effects that would forcefully move or teleport you.

You reduce all damage taken by your proficiency bonus.

As a reaction to taking damage, you can spend 1 CE reinforce your body with cursed energy and gain resistance to the triggering damage type until the beginning of your next turn.

You lose these benefits while your feet are not touching the ground. At 11th level, you are immune to being grappled, restrained, or knocked prone while your Ley Line is active.

features.name: Earth Dragon Soul
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned to greater siphon the earth’s might. Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack while your Ley Line is active, you deal an additional 1d8 damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th level and 3d8 at 18th level. If you have not moved since the start of your last turn, you can do this extra damage twice per turn and your speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn. Additionally, when you gain resistance to a damage type with your Ley Line as a reaction, you can instead spend 3 CE to make the resistance last until the Ley Line ends.

features.name: World Anchor
features.description: At 11th level, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Cursed Energy modifier at the beginning of your turn while your feet are touching the ground. When you start your turn at half your hit point maximum or less while your Ley Line is active, you can spend 3 CE to gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Of Primordial World
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. Creatures within your domain cannot teleport or fly more than 10 ft off the ground, otherwise they find themselves getting crushed into the ground and take 5d10 force damage. A creature can take this damage once per turn. Additionally, you are always considered under Ley Line.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Of Primordial World
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. Creatures within your domain cannot teleport or fly more than 10 ft off the ground, otherwise they find themselves getting crushed into the ground and take 5d10 force damage. A creature can take this damage once per turn. Additionally, you are always considered under Ley Line.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nguyên Thủy Long Mạch

feats.name: Ley Line Extension
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Ley Line Command
feats.description: You have learned to extend the benefits of your connection with the earth to others. When you create a Ley Line you can give a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier the benefits of Flow of the Dragon while they are within 30 ft and touching the same ground as you.

feats.name: Ground Control
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Earth Dragon Soul
feats.description:
As an action for 3 CE, you stomp your foot and transform the ground within 30 ft in one of the following ways:

The ground becomes difficult terrain for all creatures other than yourself.

All creatures touching the ground other than you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they are knocked prone.

You grant creatures of your choice within range three quarters cover until the end of your next turn with earthen walls.

You move one creature touching the ground with a wave of earth up to 20 ft horizontally to a point within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the effect.

feats.name: Maximum: Dragon Pulse
feats.description:
As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) for 8 CE, you stomp your foot forcing all creatures within 120 ft that are touching the ground or at least 30 ft above the ground to make a Strength saving throw as you cause a massive shockwave that shatters the earth around you.

On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone and stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. Objects and structures automatically fail this saving throw and take maximum damage. For every creature that fails this save, you gain 5 temporary hit points.

descriptionEn: Your technique forms an unbreakable connection between you and the earth while your feet touch the ground.

name: Divergent Fist
description: Đòn đánh Chú lực trễ nhịp do Yuji Itadori vô tình sáng tạo: cú đấm thể lực chạm vào trước, dòng Chú lực bùng nổ theo sau tạo nên cú sốc kép hủy diệt.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Divergent Flow
features.description: At 1st level, once per turn, you can choose the damage of one of your unarmed strikes or weapon attacks. For 1 cursed energy, you cause the creature to take the attack’s damage in necrotic damage at the beginning of their turn. These strikes can’t be black flashes. If used with Cursed Strike, the additional necrotic damage doesn’t happen until the start of the creature’s turn.

features.name: Martial Prowess
features.description:
At 3rd level, your lack of an innate technique has caused you to make up for it with pure martial prowess. Once per round, you can use one of the following abilities:

Manji Kick: As part of an unarmed strike, drop your knees and rotate your body down to give a massive kick in your opponent's face. On a hit, the opponent must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier). On a failure, the creature will be stunned until the beginning of their next turn and take twice as much bludgeoning damage from the attack.

One-Two: As a bonus action, you land a One-Two combo. Make two unarmed attacks. The first damage roll doesn’t add your ability modifier, but on a hit the second gains advantage. The second attack adds three times your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll if both attacks hit.

Weave: You enter a defensive stance. You take the dodge action as a reaction instead.

features.name: Extreme Divergent Flow
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, you have gained better manipulation over your divergent fist attack. You can now use Divergent Flow on two separate attacks on your turn. When a creature is damaged by your Divergent Flow, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they become disoriented. Their next attack is made at disadvantage or creatures have advantage on the next saving throw forced by that creature.

features.name: Stance of the Sparks
features.description: Starting at 11th level, as an action, crouch, placing your fist over your palm. While in this stance, your movement is 0 and you can only make one attack on your following turn. This attack allows you to roll for a black flash, even if the attack is not a critical hit. You make all rolls for a black flash at advantage.

features.name: Chosen by the Sparks
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you no longer need to roll for a black flash after a critical hit or using Stance of Sparks, you always hit a black flash.

feats.name: Black Belt
feats.description:
Through much training, you gain the following martial options:

Takedown: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can try to grapple or shove the target as a bonus action.

Judo Throw: When you hit a grappled creature with a melee attack, you can grab the target and flip them on their back. If the target is Huge or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock them prone, and if they fail it by 5 or more they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

Flying Drop Kick: You can use an action to jump up and land a Flying Drop Kick. You target a creature within your jump distance with an unarmed attack (Calculator here). The target takes your unarmed damage, and is pushed back 30ft.

feats.name: Opportunistic Blow
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Extreme Divergent Flow
feats.description: You take full advantage of the unpredictability of your attacks. After a Divergent Flow is landed, you can force the enemy to make a Cursed Energy check against your DC. On a failure, you notice their distraction and can use your reaction to make an attack against them at advantage.

feats.name: Maximum: Soul Punch
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Chosen by the Sparks
feats.description: You have mastered your ability to target the soul. Before you make an unarmed strike, you can choose to spend 5 CE to cause any unarmed strikes you make on your turn to target the soul of a creature you attack. These attacks’ damage reduces the target’s maximum hit point (this does not include additional damage like Cursed Strike). This technique is a Reduced Output Effect that gives 1 level of Reduced Output when you deal damage to them with Soul Punch. This can cause a number of levels of Reduced Output up to your Cursed Energy modifier per target and no more. These levels of Reduced Output last until the target takes a short or long rest.

descriptionEn: A learnt technique using cursed energy manipulation created accidentally due to slow cursed energy, turns out to be effective.

name: Earth Manipulation
description: Điều khiển đất đá và địa hình tự do: dựng khiên thành lũy phòng ngự, tạo chông gai mặt đất hoặc đè bẹp kẻ thù dưới ngàn cân nham thạch.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Excavation
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your technique allows you to mold stone using your cursed energy. As an action for 1 cursed energy, you can shape the stone around yourself to make a 5-foot cubes of stone within 30 feet. You can choose to create multiple stone cubes up to your CE modifier (the cubes must be connected) as part of the same action, spending 1 CE for each cube. Each cube has an AC equal to your cursed energy DC and hit points equal to 5 times your CE modifier.

You can move a creature using these cubes. When creating the cubes in a creature’s area, you can attempt to move the target to a space within 5 feet. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, being pushed on a failure. If you create multiple stone cubes as part of the same action, a creature that fails the save is pushed to the end of the connected cubes.

features.name: Sculpted Earth
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain access to new ways to manipulate the earth around yourself.

Rock Blast. As an action, you can spend 1 CE to imbue your cursed energy into a rock and launch it at a target within 30 feet. You can use your CE modifier or Strength modifier for the attack and damage roll. On a hit, you deal 1d12 bludgeoning damage (you can spend 1 additional CE to instead deal necrotic damage). If you have the extra attack feature, you can replace one of your attacks this way.

Earthen Armor. As a bonus action, you can spend CE up to your proficiency bonus to protect yourself with earth. For 1 minute, you gain a bonus to your AC equal to the cursed energy spent.

Tremor. As an action, you can spend 3 cursed energy to strike the ground. Creatures in a 20-foot radius around yourself must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d10 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not prone. Structures automatically fail and take maximum damage. This increases to 4d10 at 6th level, 5d10 at 11th level, and 6d10 at 18th level.

features.name: Wall of Stone
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to create large scale constructs. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you make a wall of stone. This wall is made of ten 10 foot by 10 foot panels that are 1 inch thick. Each panel must be touching at least one other panel. The wall has an AC equal to your cursed energy DC and a number of hit points equal to 10 times your CE modifier.

You can spend 1 CE as a bonus action to move connected panels within 60 feet of you up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice that is in contact with the ground. If this movement would move a creature, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or be pushed by the wall.

features.name: Stone Arms
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned a new way to use the stone you manipulate. You are now able to create two big arms that can catch a target. As an action for 5 cursed energy, you can force a target within 60 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are wedged between the arms taking 6d12 bludgeoning damage, and are restrained, becoming stuck between the hands until the start of your next turn. On a success, they are not restrained and take half damage.

You can also choose to keep the hands active by spending 1 CE at the start of your turns. Every turn you have it active you can use an action to crush a creature restrained by your hands, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. If they fail they take another 4d12 bludgeoning damage or half as much on a success. A creature can use their action to make an Athletics or Acrobatics check against your Cursed Energy DC, escaping on a success. While maintaining your stone arms, they have AC 18 and HP equal to your maximum hit points and you must maintain concentration.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Trichiliocosm
features.description:
At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take 6d12 bludgeoning damage and are restrained by shifting stone until the start of their next turn.

You can spend an action to change the environment of your domain.

You can create a large 20 ft radius, 1d10 x 10 feet deep chasm causing creatures to fall and take falling damage.

You can create a 100 ft tall tower of stone (as if casting Galdur’s Tower with 10 stories).

You can create 100 ft of difficult terrain in an area you can see. A creature that moves through this area takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet moved.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Trichiliocosm
domain.description:
At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take 6d12 bludgeoning damage and are restrained by shifting stone until the start of their next turn.

You can spend an action to change the environment of your domain.

You can create a large 20 ft radius, 1d10 x 10 feet deep chasm causing creatures to fall and take falling damage.

You can create a 100 ft tall tower of stone (as if casting Galdur’s Tower with 10 stories).

You can create 100 ft of difficult terrain in an area you can see. A creature that moves through this area takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet moved.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tam Thiên Đại Thiên Thế Giới

feats.name: Density Manipulation
feats.description: You have learned to increase the density of your stone creations. The amount of hit points each cube created by your Excavation now equals 10 times your CE modifier. Stone constructs created by your other Innate Technique features gain an additional 10 hit points.

feats.name: Rock Burst
feats.description: As a reaction, you can cause one of your stone constructs within 60 feet of you to explode. Any creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 1d12 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone. You can spend CE up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) as part of this reaction to heighten the explosion and deal an additional 1d12 bludgeoning damage per CE and cause creatures in range to take half as much damage on a success.

feats.name: Arms of the Giant
feats.description: You are no longer required to maintain concentration to maintain your Stone Arms. Additionally, while spending 1 CE each turn to maintain your hands, you are able to control your Stone Arms as if casting the spell Bigby’s Hand. A creature that gains the restrained condition from your Stone Arms has their movement speed halved for 1 minute or until they regain hit points.

descriptionEn: A simple yet powerful technique to mold rock as you please.

name: Eight Heads
description: Triệu hồi Thức thần đại xà Bát Đầu Xà (Yamata no Orochi) với tám chiếc đầu khổng lồ nuốt chửng kẻ thù và phun nọc độc tàn phá.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Eight Lives
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you have the ability to come back to life after you die, up to 8 times. When you are reduced to 0 hit points or die outright, you can spend 1 CE to come back to life at half your hitpoint maximum and harmful conditions other than exhaustion are removed. You have 8 lives and can use a life this way three times per long rest. This increases to four at 3rd level and eight at 6th level.  You regain one expended life after eight days.

features.name: Collective Will
features.description: At 3rd level, when you make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma  ability check or saving throw, you can spend 1 cursed energy to reroll and must use the new roll. You can use this feature up to 8 times per long rest.

features.name: Fangs of Orochi
features.description:
At 6th level, as an action you can spend up to 8 cursed energy to summon an equal number of fangs from the jaws of Yamata no Orochi as shikigami. They appear in unoccupied spaces of your choice within 10 ft. You can have up to 8 summoned at a time.

You can command any Fangs you have summoned as a bonus action. These Fangs disappear if you become unconscious and if destroyed cannot be resummoned for 1 minute. The Fangs hit points increase to 20 at 11th level.

features.name: Maximum: Sacrifice
features.description:
At 11th level, when you have at least 3 Fangs of Orochi summoned, you can command them as an action for 6 cursed energy to move up to 40 ft, encircle a creature, and embed themselves into the ground in an unoccupied area. A barrier forms, connecting the Fangs like a cylinder resembling a trigram and trapping any within.

The barrier has a height of 20 ft and can have a maximum diameter of 15 ft. It has 20 AC and hit points equal to the hit points of the Fangs of Orochi used to create it. A trapped creature makes a cursed energy save at the start of their turns, taking 10d4 necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save.

If this damage reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the creature dies and you regain one life. Once you regain a life in this way, you cannot for 1 week.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Ama ga Fuchi
features.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have constructed a domain filled with your technique. The domain takes the form of grassy wetlands. At initiative 20, Yamata no Orochi forms from the earth. The shikigami does not take actions and does not have a turn in initiative. This is a false incarnation that only exists within your domain, containing the shackled mind of the original Yamata no Orochi.

On initiative 20 after Yamata no Orochi has formed, roll a 1d8. That number of creatures of your choice within the domain each suffer its bite. The shikigami disappears when your domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Ama ga Fuchi
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have constructed a domain filled with your technique. The domain takes the form of grassy wetlands. At initiative 20, Yamata no Orochi forms from the earth. The shikigami does not take actions and does not have a turn in initiative. This is a false incarnation that only exists within your domain, containing the shackled mind of the original Yamata no Orochi.

On initiative 20 after Yamata no Orochi has formed, roll a 1d8. That number of creatures of your choice within the domain each suffer its bite. The shikigami disappears when your domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thiên Chi Uyên

feats.name: Snake Scales
feats.description: As an action for 4 cursed energy, you summon the scales of Yamata no Orochi to protect your flesh. Your AC cannot be lower than 14 + your proficiency bonus and you become resistant to poison and slashing damage for 1 hour.

feats.name: Blessing of the Hydra
feats.description: When you use Eight Lives to return to life, you can gain resistance to one damage type that reduced you to 0 hit points or immunity to one harmful condition you had. This benefit lasts for 1 hour.

feats.name: Fang Versatility
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Fangs of Orochi
feats.description:
You have trained your technique to be more versatile in combat. You can wield Fangs or Orochi as a Dagger or Shortsword. On a hit with this weapon, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes an additional 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. Your Fang Shikigami gain the following improvements:

The AC of your Fangs becomes 15 + your proficiency bonus.

Your Fangs deal an additional 2d4 poison damage on a hit.

feats.name: Incarnation
feats.description:
When you use Sacrifice and kill a humanoid, instead of gaining a life, you can summon a Head of Orochi as a shikigami under your control. You can control or unsummon the head as a bonus action or summon it as an action for 3 CE later, being stored somewhere on your body as a tattoo of the head of a snake. This replaces one of your Fangs of Orochi shikigami you can have active at once.

Once you have used Sacrifice to gain all eight heads, the tattoos come together to form a knot on your chest. As a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement), you can complete the ritual and incarnate the Special Grade Cursed Spirit: Yamata no Orochi as a shikigami in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of you.

descriptionEn: One of your ancestors devoured Yamata no Orochi, the Eight Headed Serpent, creating a hereditary technique with its power.

name: Esoteric Art
description: Họa sĩ chú thuật vẽ nên những bức tranh tà thuật mang lại hiệu ứng nguyền rủa hoặc biến đổi cảnh quan thực tế theo nét cọ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Cursed Painting
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can spend 1 cursed energy to create a painting of cursed ink under a Medium or smaller creature within 30 ft, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are sucked into the painting. The painting takes the form of an empty 30 ft radius cube subspace of greyscale. You can change the color or create simple illustrations within the subspace as an action. You can enter, exit, place, or remove an item from the subspace of your paintings as a free action once per turn without spending cursed energy. Your subspace becomes 120 ft at 3rd level, 600 ft at 6th, and 1200 ft at 11th level.

At the beginning of your turn, you must spend 1 CE to keep any creatures (including yourself) within a painting. Otherwise, they reappear at the point they disappeared.

You can use a binding vow to remove the cost at the beginning of your turn by placing a method of escape. This creates an Exit Painting in a random, but accessible area within the subspace that allows a creature to exit the painting, reappearing in the space they disappeared.

You can have a number of subspaces equal to your CE modifier, but if you have creatures in different paintings, you must spend 1 cursed energy for each subspace at the start of your turn. This increases to twice your CE modifier of paintings at 11th level.

Alternatively, you can paint a physical painting and imbue it with up to 3 cursed energy during its creation, spending 1 hour painting per cursed energy. A creature that gets within 5 ft and can see the painting must make a Dexterity saving throw, getting sucked into the painting on a failed save. A painting imbued this way keeps a creature trapped for 3 rounds. The painting’s subspace can only be accessed through the physical painting.

At 3rd level, you can spend additional cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to imbue the painting with more power and increase the painting time. This increases to twice your CE modifier at 11th level. This allows the painting to keep an unwilling creature trapped for an additional round for every cursed energy spent. You can also use this painting to store items, but it also counts against the number of paintings you can have at once.

At 6th level, you can instead cause the painting to spend the imbued cursed energy to use Ink Wave against a creature that moves within 5 ft of it.

features.name: Impasto Canvas
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain the ability to change the content of one of your paintings in one the following ways while within your painting:

Ink Shikigami. As an action, you can spend up to your Cursed Energy modifier to create one Ink Wolf for each cursed energy spent. Each wolf appears in an unoccupied space you can see anywhere within your painting and acts on your initiative. The wolves obey your verbal commands (no action required).

Exit Shift. You move the Exit Painting up to 80 ft as an action.

Difficult Terrain. As an action, you create a 15 ft radius area of difficult terrain anywhere within your painting. The terrain lasts until the painting ends or until you use this feature again.

Structure Generation. As an action, you create one structure from cursed ink anywhere within your painting. The structure must fit entirely within a 30 ft cube and can be any ordinary structure you choose, such as walls, platforms, towers, bridges, or buildings.

The structure’s AC equals your CE save DC and each 5 ft by 5 ft section has hit points equal to 5 x your proficiency bonus.

If reduced to 0 hit points, it dissolves into ink and disappears. Any creatures standing on the structure when it is destroyed fall or are affected at the DM’s discretion. You can create, destroy, or replace a structure while within the painting.

Trap Creation. As an action, you create one trap of your choice in an unoccupied 5 ft square anywhere within your painting. The trap lasts until triggered or until the painting ends. A creature can detect a trap with an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check against your Cursed Energy save DC. All traps use your CE save DC.:

Pit Trap. When a creature enters the trapped space, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall 20 feet into the pit, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage and falling prone.

Spike Trap. When a creature enters the trapped space, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall 10 feet into the pit, taking 2d10 piercing damage and falling prone.

Snare Trap. When a creature enters the trapped space, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become restrained. A creature can use its action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, freeing the target on a success.

Rolling Stone Trap. When triggered, an ink-formed boulder rolls in a 5 ft wide 30 ft line from the trap’s space in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d10 bludgeoning damage and knocked prone on a fail, or half as much damage and not prone on a success.

features.name: Sgraffito
features.description: At 6th level, you have improved your technique. You can now manipulate your painting as a bonus action and gain the following improvements and options:

features.name: Ink Shikigami. You can summon new types of shikigami:
features.description:
Greater Ink Wolf (2 CE)

Ink Crow (3 CE)

Exit Shift. You cause the location of the Exit Painting to a new random accessible location in the subspace.

Difficult Terrain. You can now create a 30 ft radius area of difficult terrain anywhere within your painting.

Structure Generation. Each 5 ft by 5 ft section of a structure you create now has hit points equal to 10 x your proficiency bonus.

Trap Creation. Your traps now deal an additional 2 damage dice. This increases to an additional 4 damage dice at 11th level.

Ink Wave. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you create a 30 ft cone originating from you or an Ink Shikigami. A creature within the cone must make a Constitution saving throw, taking your proficiency bonus in d6s of necrotic damage and be blinded until the end of their next turn on a failed save. (This can also be used outside your subspace)

Larger Frames. You can now use Cursed Painting on Large or smaller creatures. This increases to Huge at 11th level.

features.name: Panoramic Composition
features.cost: cursed energy up to twice your CE modifier
features.description: At 11th level, as an action, you can spend cursed energy up to twice your CE modifier, forcing that number of creatures within 60 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are sucked into your cursed paintings.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Magnum Opus
features.description: At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. The inside of your domain counts as your painting’s subspace, expanding to the same size as your subspace and following the same rules, except your Ink Shikigami and Traps are imbued with your guaranteed hit. At initiative 20, two different Impasto Canvas effects of your choice happen (if you choose Ink Shikigami, they still cost Cursed Energy).

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Magnum Opus
domain.description: At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. The inside of your domain counts as your painting’s subspace, expanding to the same size as your subspace and following the same rules, except your Ink Shikigami and Traps are imbued with your guaranteed hit. At initiative 20, two different Impasto Canvas effects of your choice happen (if you choose Ink Shikigami, they still cost Cursed Energy).
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Kiệt Tác Vĩ Đại

feats.name: Diptych
feats.description: You have learned to fold, expand, and even connect the subspaces of your paintings. When you enter one of your painting subspaces, you can spend 4 cursed energy to exit from one of your physical paintings. Additionally, the number of paintings you can have at once increases by your proficiency bonus and the area of your subspace doubles.

feats.name: Air Brush
feats.description:
As a reaction to an attack roll, you can spend 1 Cursed Energy to add +4 to your AC against the attack by forming a cursed painting, storing the attack in your subspace on a miss. If you have taken the dodge action, you can use this reaction on allies within 5 feet.

Once per turn when you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to replace one of your attacks on your turn with an attack from a Giant Ink Shikigami. Make a melee cursed energy attack against a creature you can see within 30 ft. You create a painting of cursed energy and one of your Ink Shikigami attacks from the painting, dealing 3d10 + your CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit. This increases to 4d10 at 6th level and 5d10 at 11th level.

feats.name: Gradient
feats.description:
As an action for 5 cursed energy, you create a subspace Gradient that fills a 30 ft cube centered on you for 1 minute. You can use your innate technique features within this subspace, but they cannot extend beyond it and disappear once the technique ends. The subspace is stationary and does not move with you. At 11th level, you can increase the size of the cube to 60 ft.

Alternatively, instead of using your innate technique features within Gradient, you can instead enhance your spatial awareness. You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within the subspace. While Gradient is active, you can use your reaction to add your CE modifier to an attack roll, saving throw, or AC against one attack roll. While using Gradient this way, you cannot use Impasto Canvas.

descriptionEn: You were born with the ability to create cursed paintings leading to unique subspaces.

name: Explosive Flesh
description: Tách rời các bộ phận cơ thể (răng, mắt, móng tay) nạp đầy Chú lực để biến chúng thành những quả bom hẹn giờ nổ tung bất ngờ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Self-Destruction
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can make any part of you a deadly bomb. You spend cursed energy to remove and throw your body parts. You remove the part as described below. Throwing takes an action:

After using a limb or body part in an explosion, it will be considered removed (Con mod is treated as min of 1).

The X is your CE modifier. Damage from this technique deals twice as much damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Faster Throws
features.description: At 3rd level, you have gained more expertise over your technique, and can now throw your bombs faster. You can now throw a body part as an action or bonus action.

features.name: Guerilla Tactics
features.description: At 6th level, your practice with your explosions allowed you to make them in an instant. You can now instantly explode one of your body parts for the normal cost, as a reaction to receiving or hitting a melee attack roll as the body part explodes on your body. All creatures make the Dexterity saving throw with disadvantage unless their passive perception is higher than your cursed energy DC.

features.name: Stronger Explosions
features.description:
At 11th level, with the extensive use of your technique, your explosions became deadlier. When a creature fails the saving throw of your explosions, they gain the deafened condition for 1 minute. They can make a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of their turns, ending the condition early on a success. Also, your explosions deal three times as much damage to objects and structures and their explosion range is increased by 5ft.

At 18th level, the creature also gains the blinded condition.

features.name: Domain Expansion: True Art
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. You can detonate any of your body parts for no CE cost. At initiative 20, you can choose a limb (arm or leg) from a creature inside your domain and detonate it.

tables: You throw the body part at a point within 120ft. Creatures within 5 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd6 force damage. On a success, they take half.
2 CE + Con mod*half your level HP
You throw the body part at a point within 100ft. Creatures within 10 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd8 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success they take half.
You throw the body part at a point within 80ft. Creatures within 15 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd10 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half.
You throw the body part at a point within 60ft. Creatures within 20 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd12 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: True Art
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. You can detonate any of your body parts for no CE cost. At initiative 20, you can choose a limb (arm or leg) from a creature inside your domain and detonate it.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nghệ Thuật Đích Thực

feats.name: Reduced Harm
feats.description:
You have learned to minimize the damage you take when using your technique. You decrease the hit point loss from using any part of your body as an explosive by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hit point).

At 6th level, this reduction increases to an amount equal to twice your Constitution modifier plus your level (minimum 1 hit point).

feats.name: Elemental Bomb
feats.description: You have learned how to create different types of explosions, making them create different effects. You can spend additional cursed energy equal to the energy spent in using the bomb to make them an elemental bomb. The elemental bomb will deal additional dice of fire, cold or lightning damage, equal to the original bombs' damage.

feats.name: Maximum: Bites the Dust
feats.description: Your explosive prowess has reached new heights, allowing you to trigger massive blasts from your removed body parts. As an action, you can spend cursed energy equal to the body part to trigger a delayed explosion. Choose a body part you have removed within 30 ft. It detonates at the end of your next turn, forcing all creatures within 20 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, they take Xd12 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. You can spend additional cursed energy up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to increase the damage by an additional Xd12 for every cursed energy spent. The X is your Cursed Energy modifier.

descriptionEn: You can make your body into a deadly bomb.

name: Fa Jin
description: Tích lũy động năng qua các chuyển động lặp lại rồi giải phóng một đòn phát kình xuyên phá cực đại làm vỡ vụn nội tạng đối thủ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + your proficiency bonus.

Store and Release Starting at 1st level, you can store and release energy. When you miss with a melee attack, you gain a Jin charge. You can have a number of Jin charges equal to your proficiency bonus + your level.You can spend a Jin charge or 1 Cursed Energy to either gain a +2 to a melee or cursed energy attack roll or deal an additional damage die for each charge spent.

You must declare how many Jin charges you are using before making an attack or using a technique and can use a number of Jin charges equal to your proficiency bonus at once. On a miss, you waste the Jin charges. You lose all unused Jin charges on a long rest.Instantaneous Movement

At 3rd level, you gain more flexibility when using your Fa Jin. At the beginning of your turn, you can forgo your movement or spend 1 cursed energy to gain a Jin charge. You can now also use a Jin charge to increase your movement speed by 10 feet and triple your jump distance until the end of your turn or to instantly move 10 feet per charge in any direction as a reaction without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Fist of Explosive Power
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned to use your cursed energy to amplify your Fa Jin. You can spend 3 cursed energy as an action to launch a blast of compressed air using Jin charges, which have different effects based on the weapon you use.

features.name: Maximize Potential Energy
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned not only how to avoid wasting your stored energy, but how to use it more effectively, granting you the following benefits:

When you spend Jin charges to enhance an attack and miss, you can keep a number of Jin charges up to your Cursed Energy modifier instead of losing the charges.

When you spend at least 3 Jin charges for Explosive Power, you can increase the range of your compressed air blast by 30 feet, which now deals thunder damage.

When you spend ce to gain a Jin charge, you now gain 2 Jin charges for every ce spent.

As an action while touching a creature, you can give them a number of your Jin charges up to your CE modifier.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of Divine Bagua
features.description: At 18th level, you have learned your domain. Within your domain, you have unlimited Jin charges and at initiative 20, all creatures within your domain gain a permanent negative Jin charge, causing them to deal 1d6 less damage on their next attack or technique for each charge. These charges disappear when your domain ends.

tables: 15 feet cone, Con save, 2D6 bludgeoning damage per Jin charge, knocked prone on a failed save
30 feet line, Dex save, 2D10 slashing damage per Jin charge

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of Divine Bagua
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned your domain. Within your domain, you have unlimited Jin charges and at initiative 20, all creatures within your domain gain a permanent negative Jin charge, causing them to deal 1d6 less damage on their next attack or technique for each charge. These charges disappear when your domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thần Thánh Bát Quái Điện

feats.name: Kinetic AbsorptionPrerequisite: Must have Store and Release
feats.description:
As a reaction to bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, you can spend 1 cursed energy to reduce the incoming damage by your Cursed Energy score and gain 1 Jin Charge. You cannot reduce the damage of other damage types.

Instantaneous ChargePrerequisite: Must have Instantaneous Movement

When you use at least 3 Jin charges for Instantaneous Movement, you gain advantage on your next melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal additional thunder damage equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

Maximum: Destructive ReleasePrerequisite: Must have Maximize Potential

You have learned the method to magnify your destructive power. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 CE before using Fist of Explosive Power. You deal three damage die per Jin charge spent and all targets gain a -3 to their saving throw, being launched back 10 feet on a failed save, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage if they hit an object, creature or structure.

descriptionEn: You can store and release kinetic energy using your cursed technique.

name: Faceless God
description: Triệu hồi thần lực hư ảo không mặt, gieo rắc sự tha hóa tâm linh và điên loạn kinh hoàng vào tâm trí bất kỳ ai dám nhìn thẳng.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Madness Inducement
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, just looking at you slowly leads to mental corruption. As an action for 3 cursed energy, you can activate your technique for 1 minute causing madness to spread to everyone around you. If a creature ends their turn within 60 ft of you and can see you, it gains a 5% increase to Mental Corruption. You can choose a number of creatures to be immune to this effect when you activate the technique.

Paranoia and Madness. When a creature reaches 25% Mental Corruption, they begin seeing all creatures as faceless monsters and must roll a d10 at the start of their turn. On a roll of 1-2, the target spends their action attacking the closest creature. A creature can only have up to 25% Mental Corruption at a time.

Madness Removal. Mental Corruption persists even after your technique has been deactivated. A creature without line of sight to you can make a Wisdom saving throw to reduce Mental Corruption by 5% and repeat the save at the beginning of their turn. If a creature has more than 25% corruption, they cannot reduce corruption below 25% as the madness becomes rooted more deeply within their mind. As part of a long rest, they can attempt to make a Wisdom saving throw to cleanse their mind. On a success, they can begin making saves to reduce madness as normal, down to the next 25% segment before they must complete another long rest to repeat the save and continue to process.

features.name: Madness Enhancement
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn to directly inject madness into a creature. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack while your technique is active, they gain a 5% increase to Mental Corruption. You can spend additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus on a hit to increase Mental Corruption by 5% per cursed energy spent.

features.name: Obsession and Insanity
features.description: At 6th level, the percent of Mental Corruption you can force on a creature increases to 50% and increases by 25% again at 11th level and 18th level. The die size for Paranoia and Madness decreases with every 25% increase and at 100% it happens automatically. At 90% you fall further into madness and must make a Wisdom saving throw at the beginning of your turn, moving in a random direction on a failed save.

features.name: Maximum: Rumination
features.description:
At 11th level, you can spend 6 cursed energy as an action to target a creature within 30 feet that you can see and is currently afflicted by your madness. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d10 psychic damage per 10% Mental Corruption they currently have.

A creature with more than 50% Mental Corruption makes this save with disadvantage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Theia Mania
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain gains 5% Mental Corruption. Creatures gain a -1 penalty to all rolls for every 10% Mental Corruption they have while within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Theia Mania
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain gains 5% Mental Corruption. Creatures gain a -1 penalty to all rolls for every 10% Mental Corruption they have while within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thần Cuồng Điên Loạn

feats.name: Veil of the Faceless God
feats.description: As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, your face is adorned with a veil for 1 minute. A creature with at least 10% corruption that can see you must make an Intelligence saving throw at the beginning of their turn. On a failed save, they gain a -1 to all rolls for every 10% corruption they have until the start of their next turn (does not stack with Theia Mania). An affected creature repeats the save at the start of their turn, ending the effect on a success and automatically succeeds the save if it cannot see you.

feats.name: Hands of Madness
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Obsession and Insanity
feats.description:
As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, you summon either the Left Hand or Right Hand for 10 minutes. Attacks made with a Hand of Madness increases Mental Corruption by 5% once per turn, even when your technique is not activated. You can only have one hand active at a time. At 11th level, you can spend 6 CE as a bonus action to use both.

Right Hand. The Right Hand of Madness covers your right hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see a horrid arm of rotting flesh, wriggling tendrils, or similarly terrifying to them. An unarmed strike made with your right hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d12 psychic damage on a hit. Attacks with the right hand have advantage on targets with 50% or more corruption.

Left Hand. The Left Hand of Madness covers your left hand. You and creatures with Mental Corruption see your normal arm, but it invokes an inexplicable sense of terror within them. An unarmed strike made with your left hand can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls and deals 1d6 psychic damage on a hit. On a hit, a creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or gain the frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

feats.name: True Mania
feats.description: A creature gains a temporary level of exhaustion while at 50% corruption or two levels of exhaustion at 100%.

descriptionEn: Just a glance in your direction slowly leads to mental corruption.

name: Fate
description: Thao túng bánh xe định mệnh: chuyển hướng vận rủi sang kẻ thù và kéo những xác suất may mắn bất khả thi về phía bản thân trong giao tranh.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Fate Manipulation
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can weave together threads of fate. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you bind two creatures within 30 ft of you with an invisible red thread for 1 minute. If a Fate requires Touch, you must touch both targets, but not necessarily at the same time. You choose a Fate, +1 Fate per 2 additional CE, up to your proficiency bonus that affects both while within 30 ft of each other:

An effect that would damage the soul is capable of cutting your thread and removing your technique’s effects. Additionally, you cannot manipulate the fate of a creature that is completely lacking cursed energy (such as via Heavenly Restriction).

features.name: Cursed Eyes of Fate
features.description:
At 3rd level, you learn that fate is not simple. It is what makes up all connections between people and everything else. As a bonus action for 1 CE, when you look at a creature you can focus until you see the red threads of fate that connect the souls of all living creatures. As part of this bonus action, you can tell who the threads connect to if they are within sight, as well as the type of connection. This can range from familial connections, admiration, or feelings of love.

Alternatively, you can instead read the target’s personal thread of fate to learn one of the following:

The target’s damage resistances, immunities, or vulnerabilities.

The target’s CR or Level.

The target’s remaining hit points.

The target’s AC or an Ability modifier.

The target’s current emotions.

features.name: Strong Destiny
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to strengthen your threads of fate with cursed energy. When you apply a fate to creatures, you can increase the duration by 1 minute per additional cursed energy spent. As a reaction to the target’s turn starting for 2 CE, you can cause a creature under one of your Fates to take Xd8 bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage (your choice) equaling your proficiency bonus as random unlucky phenomena assaults them. Additionally, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

At 11th level, your Fate Manipulation now lasts for 1 hour and you can increase the duration by 1 hour per additional cursed energy spent.

features.name: Karmic Entanglement
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned to permanently entangle souls in the web of fate. Over an uninterrupted period of 1 week, you permanently intertwine the fates of two or more creatures together. The creatures become destined to meet by fate. You can attach this to an incredibly unique part of one of the creatures, such as Inherited Technique, Special Trait, or unique Constitution (Star Plasma Vessel) to cause it to be passed down even after the targets’ deaths. You can have a number of creatures with permanently intertwined fate equal to your proficiency bonus at once (including yourself).

Immortality. As a side effect of your technique, your fate has become set. You cannot die of old age, but still grow older. Every 500 years you must assimilate with a genetically similar human to reset your body and appearance. Failure to meet this causes you to begin to evolve beyond humanity, changing your race to Cursed Spirit.

Fate Control. As an action for 8 CE, you manifest fate for 1 minute. While active, you gain 3 fate points at the beginning of your turns. You can spend one fate point to add a -5 penalty to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by a creature you can see within 30 ft (cannot stack). Unused fate points disappear at the start of your turn. While active, damage dice of Strong Destiny is doubled.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Road of Karma
features.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you select a creature within your domain as your Destined Foe. While your Destined Foe is within your domain, all your attacks against them are imbued with your guaranteed hit. You can switch your Destined Foe to another creature at initiative 20.

Your innate technique features count your domain as being within range and you can ignore the Touch Requirement of Fates.

tables: The targets gain a +2 bonus to AC.
The creatures both have either advantage or disadvantage on attacks against each other.
If one target rolls a 20 or 1 on their turn, the other’s next roll will be the opposite.
If targets start their turn within 30 ft of each other, they are pulled 10 ft closer. If this brings them within 5 ft, they become tangled and prone (Str save to pull away).
Choose a damage resistance, immunity, vulnerability or condition immunity of a target. Both targets share that strength/weakness.
When one of the linked targets takes damage, they take half as much damage and the linked creature takes the other half.
The targets both have either advantage or disadvantage on saves against each other.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Road of Karma
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you select a creature within your domain as your Destined Foe. While your Destined Foe is within your domain, all your attacks against them are imbued with your guaranteed hit. You can switch your Destined Foe to another creature at initiative 20.

Your innate technique features count your domain as being within range and you can ignore the Touch Requirement of Fates.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nghiệp Quả Chi Lộ

feats.name: Destined One
feats.description: You or the DM chooses one creature you touch as your Destined One. You can always tell where your Destined One is as the thread of Fate always guides your hand. While within 30 ft of your Destined One, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, once per round you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC against an attack roll made against you or to a saving throw you make, potentially changing the outcome. You cannot change the creature chosen as your Destined One unless they die.

feats.name: Web of Fate
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Eyes of Fate
feats.description: When you cast a Fate onto targets, you can instead target a number of creatures equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus within range. If the Fate requires Touch, you must touch all targets of the technique.

feats.name: Maximum: Shears of Three Fates
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Road of Karma
feats.description: As an action for 15 cursed energy, you form a scissor with your fingers and snip one of the threads of fate of a creature you can see within 5 ft of you. At the start of each of the target’s turns, they must make a Death saving throw. This roll cannot have advantage or disadvantage or any bonuses or penalties. The target gains 1 level of exhaustion for every failed death save. If the target fails 3 death saves, they fall to 0 hit points and die. They are unable to be revived by cursed techniques. If the target succeeds 3 death saves or you are reduced to 0 hit points or die, the technique ends and the target becomes immune to this technique for 3 days.

descriptionEn: The wheel of fate is yours to steer and yours alone.

name: G Warstaff
description: Biến cán bút vẽ manga thành vũ khí chiến trượng, tích tụ mực vẽ để nhìn thấy trước hành động tương lai của đối thủ trên từng trang truyện.

features.name: Warstaff
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can summon a pen-like cursed tool that allows you to see into the future of your opponents. As a bonus action for 2 cursed energy, you create an oversized pen-like cursed tool. This cursed tool has the reach and two-handed properties and you can use your CE modifier for its attack and damage rolls. On a hit it deals 1d4 + your CE modifier piercing damage and counts as a grade 4 cursed tool and can be used with martial arts die. You can dismiss the Warstaff at will and can only have one created at a time.

When you hit a creature with G Warstaff, you fulfill the condition for ink and attach a manga panel to the target, being able to view 1 second into the target's future. Hitting a target more than once adds another 1 second to the total, making you gain the benefits of the earlier seconds and the current. As a reaction or bonus action for 1 cursed energy, you can view that creature's future again and gain the following foresights until the beginning of your next turn depending on the creature’s marks. You cannot use this while blinded.

You can only see into a number of seconds into a creature's future equal to your proficiency bonus. The number of creatures that can be affected by this technique is equal to your CE modifier, and you can end the technique at will or it ends when the combat ends.

features.name: Highlighted Panels
features.description: At 3rd level, with the power of reading into the future, no one surprises you anymore. As long as you can see 2 seconds into a creature's future, you take half damage on a failure, and no damage on a success against saving throws caused by that creature.

features.name: Predictable Strikes
features.description: At 6th level, your opponents become extremely easy to read after being affected by your technique, and you learned how to exploit that. Once per turn when you hit an attack using G Warstaff against a creature that you can see 3 seconds into the future, you can turn that attack into a critical. You cannot roll for a black flash using this feature.

features.name: Precognition
features.description:
At 11th level, you can glimpse your own future, knowing exactly what to do and when. When you roll with advantage against a creature because of your technique, your critical range is increased by half your CE modifier(rounded down).

Whenever a creature rolls with disadvantage against you because of your technique, the roll’s critical fail range is increased by half of your CE modifier(rounded down). For example, if you have a +4 CE modifier and they roll a natural 3 on their roll, it counts as a critical failure.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Storyboard Dominion
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. All creatures in your domain count as having 6 seconds marked and at initiative 20, you can see 6 seconds into the future of all creatures.

tables: The creature's attack rolls against you are made at disadvantage
You have advantage on saving throws from that creature
You have advantage on attack rolls against that creature
You know the next actions of the creature (The DM tells you at the start of their turn)
You know the next actions of the creature (The DM tells you at the end of your turn)
You know the next actions of the creature (The DM tells you at the beginning of your turn)

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Storyboard Dominion
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. All creatures in your domain count as having 6 seconds marked and at initiative 20, you can see 6 seconds into the future of all creatures.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Phân Cảnh Thao Túng

feats.name: Greater Foresight
feats.description: Your foresight ability has reached even greater potential, reaching the point some consider enlightened. Whenever you have advantage because of your technique, you can roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the highest roll. Also, whenever a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you because of your technique, they roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the lowest roll.

feats.name: GG True Warstaff
feats.description:
You have created a more powerful version of your G Warstaff, being a true weapon of destruction. As a bonus action while you have G Warstaff active, you can spend 4 cursed energy to evolve it into its true form, GG True Warstaff. It gains the following benefits for 1 minute:

It deals one additional damage dice

Its reach is 15ft instead of 10ft

When you score a critical hit against a creature, you gain 2 seconds instead of 1

It gains a +1 to critical range

feats.name: Maximum: Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint
feats.description: You have gained the ability to not only see, but also manipulate the contents of your manga panel. At the beginning of your turn, you can choose a creature that you can see that is marked by 6 seconds and roll a d20. Record the roll. As a reaction, you can replace one roll that creature makes with the result of that roll. At the beginning of your turn, you lose any unused rolls.

descriptionEn: You can conjure a pen-like cursed tool that lets you see the future.

name: Golden Hour
description: Thao túng dòng chảy thời gian xung quanh cơ thể khi tạo dáng cố định, làm chậm đối thủ và chớp thời cơ tung đòn quyết định.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Golden Hour
features.description:
At 1st level, you can strike a pose and move so quickly it seems as if time has stopped. As a bonus action for 1 cursed energy you can stop time until the end of your turn. During stopped time, you cannot use cursed energy, and are affected by the following:

You have advantage on all attack rolls against creatures in stopped time.

Ranged attacks you make become affected by stopped time and are suspended in mid-air, but finish when time resumes.

Other creatures in stopped time automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves and cannot use reactions. (A creature can use their reaction against a ranged attack you have made once time has resumed.)

features.name: Majestic Pose
features.description:
At 3rd level, you can instead spend up to twice your proficiency bonus in cursed energy as a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) to strike a majestic pose and immediately take one turn per three CE spent in stopped time. Doing so places extreme stress on your body. Once time resumes your movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn.

When you stop time, your speed increases by 10 ft until time resumes. This increases by 5 ft at 6th, 11th, and 18th level.

features.name: Golden Week
features.description:
At 6th level, you have begun to master your technique. You have learned to use your technique for longer. As an action for 4 cursed energy instead of stopping time you can empower yourself for longer, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

Your speed is doubled.

You gain a +3 bonus to AC.

You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

You gain an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

You cannot stop time until this feature ends.

features.name: Samsara Rewind
features.description:
At 11th level, you have gained the limited ability to reverse time. As a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) for 8 cursed energy you can strike a supreme pose and rewind time by 6 seconds, taking all creatures and objects within 100 ft back in time 1 round to the start of your previous turn.

Any damage taken or cursed energy spent (other than this technique) during that round is undone and all creatures are taken back to where they were 6 seconds ago as long as it is within the 100 ft radius of the rewind.

features.name: Domain Expansion: The World
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have created a domain imbued with your perfected technique. At initiative 20, you can stop time and immediately take one turn as your domain empowers you. Whenever you stop time in your domain using your technique, you stop time for an additional turn.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: The World
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have created a domain imbued with your perfected technique. At initiative 20, you can stop time and immediately take one turn as your domain empowers you. Whenever you stop time in your domain using your technique, you stop time for an additional turn.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thế Giới Thời Gian

feats.name: Quick Pose
feats.description:
You have learned to activate your technique in a fraction of a second.

When you use Golden Hour, you can instead use it as a free action on your turn instead of as a bonus action.

As a reaction for 5 CE, you can stop time for yourself and immediately take one turn. After time resumes, your movement is 0 ft and you cannot take actions until the end of your next turn.

At 6th level, you can use Golden Week as a bonus action instead of an action.

feats.name: Prime Time
feats.description: Instead of making your technique last longer, you can increase the intensity to create an even sharper burst. When you use Majestic Pose, you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to instead quadruple your movement speed and gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls within stopped time. However, once time resumes you are unable to move or take actions until the end of your next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over you.

feats.name: Maximum: Clock Hand
feats.description:
As a bonus action, you can spend 5 CE to summon the Clock Hand to your hands for 10 minutes. The Clock Hand counts as a Simple Melee weapon that you are proficient with and has the finesse and reach property. It deals 1d10 piercing damage on a hit and has the Hour Hand and Minute Hand properties while you (not others) wield it.

Hour Hand. If used against a creature in stopped time, the Clock Hand deals an additional 3d8 necrotic damage on a hit.

Minute Hand. If used against a creature not in stopped time, on a hit the creature must make a Cursed Energy save or be frozen in time and suffer the penalties of stopped time until the end of their next turn. This can only force a save once per round.

descriptionEn: You have the unique ability to manipulate time when you strike a pose.

name: Hair Manipulation
description: Biến từng sợi tóc thành lưỡi dao sắc như thép nguội hoặc tạo thành khiên chắn xoáy tròn bảo vệ toàn diện bản thân.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Scorpion Hair
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you have learned to move your hair into different forms using cursed energy. When you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 CE to replace an attack by shaping your hair into a barbed stinger. Make a melee cursed energy attack against a creature within 10 ft of you. On a hit you deal 1d10 + your CE modifier piercing damage. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this attack at 3rd level. This increases to a +2 bonus at 6th level, +3 bonus at 11th level and +4 bonus at 18th level.

features.name: Drill Hair
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have learned to form your hair into drill bits and shoot them off as projectiles. When you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to replace an attack with a ranged cursed energy attack roll with a range of 30ft. This attack deals 1d6 + your CE modifier piercing damage. The range of this technique increases to 60 ft at 6th level.

When attacking with a drill, you can spend an additional 2 cursed energy to make the drill explode in a 5 ft radius upon the point of impact causing creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take an additional 3d6 fire damage. On a success, they take half as much damage. The fire damage increases to 5d6 at 6th level, 8d6 at 11th level and 10d6 at 18th level.

features.name: Aircraft Hair
features.description:
At 6th level you have learned to make more complex constructs from your hair. As an action for 3 CE, you form your hair into either a Jet or Helicopter for 1 minute and can spend 1 CE to keep the form active for 1 minute:

Helicopter Hair. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When you take the attack action, you can spend 2 cursed energy to replace one attack by extending your blades and attempting to slash an enemy. Make a melee cursed energy attack, on a hit you deal 6d8 + your CE modifier slashing damage. This damage increases to 8d8 at 11th level, and 10d8 at 18th level.

A creature that hits you with an Opportunity attack takes slashing damage equal to your CE modifier. This becomes twice your CE modifier at 11th level.

Jet Hair. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. When you take the dash action while flying, you not only do not provoke opportunity attacks, but can also choose to move in a straight line and crash through creatures. All creatures in your path must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take Xd8 bludgeoning damage and are pushed back 30 ft away from you and knocked prone. If they impact a solid surface, they take 1d4 bludgeoning for every 10 ft you traveled in a straight line before crashing into them. On a successful save they take half as much damage and are not pushed or knocked prone. (X = CE modifier)

At 11th level, taking the Dash action while flying you instead move up to twice your flying speed. This increases to three times your flying speed at 18th level.

features.name: Hair Spray
features.description:
At 11th level, your hair has become almost indestructible, allowing you to grow it to longer lengths and activate your techniques more freely. The melee reach of your techniques increases by 5 ft and your hair counts as a Grade 1 Cursed Tool. At 18th level, your hair counts as a Special Grade Cursed Tool.

Once per turn you can spend 2 additional CE to activate one of your technique features requiring an attack roll as a bonus action. An attack roll made using this special free action is made at advantage. Alternatively, once per turn you can spend 4 CE to activate one of your technique features requiring a saving throw as a bonus action. A saving throw forced by this special free action is made at disadvantage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Silken Strand Execution Ground
features.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. Creatures other than you take 2d10 slashing damage for every 5 ft they move within your domain as infinitesimally small and sharp hairs cut into them with their every movement. Your domain counts as difficult terrain for creatures other than you.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Silken Strand Execution Ground
domain.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. Creatures other than you take 2d10 slashing damage for every 5 ft they move within your domain as infinitesimally small and sharp hairs cut into them with their every movement. Your domain counts as difficult terrain for creatures other than you.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Ti Sợi Xử Quyết Trường

feats.name: Scorpion Tactics
feats.description:
You have trained with your hair and unlocked the following maneuvers:

Barbed Defense. As a reaction to being targeted by an attack, you can make a Scorpion Hair attack against the attacker if they are within range.

Hair Wrapping. On a hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can choose to deal no damage and instead grapple the creature. You can use your Cursed Energy modifier to make grapple checks with your hair.

Split Ends. Once per turn, when you hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll.

feats.name: Mega-Drill
feats.description: You can now use more cursed energy to imbue one Mega-drill. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you can shoot this Mega-drill in a 5 ft wide, 80 ft long line. Creatures in this line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it deals 6d10 piercing damage. On a success, they take half the damage.
