This technique deals maximum damage to objects and structures and ignores half and three quarters cover. The damage of this technique increases to 8d10 at 6th level and becomes 10d10 at 11th level.

feats.name: Air Bomber
feats.description:
You have learned the following destructive ways to amplify your Aircraft Hair forms:

Copter Frenzy. As an action for 5 CE, you force all creatures within 15 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they take your Helicopter Hair damage. On a successful save, they take half as much.

Jet Crash. The damage a creature takes from impacting a solid surface from your crash increases to 1d6 per 10 ft traveled in a straight line before hitting the. This becomes 1d8 at 11th level and 1d10 at 18th level.

descriptionEn: Your technique allows you to form your hair into a variety of shapes.

name: Heart Catch
description: Lấy nhịp đập con tim làm ngòi nổ Chú lực: nhịp tim càng tăng cao trong hiểm cảnh, đòn đánh tung ra càng đạt uy lực tàn phá khủng khiếp.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Hands of Love
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you create a pair of translucent hands as a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy. These hands stay within 15 ft of you and each count as medium constructs. You can replace any attacks you make on your turn with an attack from your Love Hands. These hands deal your unarmed damage, and have advantage on grappling and shoving. The hands have an AC equal to your Cursed Energy save DC, HP equal to twice your cursed energy score and you take 1/10th of damage they take. This increases to three times your cursed energy score at 6th level and four times at 11th level.

features.name: Handy
features.description:
At 3rd level, your love hands improve. Your hands gain the following benefits:

Your hands AC increase by your proficiency bonus

Your hands gain a damage bonus equal to your CE modifier

The range of your hands increases to a total of 30 feet

Grappled creatures are  also restrained

You can use cursed feats and abilities using your hands

features.name: Hand Shield
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Love Hands to guard a creature within 5 ft of both hands, granting them three quarters cover. Alternatively, you can have each hand guard a different target to grant them half cover.

features.name: Cutie Honey
features.description: Starting at 11th level, on a hit you can spend 5 Cursed Energy to force a creature you hit with a melee attack to become Charmed. A creature charmed in this way can only target you with attacks and harmful effects for 1 minute and must make a Wisdom save at the start of their turn to end the condition.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Lover’s Grasp
features.description: At 18th level, you have learned the true meaning of love. At initiative 20 all creatures in the Domain are restrained and charmed until the end of their next turn. Additionally, your Love Hands automatically hit all attack rolls and creatures automatically fail grapple and shove checks as well as saving throws made by the hands.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Lover’s Grasp
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned the true meaning of love. At initiative 20 all creatures in the Domain are restrained and charmed until the end of their next turn. Additionally, your Love Hands automatically hit all attack rolls and creatures automatically fail grapple and shove checks as well as saving throws made by the hands.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tình Si Đoạt Mệnh

feats.name: Lover’s Embrace
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Hands of Love
feats.description: You have mastered the basic use of your love hands. Whenever you Shove a creature, they are instead pushed 10 feet. When creatures are grappled or restrained, they take a d6 bludgeoning damage at the start of their turn. Structures also take maximum damage from your Love Hands.

feats.name: Handy Dandy
feats.description: You use your Love Hands in new and innovative ways. As an action, you can make your Hands into a solid platform. This can be used for traversing, or area control and gives you and another creature that is large or smaller a hover speed of 15 ft while on it.

feats.name: Maximum: Love at First Sight
feats.description: As an action for 8 CE, you can choose to instantly put a creature you can see under the effects of Cutie Honey without needing to restrain them.

descriptionEn: A simple yet effective technique, powered by the heart.

name: Ice Formation
description: Băng ngưng thuật thức tuyệt mỹ của Uraume: ngưng kết hơi ẩm tức khắc thành những tảng băng khổng lồ và mây giá lạnh phong tỏa kẻ thù.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Ice Creation
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, your innate technique has allowed you to mess with the temperature around you, creating extreme levels of cold. As an action for 1 cursed energy, you can force creatures in a 10ft cone to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d10 cold damage and are restrained as ice covers part of their bodies. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not restrained.

The creature can make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of its turns to break the ice and end the restrained condition.

All ice created by your technique will last until you end it as a free action, a creature breaks it, or you are poisoned, incapacitated, or unconscious.

At 3rd level, the damage of this feature increases to 2d10, to 3d10 at 6th, to 4d10 at 10th, to 5d10 at 14th, and to 6d10 cold damage at 20th level.

features.name: Extreme Cold
features.description: At 3rd level, being stuck on your ice feels like staying in a cold mountain while you wait for death. A creature inside your ice is under one level of Exhaustion. Any creatures within 5ft of your ice that don't have resistance or immunity to cold damage have their movement speed halved.

features.name: Frost Calm
features.description:
When you reach 6th level, you have learned how to unleash thick layers of ice through the mist. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you can send a cloud of freezing mist to a spot within 60 feet of you. Every creature in a 30-foot radius sphere in that spot must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d8 cold damage and are restrained by an ice layer. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not restrained.

The creature can make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of its turns to break the ice and end the restrained condition.

features.name: Ice Fall
features.description:
Once you reach 11th level, you learn a great execution method that makes sure your enemies won't escape. As an action for 8 cursed energy, you fall prone until the beginning of your next turn to create ice on the ground. You telepathically manipulate the ice created, launching one for every creature within 30 ft of you of your choice. Make a cursed energy attack roll, on a hit they take 1d10 cold damage and become restrained.

The creature can make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of its turns to break the ice and end the restrained condition.

Hitting or missing, giant spikes of ice will fall from the sky on top of the targeted creatures, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d8 cold damage and 6d8 piercing damage. On a success, they take half as much damage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: White Abyss
features.description: If you achieve 18th level, you hone your technique to a fine edge, allowing you to use your Domain Expansion. While inside it, every creature except you takes 10d8 cold damage and is restrained at the end of their turn. A creature can make a Strength (Athletics) check at the beginning of their turn to break out.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: White Abyss
domain.description: If you achieve 18th level, you hone your technique to a fine edge, allowing you to use your Domain Expansion. While inside it, every creature except you takes 10d8 cold damage and is restrained at the end of their turn. A creature can make a Strength (Athletics) check at the beginning of their turn to break out.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Bạch Ngưng Thâm Uyên

feats.name: Iceshape
feats.description: You have gained the ability to further shape your ice into a weapon. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy you can make a weapon made of ice or transform ice into a weapon for 1 minute. Once per turn, you can deal additional cold damage equal to your CE modifier on an attack made with that weapon.

feats.name: Frostbite
feats.description: The cold of your ice has increased exponentially. While restrained by your ice, your opponent gains an additional temporary level of exhaustion and a -2 to attack rolls and ability checks.

feats.name: Maximum: Shatter
feats.description: You now freeze through flesh and muscle. As an action while within 5 ft of a creature that is restrained by your ice, you can break off a limb that is not the head or torso (Using the limb damage table). The creature is then no longer restrained.

descriptionEn: Your technique is beautiful in its simplicity, and the ability to make and control ice.

name: Idle Transfiguration
description: Thuật thức tàn bạo của Mahito: chạm vào da thịt để bóp méo hình dạng linh hồn đối thủ, biến họ thành dị hình quái vật hoặc tự tái tạo thân thể.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Transfiguration
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your touch can alter a creature's very own being, their soul. Whenever you hit a creature with a natural weapon, unarmed strike, or touch them, you can deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage.

In addition, as an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can force a creature within your reach to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they will take 1d10 Necrotic Damage, which increases to 2d10 at 3rd level, 3d10 at 6th level, 4d10 at 11th level, and 5d10 at 18th level. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage. This damage reduces a creature’s hit point maximum until they finish a long rest.

If Necrotic damage from any features of Idle Transfiguration reduces a creature's total hit points to 0, the creature will become one of your Transfigured Creatures. This does not work on Constructs.

Transfigured Creatures. You can have a number of transfigured creatures equal to your level x your Cursed Energy modifier. Transfigured creatures will follow your orders, act at the end of your turn and their creature type is undead. On a short or long rest, you can modify a transfigured creature’s size from tiny to huge.

Ability Scores. The creature’s mental scores will be decreased to 4. You can redistribute the points removed from their mental stats into their physical scores, even beyond 20.

Primitiveness. Transformed creatures lose all supernatural abilities like cursed technique as well as proficiencies, and their AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier. They can only use natural weapons or unarmed attacks. They roll a d6 in place of the normal damage of their unarmed strike.

You can command with simple orders such as to attack a creature as a bonus action. Complex orders like area control are an action. You can store transfigured creatures, extracting any number as an action.

features.name: Alteration
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, you can safely alter yourself or an ally.

Ally Alteration: You can use your alteration on willing creatures, to alter them as you see fit. You alter a willing creature during a short or long rest, granting them one or more of the following benefits:

You can grant a number of different alterations to the same creature equal to your proficiency.

Self-Alteration: You have learned how to shape your own form in many different ways. As a bonus action, you can gain new body parts. You can choose one of the following:

At 6th level, you gain the following Self-Alteration option:

Size Change. For 2 CE, you increase or decrease your size by 1 category for 1 min (does not stack). While enlarged you have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws and your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 extra damage. While reduced you have advantage on Dexterity checks and saves and a +1 to AC. You can revert as a bonus action.

features.name: Body Clone
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned how to create a near perfect clone of yourself. As an action for 6 Cursed Energy, you create a copy of yourself, giving it half of your current and max Hit Points and Cursed Energy. It is identical to you, controlled by you, acts at the end of your turn, and you can view through its senses. Your clone cannot use your Innate Technique features except Self-Alteration. You can't make another clone until it dies or you touch it and rejoin, granting you back the rest of your max HP and Cursed Energy.

features.name: Soul Multiplicity
features.description:
Starting at 11th level, you can use Self-Alteration as a free action on your turn. As an action for 5 Cursed Energy you can spend 2 or more Transfigured Creatures, fusing together for one of the following:

Body Repel. You create a barrage of Transfigured creatures being launched at high speeds. You make a ranged Cursed Energy attack with a range of 60/120 feet that deals 4d8 necrotic damage on a hit. For every additional Transfigured Creature, you deal another 1d8 necrotic damage and can split the damage die between different targets to make multiple attacks.

Polymorphic Soul Isomer. You create a Polymorphic Soul Isomer for 1 minute. When using this technique, you can add another Transfigured Creature to the fusion. Each transfigured creature counts as one soul.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Self Embodiment of Perfection
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have studied your powers and have finally learned your most powerful technique. You create a large dimension filled with your body parts, making escaping death impossible. At initiative 20 creatures within your domain suffer twice your Transfiguration touch damage.

tables: The creature gains advantage in perception checks involving smell.
The creature gains advantage in perception checks involving hearing.
The creature  gains advantage in perception checks involving seeing.
The creature gains darkvision up to 60 feet, if the creature already has darkvision it will extend its range by 30 feet.
The creature gains resistance to either: bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing.
The creature gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed and can breathe underwater.
Your unarmed strikes deal slashing and count as light, finesse, martial melee weapons
Your unarmed strikes deal piercing damage, and increases damage by your Proficiency
Increase movement by 10 feet and Bonus Action dash.
As a reaction to a melee attack within 5 feet, you can deal Piercing damage equal to 4x your Proficiency.
You gain a 60 ft fly speed. While at least 15 feet away, you gain a +2 bonus to AC
No Spike Hands, Sword Hands,  Arm Shield, or Long Arms

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Self Embodiment of Perfection
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have studied your powers and have finally learned your most powerful technique. You create a large dimension filled with your body parts, making escaping death impossible. At initiative 20 creatures within your domain suffer twice your Transfiguration touch damage.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tự Bế Viên Đốn Quả

feats.name: Transfiguration Adept
feats.description:
You have mastered your observation of the soul and learned grotesque molds to shape them into. You gain the two of the following ways to use transfigured humans (this feat can be repeated):

Remote Transfiguration. When using Transfiguration, you can instead imprint a small, latent amount  of cursed energy upon their souls, allowing you to transfigure them from large distances (only one touch per creature).

Wall of Flesh. As an action, you spend humans up to your proficiency bonus to form a flat panel of human flesh up to 5 ft long and wide per human used in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. The wall’s AC equals your CE save DC and has hit points equal to 5 x the combined CR of the creatures used. You can move it 5 ft as a bonus action and can have only one wall at a time.

Human Weapon. As a bonus action, you form a creature into a simple or martial weapon or ammunition. The weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature’s CR is 5 or higher and increases by +1 per 5 CR to a maximum of +4.

People Spikes. As an action, you spend humans up to your proficiency bonus, covering a 5 ft area per human on the ground within 30 ft of you with human spikes. A creature that walks through this area takes 2d8 piercing damage.

feats.name: Awakening
feats.description:
When you use Ally-Alteration on a Non-Sorcerer, you can instead spend 10 cursed energy to awaken the sorcerer, making a DC 25 Cursed Energy check to awaken the target. On a success, their potential grows over the course of 1d4 + 4 days, gaining a level in a Jujutsu Sorcerer class of the DM’s choice. Roll a d100 to see if the target has an Innate Technique despite being a Non-Sorcerer. On a 99-100, the target has an innate technique.

If you roll below a 15 on the Cursed Energy check, the target takes your Transfiguration damage, potentially making the target into a transfigured human.

feats.name: Soul Alteration
feats.description:
Your manipulation over your soul has increased dramatically, making you almost impossible to kill by those who cannot target your soul. When you use Self-Alteration, you can instead spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to regain 5 hit points per cursed energy spent. You can regrow a limb for every 2 cursed energy spent in this way. At 11th level, this instead becomes 10 hit points per CE, can be used as a reaction to damage, and costs 1 CE to regrow limbs.

When you are reduced to 0 hit points while you have at least 1 CE, by a method that does not directly harm your soul, you are instead incapacitated until you regain hit points and do not make death saves. While incapacitated in this way, the only action you can take is to use Soul Alteration as an action.

feats.name: Maximum: Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Self Embodiment of Perfection
feats.description: As an action for 8 cursed energy, you mold your body and soul into a form most befitting you. A form suited for killing. For 1 hour, your AC cannot be lower than 25 and you gain damage reduction equal to your CE modifier as your body has become impossibly hard and dense. Additionally, you gain elbow blades that count as simple melee weapons that you are proficient with. They deal 1d12 + your Cursed Energy modifier in piercing damage on a hit. When you make an attack with your Elbow Blades, you can spend 1 cursed energy to gain advantage on and increase the range of the attack to 15 feet as the Elbow Blade extends and shoots out at the target.

descriptionEn: The soul is an interesting thing and your technique manipulates it.

name: Illusive Mirage
description: Gieo rắc ảo giác vào tâm thức đối phương, tạo ra các ảo ảnh gương phản chiếu đánh lừa thị giác và chuyển hướng đòn đánh của kẻ địch.

features.name: Self Distortion
features.description:
At 3rd level, you’ve learned how to distort your own body to confuse your opponents. You learn the 3 following distortion techniques:

Phase Fist. As part of making a melee attack, you can spend 3 cursed energy to create a duplicate of your weapon. Make a melee cursed attack roll at disadvantage, afterwards you make your normal attack against the same target. If the phase attack misses the actual attack will deal double the damage dice on a hit and if the phase attack hits the main attack will instead be made at advantage.

Blurring. As an action for 3 cursed energy, your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For a number of rounds equal to your Cursed Energy modifier, a creature that can see you has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight like blindsight or can see through illusions like with true sight.

Distorting Disguise. For 3 cursed energy, you make yourself (including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings) look different for a number of hours equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. The changes of this feature fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this technique to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel your head and hair. If you use this spell to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair. To discern that you are disguised, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your cursed energy save DC.

features.name: Object Distortion
features.description:
At 6th level, you have now learned a new way to distort the surroundings of those you have cursed. As an action, you may choose an object within the range of your cursed illusion that you can see to distort its appearance, this can include changing its opacity, luster, visible texture, or its seen value. A creature can attempt to discern the illusion by rolling an investigation check against your cursed energy save DC. You can spend an additional 3 CE to make the object invisible. If a creature runs into a medium or larger invisible object, they take 1d6 bludgeoning and lose their reaction.

The cost of the technique depends on the size of the targeted object:

features.name: Illusive Terrain
features.description:
At 11th level, you have decided that affecting the area around people can lead to strategic victory. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you can manipulate the surrounding terrain around you in a 150 ft radius in the following ways:

Rough Ground. You make the terrain appear difficult to traverse, when a creature attempts to walk in this area they must spend twice as much movement per 5 ft of travel.

Obstructing Illusion. As an action, you make a false structure or wall within range. A creature is convinced that the structure is real, meaning that they cannot target you with features that require line of sight.

A creature can attempt to see through the illusion by rolling an Investigation or Perception check (using their Cursed Energy score if they are a Sorcerer) against your Cursed Energy save DC. A creature automatically succeeds if they have an ability like true sight.

features.name: Domain Expansion: House of Mirrors At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. At initiative 20, you can force all creatures to fall under an illusion of your choice. Additionally, you can use your reaction to trick a creature that attacks you to target a random creature within range. They must roll a dice to see who is targeted with the dice depending on the number of creatures within range. On a 1, you are still targeted. On a higher roll, a different creature is targeted. If there are no other creatures in range, roll a d2. On a 2, the attack targets a random direction, missing you completely.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: House of Mirrors
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. At initiative 20, you can force all creatures to fall under an illusion of your choice. Additionally, you can use your reaction to trick a creature that attacks you to target a random creature within range. They must roll a dice to see who is targeted with the dice depending on the number of creatures within range. On a 1, you are still targeted. On a higher roll, a different creature is targeted. If there are no other creatures in range, roll a d2. On a 2, the attack targets a random direction, missing you completely.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Kính Phòng Ảo Cảnh

feats.name: Funny Faces
feats.description: You have learned to add a bit of humor to your technique. When a cursed creature sees a distorted face, you can spend 2 CE to force the Intelligence saving throw to be made at disadvantage by making the face look extra goofy. Additionally, you can spend 1 CE to change the distortion, causing them to have to make an additional Intelligence save on their next turn if they see a distorted face.

feats.name: Cursed Tracking
feats.description:
You have begun to work on your tracking skills over your illusions so you can track your targets at all times.

When someone is cursed by your technique you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to forgo the effects of the illusions but enhance the tracking. Somewhere on the target's body, a mark appears out of sight without their knowledge. They can make an Investigation check against your Cursed Energy DC to become aware of the curse or if someone else points it out. This mark will last for 24 hours and while it’s active you will always have a precise location of the target within a range of 300 ft + your proficiency bonus x 100 ft. At the beginning of each day you can spend 5 Cursed Energy to keep it active for another 24 hours.

If a target leaves your range, you cannot track them until they reenter your range. You cannot extend your tracking period if they are not within range.

feats.name: Maximum: Absolute Perspective
feats.description: For 10 cursed energy, you can force a creature in range to make a Cursed Energy saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, you completely fool all of their senses for 1 minute. You can freely create illusions around the target as if they are under your Cursed Illusion or Illusive Terrain. They automatically fail checks to determine the illusions are fake as their mind rationalizes any inconsistencies. Additionally, the target believes so strongly that your illusions are real that they can actually take damage. Once per turn if you create a harmful illusion, the target can take psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus in d6s.

descriptionEn:
Your technique lets you curse people and make them see illusions.

Cursed Illusion At 1st level, your technique allows you to curse creatures and make them see other people's faces in a distorted way. You are also able to track those you have cursed. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can curse a creature within 60 feet. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the next person they see has a distorted face. Upon seeing this distortion for the first time, the creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature is confused and has disadvantage on attack rolls and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks until the end of their next turn. A sorcerer can repeat the Charisma save at the end of their turns to end the curse.

When a creature fails their Charisma saving throw, you gain the ability to track them up to 400 feet away. While a creature is cursed, you know its general location. The cursed creature keeps seeing the distorted face until they succeed the save or leave your tracking range.

At 6th level, you can target a number of creatures up to your Cursed Energy modifier as an action, spending 2 CE for each. Additionally, a creature that fails its save also has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves and loses concentration on any technique or feature it was concentrating on.

name: Inverse
description: Đảo nghịch quy luật sát thương của Jiro Awasaka: đòn đánh càng mạnh càng trở nên yếu ớt, trong khi đòn đánh cực nhẹ lại gây tổn thương nặng nề.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Inversion
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to invert the damage you take. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 cursed energy to activate Inverse for 1 minute. While Inverse is active, when you take damage, it is modified based on a damage limit and threshold. The damage limit equals your proficiency bonus times your Cursed Energy score, and the threshold is equal to your proficiency bonus times your Cursed Energy modifier.

When you take damage that exceeds your threshold, you subtract the threshold from the damage and take the remaining difference as damage. However, when the damage is below your threshold, you subtract the threshold from the damage and take the resulting number as damage instead. For example, if your set limit is 100 and you take 90 damage, you would subtract the damage from your limit if it exceeds the threshold (e.g., 90 - 20 = 70), and take the remaining 70 damage. Conversely, if the damage is below the threshold (e.g., 10 damage), you subtract that amount from your set limit (100 - 10 = 90), and take 90 damage instead. If the calculation results in a negative number, the damage remains unchanged.

You can extend the duration of Inverse by spending 1 cursed energy to maintain the effect for an additional minute.

features.name: Extreme Opposites
features.description:
At 3rd level, you’ve learned to further manipulate the damage you take based on its intensity. If you take damage that is below your threshold, you are considered vulnerable to the damage dealt. However, if the damage exceeds your threshold, you gain resistance to the damage, even if it would normally bypass resistances or immunities.

For example, if your threshold is 15 and you take 10 damage, you treat that as vulnerability. But if you take 18 damage, you instead halve it due to your resistance, even if that type of damage would normally ignore resistances.

features.name: Break the Strong
features.description:
At 6th level, you’ve become adept at manipulating damage based on its intensity, even when making saving throws. When you are forced to make a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the difficulty of the save depends on whether the damage is above or below your threshold.

If the damage is above your threshold, you have advantage on the saving throw, regardless of the damage type. If the damage is below your threshold, you have disadvantage on the saving throw, as weaker attacks become more dangerous to you.

For example, if your threshold is 15 and you would take 18 damage from a fireball, you gain advantage on the saving throw. However, if you take 10 damage from the same attack, you would roll with disadvantage instead.

features.name: Quick Inversion
features.description:
At 11th level, staying with your technique active for long periods of time can become a disadvantage at times, so you have trained to have easier access to your technique. You can now use your technique as a reaction to damage and can deactivate your technique as a reaction.

In addition, you now have additional reactions equal to half of your proficiency bonus(rounded up) that can be used only for the inverse technique. At 18th level, this becomes a number of reactions equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Synesthesia
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. Within your domain, you can activate Inverse as a free action an infinite number of times for no cost. At initiative 20, creatures of your choice have their senses inverted. Each creature rolls a d4 (1: taste, 2: smell, 3: touch, 4: sight) having a sense inverted and unable to be used. A creature can make a Cursed Energy check at the end of their turn to regain their lost sense.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Synesthesia
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to open your domain. Within your domain, you can activate Inverse as a free action an infinite number of times for no cost. At initiative 20, creatures of your choice have their senses inverted. Each creature rolls a d4 (1: taste, 2: smell, 3: touch, 4: sight) having a sense inverted and unable to be used. A creature can make a Cursed Energy check at the end of their turn to regain their lost sense.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Cảm Giác Đồng Hóa

feats.name: Extreme Inverse
feats.description:
You have fully mastered your Inverse technique, allowing you to withstand devastating attacks while weak strikes take a heavy toll. When you take damage, the effect depends on whether it exceeds or falls below your threshold.

If the damage exceeds your threshold, you reduce it by an amount equal to your level. However, if the damage is below your threshold, you increase the damage taken by an amount equal to your level. This makes you near-invulnerable to powerful blows, but even the lightest strike can prove perilous.

feats.name: Inverted Field
feats.description: While training on your technique, you have found out you have a lot more to offer than just being an indestructible powerhouse. You have learned how to alter a whole area to be affected by your technique. As a bonus action for 6 cursed energy, you cause all objects and creatures within 30 ft of you to be affected by your Inverse technique for 1 minute. A creature or object is no longer affected by Inverse if they leave the range of the field. You can deactivate this as a bonus action.

feats.name: Maximum: Antithesis
feats.description:
You’ve learned to channel your inverted energy outward, inverting the flow of harm itself while your Inverse is active:

When you take damage within your threshold, you can spend 4 CE as a reaction to reflect half of that damage back to the attacker (damage becomes force or necrotic, your choice) if they are within 30 ft.

When you take damage below your threshold, you can instead spend 1 CE as a free action to transfer the pain. Choose a creature within 30 ft to take force or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to twice your CE modifier.

descriptionEn: You invert damage taken based on a specific threshold.

name: Laplace’s Demon
description: Bộ não tính toán siêu việt tựa ác quỷ Laplace: dự đoán chính xác tuyệt đối quỹ đạo di chuyển và vị trí của mọi phân tử trên chiến trường.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Demonic Intellect
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have extreme control of your emotions with a logical mindset allowing you to use Intelligence as your Cursed Energy modifier. You can spend 1 CE as a bonus action to overclock your brain for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits:

You can spend 2 CE to take an action as a reaction.

You gain advantage on Intelligence checks.

You add your Intelligence modifier to AC and Dexterity saves.

You gain the 2000 IQ Skill feat.

features.name: Future and Past
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you can accelerate your brain to predict the future and past with frightful accuracy.

When you finish a long rest, roll two d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can spend 1 CE as a reaction to replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check you make, or a saving throw you force another creature to make with one of these foretelling rolls. You must choose to do so before the roll.

Each foretelling roll can be used only once. When you finish a long rest, you lose any unused foretelling rolls. When you complete a short rest, you can spend 1 CE to gain another foretelling roll. You can only have one foretelling roll from a short rest at a time.

features.name: Overload
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned to overload the minds of others instead of your own. As an action for 4 cursed energy you can touch a creature and force them to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure they take 5d10 psychic damage and are stunned until the end of their next turn, on a success they take half as much damage and aren’t stunned.

features.name: Imaginary Demon Brain
features.description: At 11th level, you have learned to push the effects of your technique to their maximum limit. As an action, you can spend 8 cursed energy to enter a state of elevated intellect and foresight for 1 hour. All rolls you make are at advantage and all rolls against you are at disadvantage as you are able to see through the truth of the world in its entirety. As a reaction, you can add your Intelligence modifier to an attack roll, skill check or saving throw made by you or a creature within 15 ft of you.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Laplace Threshold
features.description:
At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain gain a cumulative -2 penalty to all rolls against you as you begin to see the state of every atom.

While inside the domain:

You know the hit points, cursed energy, effects, conditions, resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities of all creatures within the domain.

Invisible creatures are always visible to you.

Creatures cannot gain advantage against you from being unseen or hidden.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Laplace Threshold
domain.description:
At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain gain a cumulative -2 penalty to all rolls against you as you begin to see the state of every atom.

While inside the domain:

You know the hit points, cursed energy, effects, conditions, resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities of all creatures within the domain.

Invisible creatures are always visible to you.

Creatures cannot gain advantage against you from being unseen or hidden.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Ngưỡng Giới Laplace

feats.name: Combat IQ
feats.description:
Through refining your ability, you have become more skilled in using your technique in combat and can add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative rolls. Additionally, when using Demonic Intellect, you gain the following additional benefits:

You add your proficiency bonus to any saving throws you make if you don’t already.

You can spend 1 CE to gain an additional reaction each round.

Once per round you can add your Intelligence modifier to a damage roll you make.

feats.name: Hyper-Intellect
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Future and Past
feats.description: Your brain has begun to acclimate to the constant amount of information being calculated. Your Intelligence score increases by 3 and you gain proficiency in either History, Investigation, Arcana, Religion, or Nature. Your Intelligence score increases by 1 again at 6th, 11th, and 18th level. Your maximum score for Intelligence is now 24.

feats.name: Calculate Scenario
feats.description:
You focus your mind for 1 minute and spend 5 cursed energy. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply.

The answer doesn’t take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as additional glimpses of the future or the loss or gain of a companion. Between now and the predicted event, you gain an insight of knowledge that grants you advantage on one roll of your choice. You cannot have more than one insight at a time.

descriptionEn: A thought experiment proposing an intellect so vast it knows the position and momentum of every particle, allowing it to predict the future and recall the past.

name: Limitless
description: Thuật thức tối thượng của gia tộc Gojo: thao túng không gian vô hạn ở cấp độ nguyên tử, thi triển Nghịch Thức Vô Hạ Hạn, Xích, Thương và Tử.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Infinity
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you gain the ability to use your manipulation over space to protect yourself effectively. As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can encase yourself in a field of mathematical infinity costing 1 Cursed Energy at the start of your turn. When you are targeted by a weapon, spell, Cursed Energy attack roll or any saving throws from sources outside your body you roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, any attacks or spells made against you automatically fail to touch or harm you in any physical way. At 6th level, this becomes 3 or higher, and 2 or higher at 11th level.

You can spend 1 Cursed Energy to automatically roll a 6 on an Infinity roll. At 11th level, you can spend 2 Cursed Energy at the beginning of each of your turns to automatically roll a 6 on Infinity rolls and you can activate Infinity as a reaction to being targeted by an attack or effect that you can see.

When you take the Dodge action while Infinity is activated, you gain advantage on the d6 roll, and you can grant its benefits to any creatures within your reach.

This feature does not work against poison or attacks that you cannot see until 6th level.

features.name: Lapse Blue
features.description:
At 3rd level, you can create another impossible concept, negative numbers which manifests as negative space. As an action for CE up to your modifier, you pick an unoccupied space within 30 feet you can see and create a 5 ft sphere until the beginning of your next turn as space corrects itself. This pulls targets within a radius of 5 feet for each CE spent, forcing a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they take 2d8 + 1d8 for each CE in force damage and are dragged into the blue and grappled. At 11th level, on a failure of 5 or more they take maximum damage and are restrained. On a success they take half as much damage. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn.

When you spend at least 5 CE on Blue, you can use its Maximum Output form to make it last for up to a minute while concentrating. As bonus action, you can move the sphere 30 ft in any direction. All creatures currently stuck in the sphere are also moved and a creature that starts their turn in range must make the saving throw. You can end the technique at will.

features.name: Teleportation
features.description:
At 6th level, your control over blue and space has increased. As an action, you can teleport yourself or another willing creature you touch 10 ft per Cursed Energy used.

You can teleport an additional creature by doubling the cursed energy cost. Additionally, with the use of a binding vow, you can instead teleport a creature to a 5 ft circle you have prepared. You can teleport a willing creature you touch to one of these circles as an action for 5 cursed energy. You can only have one circle per binding vow.

features.name: Offensive Infinity
features.cost: CE up to your Cursed Energy modifier to amplify Infinity
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned to push infinity to an aggressive mode through offensive training. As an action, you can spend CE up to your Cursed Energy modifier to amplify Infinity. All creatures within 10 ft must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they are forced 10 ft directly away from you and take 2d8 force damage per cursed energy spent. On a successful save they take half as much damage and are not pushed away.

If used at Maximum Output, a creature within 5 ft makes this save at disadvantage.

Alternatively, you can choose one target within 5 ft of you and 10 ft away from a wall or solid structure, and spend CE up to your CE modifier as an action to crush them against it. The target must make a Strength saving throw, being forced against the wall and taking 3d8 Force damage for each Cursed Energy spent and be restrained until the start of your next turn on a failed save. On a success, they are pushed 5 ft back and take half as much damage. If you are more than 10 ft away from the target, the technique ends.

If used at Maximum Output, you can spend CE up to your modifier at the start of your turn to maintain the technique, forcing the creature to repeat the save.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Unlimited Void
features.description: Finally, at 18th level you have learned how to expand your own domain, showing the dangers of the Unlimited Void. You can create a void in space that causes victims to receive all kinds of stimuli and information endlessly, restricting their thought processes and actions. At initiative 20, every creature within your domain that is not touching you must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, they take 12d8 psychic damage, their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become 1 and they are unable to cast spells, attack, use magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way, and fall unconscious for 1 minute. At the end of every minute, the creature can repeat this saving throw, ending these effects on a success. This effect can also be ended by Greater Restoration or Wish.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Unlimited Void
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level you have learned how to expand your own domain, showing the dangers of the Unlimited Void. You can create a void in space that causes victims to receive all kinds of stimuli and information endlessly, restricting their thought processes and actions. At initiative 20, every creature within your domain that is not touching you must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, they take 12d8 psychic damage, their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become 1 and they are unable to cast spells, attack, use magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way, and fall unconscious for 1 minute. At the end of every minute, the creature can repeat this saving throw, ending these effects on a success. This effect can also be ended by Greater Restoration or Wish.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Vô Lượng Không Xứ

feats.name: Spatial Skirmishing
feats.description:
Through intense training and familiarizing yourself with your technique, you have gained the ability to apply Blue to your fists. Once per turn, when you make an unarmed strike, by spending cursed energy you can make them suffer the effects of Lapse Blue on a hit. For this attack you can use your cursed energy modifier for attack rolls. When you use Blue in this way, the target takes additional damage equal to Lapse Blue on a hit and you gain advantage on that attack roll as your technique attracts the target.

If you have access to Reversal Red, you can also imbue Red to your fists. When you use Red in this way, the target takes additional damage equal to Reversal Red on a hit and must make a Strength saving throw or be launched the same distance as a normal Red.

feats.name: Maximum: Hollow Purple
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Lapse Blue and Reversal Red
feats.description: You have learned how to mix positive and negative space, creating imaginary mass. After using your action to prepare the technique, you can release it as an action for 10 Cursed Energy. Every creature in a 5 feet wide 100-foot line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 20d12 force damage, are moved to the end of the line, gain 1 level of exhaustion and you can target a limb from the Limb Damage Table. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.

feats.name: Delayed Purple
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Hollow Purple
feats.description: You have found a new more powerful way to fire Purple. As a reaction or action when a Blue is active, you can shoot a Red into it if it is within range. This forcefully creates a Hollow Purple that affects everything in a 100 foot radius around the source. This Hollow Purple deals maximum damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. You must also make a saving throw if you are within range. This technique cannot be used at Maximum Output.

descriptionEn:
A technique whose power is only matched by its complexity,

Limitless allows manipulation over space.

name: Love Rendezvous
description: Thuật thức sao Nam Thập Tự của Kirara: đánh dấu các vì sao lên mục tiêu và người dùng, cưỡng ép di chuyển theo thứ tự thiên hà nghiêm ngặt.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Love Rendezvous
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have a very complex technique, and you have learned the basics of how to use it. As a free action when you touch a creature or object(this can be done with yourself) with cursed energy or as part of hitting an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 cursed energy to mark the target's cursed energy with a star of your choice. Only one star can be placed in one creature's cursed energy at a time, however the same star can be applied to different people's cursed energy at a time. You can mark a number of creatures with the same star up to your Cursed Energy modifier. If you mark a creature, everything that has their cursed energy will be marked as well, like Shikigami, cursed tools etc. The following stars are available to mark: ★Imai, ★Acrux, ★Mimosa, ★Ginan and ★Gacrux.

When you mark a creature, a sparking light will appear above their head. They can also find the star's name marked on their body with a Wisdom (Perception) check.

Anyone appointed with a star must follow a sequential order if they want to attempt approaching another star. When they make their movement, they must move directly towards the next star in order and touch them, which allows them to move on to the next star in order. Failing to do this will make them restrained until the beginning of their next turn and every single creature or object marked with the same star will be attracted to the point with the highest cursed energy, being all rapidly thrown at that point. The highest cursed energy point will take 1 dice of bludgeoning damage per 5ft the other stars have travelled and their size, while the objects and creatures that crashed into it will take half as much damage. See the following chart for measure of damage:

The order of the stars is as follows: ★Imai → ★Acrux → ★Mimosa → ★Ginan → ★Gacrux

If there is no possible path for a target to follow the order, the target isn’t affected by the technique until such a possible path is created. The target is immediately affected again once such a path exists. For example, if Gacrux is placed in front of Ginan for a creature marked with Acrux, then the technique no longer functions for that creature, as there is no way to touch Ginan without approaching Gacrux. Once the creature passes Gacrux, thus opening a path for them to get to Ginan, the technique functions for them once more, and they must touch Ginan before approaching Gacrux.

The stars last for 10 minutes or until you remove one or more of them.

Creatures won't know they're being affected by the technique until they suffer the consequences from not following the order. After that, they can make a Perception check to find the star. After they discover the star, they can make a Wisdom (Insight) check at disadvantage against your cursed energy DC to try to understand your technique. Unless they have the Cursed Energy Perception feat or are familiar with the southern star constellation, which allows them to ignore disadvantage to the roll.

features.name: Effective Marking
features.description: At 3rd level, you learned how to mark creatures in a quicker and more effective manner. You can now mark creatures with stars as a reaction. Also, you gain a number of additional reactions equal to your Cursed Energy modifier that can only be used to mark other creatures.

features.name: Gravity
features.description: At 6th level, your technique's attraction has grown stronger. The damage of creatures colliding now ignores resistance to bludgeoning damage. This becomes force damage at 11th level and ignores resistance to force damage at 18th level.

features.name: Shining Stars
features.description: At 11th level, you became better with your technique, now being able to have more stars. The amount of stars you can put of the same type is increased to twice your Cursed Energy modifier.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Star Crossed Lovers
features.description: At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you can mark any creatures within your domain with any of your available stars. As an action, you can cause a creature marked with one of your stars to move up to 30 ft towards another marked target, taking collision damage if they impact and counting as part of your guaranteed hit. Any marks created by your domain disappear when your domain ends.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Star Crossed Lovers
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you can mark any creatures within your domain with any of your available stars. As an action, you can cause a creature marked with one of your stars to move up to 30 ft towards another marked target, taking collision damage if they impact and counting as part of your guaranteed hit. Any marks created by your domain disappear when your domain ends.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tinh Tú Tình Nhân

feats.name: Comet Reactions
feats.description: Your reaction speed has further increased. At the cost of one CE, you gain the ability to use the reactions from effective markings for other purposes.

feats.name: Repelling Forces
feats.description: You have gained further variety with your Marks and the forces within it. As a bonus action for up to 3 CE you can force marked creatures to be repelled from the creature with the highest amount of CE. How far depends on how much CE you use, with them moving 10 feet for every CE. They take 2d8 bludgeoning damage if the repelled movement forces them into a structure, object, or creature.

feats.name: Maximum: Star Crossed
feats.description: As an action for 10 CE, you push yourself and mark a creature you touch with all your power. Marking a creature this way, attracts one body into itself causing massive damage. When you activate this, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 25d4 force damage and a level of exhaustion on a failed save or half as much on a success.

descriptionEn: Love Rendezvous is a technique based on the Southern Cross. It marks creatures or objects with cursed energy and makes the lowest star have to pass through the other ones before they can move.

name: Miracle
description: Xóa sạch ký ức về những điều kỳ tích nhỏ bé hàng ngày để tích lũy thành điểm may mắn cứu mạng trong những khoảnh khắc thập tử nhất sinh.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Little Miracles
features.description: Starting at 1st level, your technique brings you strength when you witness good fortune. When you witness this, you gain a Miracle. You can have up to six Miracles at once, which are stored as marks somewhere on your body.  You gain 2 Miracles for every miracle you witness at 11th level and 3 Miracles at 18th level.

features.name: Blind Luck
features.description:
Once per round when you take damage, you can spend a Miracle to reduce the incoming damage by Xd4 equal to your CE modifier. You add your proficiency bonus to the rolled amount and reduce the damage by that much. You can also do this as a reaction for a Miracle and 1 CE.

When used this way, the d4 increases to a d6 and you add your proficiency bonus twice.

features.name: Miraculous Outcome
features.description: At 3rd level, you can self-consciously alter fate. As a reaction to failing a roll you can spend 1 Miracle and 1 CE to add a d6 to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. This increases to a d8 at 6th level and a d10 at 11th level.

features.name: Deadly Miracle
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned that out of difficulties, miracles grow. Your technique lets you fend off death by some miracle. When you are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw that would reduce you to 0 hit points or kill you outright, you can spend 2 Miracles and 2 CE to instead succeed the save or survive the attack and take no damage or additional effects. Completely escaping harm by seemingly dumb luck.

While you have at least 1 Miracle, you make death saving throws at advantage.

At 11th level, you can use this feature against an attack or effect that would reduce you to 1/2 or below your hit point maximum.

features.name: Fated for Fortune
features.description: At 11th level you realize there is no bad future for you, only a path to fortune paved with miracles! If you roll 20 or higher using Miraculous Outcome, it is considered a critical success as if you had rolled a natural 20 (cannot roll for Black Flash or gain Miracle).

features.name: Domain Expansion: Luck of the Draw
features.description:
Finally at 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Your domain costs 2d20 CE to expand and lasts 1d4 minutes. If you lack the Cursed Energy, you must reattempt on your next turn and reroll the 2d20. If you expand your domain as a reaction to another Domain Expansion, you can choose to spend 20 CE or to roll 2d20.

At initiative 20, you gain 3 Miracles and have no limit on your max amount of Miracles. Within your domain, you can spend a Miracle on yourself or another creature when they make an attack or use a technique to imbue it with your guaranteed hit.

tables: Everyone loves a Jackpot! When you or an ally you can see rolls the maximum amount on a roll, you gain a Miracle.
Equal Numbers are supposed to be lucky, right? When you or an ally you can see rolls two equal numbers one after the other, you gain a Miracle.
Finding free stuff is always cool!When you or an ally you can see find an item worth $1,000 or more, you gain a Miracle.
Overcoming hardship is something rare in this harsh world, so every chance we get is a miracle. When you or a creature you can see succeeds on a roll they had disadvantage on, you gain a Miracle.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Luck of the Draw
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Your domain costs 2d20 CE to expand and lasts 1d4 minutes. If you lack the Cursed Energy, you must reattempt on your next turn and reroll the 2d20. If you expand your domain as a reaction to another Domain Expansion, you can choose to spend 20 CE or to roll 2d20.

At initiative 20, you gain 3 Miracles and have no limit on your max amount of Miracles. Within your domain, you can spend a Miracle on yourself or another creature when they make an attack or use a technique to imbue it with your guaranteed hit.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Rút Thưởng May Mắn

feats.name: Beginner’s Luck
feats.description: You have learned to more efficiently store up luck. You can now store an additional number of Miracles equal to your CE modifier.

feats.name: Blessing of Fortune
feats.description: When you or a creature you can see fails a death saving throw, you can spend 1 Miracle and 1 CE as a reaction. The roll is now considered a natural 20. You cannot experience a breakthrough or gain a Miracle in this way.

feats.name: Innate Luck
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Fated for Fortune
feats.description: Some have asked you: "Are you lucky because you have miracles by your side, or do you have miracles by your side because you're lucky?" The answer was obvious, you are naturally lucky and your technique merely reflects that. You roll all dice generated by your cursed technique twice, picking the result of the higher one. Additionally, you can make a miracle die roll its maximum amount once per long rest.

descriptionEn: Your technique erases your memory of everyday little miracles to store them for when needed.

name: Missile Fist
description: Phóng các nắm đấm Chú lực khổng lồ bay xa như tên lửa hành trình, truy kích và đập tan kẻ thù từ khoảng cách an toàn.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Missile Impact
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can spend 1 cursed energy as a bonus action to materialize giant fists of cursed energy. Until the end of your turn, you can replace any of your attacks with a Missile Fist, making a ranged Cursed Energy attack against a creature within 20 ft. A Missile Fist does 1d8 + your CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit. As part of the bonus action you use to activate this technique, you can make one additional Missile Fist attack. If you use Missile Fist against a creature within 5 ft, you can instead make a melee Cursed Energy attack that can use your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

The damage of your Missile Fist increases to 2d8 at 6th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 18th level.

features.name: Devastating Barrage
features.description:
At 3rd level, when you use your Missile Fist, you can spend additional cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to make an additional Missile Fist attack per cursed energy spent. Additionally, the range of your Missile Fists increases to 30 ft. This range increases by 20 ft again at 6th, 11th, and 18th level.

If you hit a creature that is Large or smaller with a Missile Fist, instead of dealing damage, you can choose to grapple it for 1 minute. If you hit a grappled creature that is Large or smaller with a Missile Fist, instead of dealing damage, you can choose to restrain it for 1 minute. A creature can make a Strength saving throw against your CE save DC at the end of their turn to escape your technique. On a success, they can remove one of the Missile Fists, removing either the Grappled or Restrained conditions. These conditions end if you become Incapacitated.

features.name: Unrelenting Fury
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned that a strong offense is the only thing that matters. As an action for 3 CE, you create a 30 ft cone of Missile Fists. All creatures within the cone must make a Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, they take 2d8 necrotic damage for every attack you can make as an action and they are knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone. You can spend your bonus action to increase the damage by 2d8. You can spend cursed energy up to your CE modifier to increase damage by 2d8 per CE.

features.name: Maximum: Brutal Bombardment
features.description:
At 11th level, you can combine your Missile Fists into a larger, more brutal attack. As a Full-Turn Action Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) for 6 CE, you create a wave of Missile Fists. A creature within 50 ft must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 3d8 + 3d8 necrotic damage for every attack you can make as an action (counting as an additional Missile Fist for range) and is knocked prone. If the target is a creature, the target takes an additional 4d10 bludgeoning damage from being crushed. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much necrotic damage and no bludgeoning damage. If the target is an object or structure, it instead takes maximum damage.

All creatures within 5 ft of the target (+5 ft per Missile Fist) must make a Strength saving throw or similarly be crushed, taking the necrotic damage of the Missile Fist wave on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save. Objects and structures automatically fail this save. You can spend cursed energy up to your CE modifier to increase the damage by 3d8 per CE spent, counting as an additional Missile Fist.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Unrelenting Ring of Spirit
features.description: At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures take 8d8 necrotic damage and are knocked prone by giant Missile Fists. As an action, you can target any creature of your choice within your domain with a single Missile Fist without spending cursed energy.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Unrelenting Ring of Spirit
domain.description: At 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures take 8d8 necrotic damage and are knocked prone by giant Missile Fists. As an action, you can target any creature of your choice within your domain with a single Missile Fist without spending cursed energy.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Quyền Kích Luân Hồi

feats.name: Exploding Fighting Spirit
feats.description: You have learned to channel your passion for battle and fighting spirit into your cursed technique. When you hit a creature with Missile Fist, all creatures within 5 ft (other than you) take thunder damage equal to your CE modifier from the shockwaves. You can use this effect a number of times each turn equal to your proficiency bonus. When you hit a target with a Missile Fist, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that target. This bonus can stack and lasts until the end of your turn.

feats.name: Armored Missile Fist
feats.description:
As a bonus action for 2 CE, you cover your hands in Missile Fists, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

You gain a +2 bonus to AC while holding no weapons or shields.

You can use your CE modifier for attack and damage rolls using your unarmed strikes.

Your unarmed strikes deal your Missile Fist damage.

The range of your unarmed strikes becomes 10 ft.

feats.name: Titan’s Grasp
feats.description: As a reaction for 3 CE, when you or a creature within 30 ft would take damage, you interpose a Missile Fist, reducing the damage by your Missile Fist damage.

descriptionEn: You can launch a barrage of giant fists against your opponents.

name: Moon Dregs
description: Triệu hồi Thức thần sứa mang chất kịch độc độc nhất vô nhị, bảo vệ chủ nhân bằng xúc tu và làm tê liệt thần kinh kẻ địch.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Lunar Jellyfish
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you can use your action to summon a Jellyfish shikigami, which lasts for 8 hours and uses your proficiency bonus. You can spend 1 additional cursed energy to change the shikigami’s size between tiny and large as an action. Moon Dregs only takes the dodge action unless you command Moon Dregs using your bonus action each turn. You can summon Moon Dregs for free once per long rest and again for 5 cursed energy. When Moon Dregs is destroyed, it cannot be summoned again for 1 minute.

features.name: Poisonous Cursed Energy
features.description:
At 3rd level, your cursed energy has toxic properties which seep into Moon Dregs and empower it. Once per turn, when you or Moon Dregs hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can spend 1 cursed energy to cause the attack to deal an extra 2d6 poison damage. This increases to 4d6 at 6th level, 6d8 at 11th level and 6d10 at 18th level. This damage is not amplified by a critical hit.

You can replace any of your attacks on your turn with an attack from Moon Dregs.

features.name: Noxious Poison
features.description:
At 6th level, your cursed energy has become more corrosive and noxious, further seeping into Moon Dregs. When you use Poisonous Cursed Energy, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. They can repeat the saving throw at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success. While poisoned in this way, the target has a temporary level of exhaustion.

Moon Dregs can now make two attacks when it takes the attack action and can grant a creature three quarters cover while occupying a creature’s space, and full cover at 11th level.

features.name: Cleansing of Purity
features.description: At 11th level, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to Moon Dregs’ AC as well as its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores. Moon Dregs now makes three attacks when it takes the Attack action.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Liberation Rite of Water and Land
features.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have created a domain embedded with your technique. The air is filled with toxins and appears as if you are underwater, counting as difficult terrain unless you have a swim speed. Creatures are still able to breathe normally.

At initiative 20, all creatures in your domain take 8d6 poison or acid damage. Moon Dregs attacks are imbued with your guaranteed hit and there are a number of tiny jellyfish shikigami swimming around equal to your cursed energy modifier that are also imbued with your guaranteed hit. You can command them as an action. They count as Moon Dregs, can only make 1 attack, and have 30 hitpoints.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Liberation Rite of Water and Land
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have created a domain embedded with your technique. The air is filled with toxins and appears as if you are underwater, counting as difficult terrain unless you have a swim speed. Creatures are still able to breathe normally.

At initiative 20, all creatures in your domain take 8d6 poison or acid damage. Moon Dregs attacks are imbued with your guaranteed hit and there are a number of tiny jellyfish shikigami swimming around equal to your cursed energy modifier that are also imbued with your guaranteed hit. You can command them as an action. They count as Moon Dregs, can only make 1 attack, and have 30 hitpoints.
