feats.name: Immortal Jellyfish
feats.description: You have learned to reinforce your shikigami with cursed energy. As part of the bonus action to command Moon Dregs, you can spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to give Moon Dregs 5 temporary hit points per Cursed Energy spent. This increases to 10 temporary hit points per cursed energy at 11th level.

feats.name: Adorable Poison Jar
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Poisonous Cursed Energy
feats.description:
You have learned to refine your poisons within Moon Dregs to create powerful mixtures. You gain the following benefits:

Moon Dregs deals an additional 1d6 poison damage on a hit. This increases to 2d6 at 6th level and 3d8 at 11th level.

A creature grappled by Moon Dregs takes 2d4 poison damage at the beginning of their turn. This increases to 2d8 poison damage at 11th level.

Poison can also be used as an enhancer. You gain 4 ability points you can use to increase Moon Dregs ability scores (max of 20).

feats.name: Maximum: Crippling Neurotoxin
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Cleansing of Purity
feats.description:
You have finally learned to amplify your poisonous cursed energy into a crippling neurotoxin that locks down nerves. When you use Poisonous Cursed Energy, you can spend 8 additional cursed energy to enhance the poison. If a creature fails their save against Noxious Poison they are stunned until the end of their next turn and poisoned for 8 hours. On a successful save, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. A creature poisoned in this way is treated as being under 3 temporary levels of exhaustion. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, they are paralyzed until the end of their next turn and poisoned for 24 hours.

This poison ignores cursed techniques that grant resistance, immunity, or other reductions to poison damage and the poisoned condition. This poison cannot be removed by cursed techniques or reverse cursed technique.

descriptionEn: Your technique forms a poison unique to you and comes with your own shikigami to help manifest it.

name: Mythical Beast Amber
description: Thuật thức sinh mạng của Hajime Kashimo: biến đổi toàn bộ cơ thể thành dòng điện thuần túy, vượt qua giới hạn con người với cái giá là cái chết.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Electric Energy
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you may not know your cursed technique yet, but you have gained insane mastery over your energy. Once per turn when you deal damage with a melee attack, you can spend 1 cursed energy to add 1d10 lightning damage to the total amount. This increases to 2d10 at 3rd level, 3d10 at 6th level, 4d10 at 11th level, to 5d10 at 14th level, and to 6d10 at 18th level.

features.name: Lightning Body
features.description: At 3rd level, your cursed energy is always electrifying your whole body, making your reactions instant. Your eyes gain marks of lightning around them, as a sign of your energy always refilling you. You can now add your Cursed Energy modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Lightning Discharge
features.description:
When you reach 6th level, your control over your technique has improved to the point where you are able to separate the charges of electricity. After hitting a creature with Electric Energy you can mark the creature with a positive charge for 1 minute. You can have a number of charges on a target equal to twice your Cursed Energy Modifier. As an action you can expend charges to release a lightning bolt at one creature within 60 ft which heads straight for the accumulated charges dealing a number of d12s equal to the number of charges.

Starting at 11th level, this gains the limb-removing effect of the Limb Damage Table.

features.name: Mythical Beast Amber Release
features.description:
Once you reach 11th level, you have finally learned your innate technique and its terrible cost. Once activated, this technique reconstructs the user's flesh in order to manifest phenomena that can be created by electricity, which is converted from the user's cursed energy. However, since the technique causes the user's body to surpass the limits of a human, it can only be used once before their body collapses following the technique's conclusion. As an action for 8 cursed energy, your body will start getting filled with electric cursed energy, making you constantly grow in power for a short period of time. You start at Stage 1 and every 5 rounds, you gain the next stage. As a bonus action, you can spend CE to expedite your transformation by 1 round per 2 CE. You can deactivate your form at any moment as a bonus action, however, depending on what stage you reached, your deactivation causes more backlash. After your fifth round in Stage 5, it instantly ends, making you die instantly:

Your body will slowly alter itself while in this form, gaining the following as it progresses.

Cursed Claw(Stage 1). When you activate this form, your cursed energy will surround your hands and increase your overall attack power. Your unarmed strikes now deal one of the following damage types: Thunder, Lightning, Fire, Force, or Cold, and will deal one additional damage dice + 1d10 Lightning damage.

Loud Blast(Stage 2). When you reach Stage 2 in this form, your mouth will start to get covered with cursed energy, allowing you to emit loud energy blasts from your mouth. As an action, make a cursed energy attack roll against a creature within 30 ft. On a hit it deals 6d10 lightning damage. Hit or miss, all creatures within 15 ft of the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d6 thunder damage and are deafened until the beginning of your next turn. On a success, they take half as much.

Lightning Armor(Stage 3). When you reach Stage 3 in this form, your torso and legs will start to get filled with cursed energy. You will gain damage reduction equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

X-Ray Vision(Stage 4). When you reach Stage 4 in this form, your head is completely filled with cursed energy, even granting you new eyes. You will gain 120 feet of truesight, and will also be able to see all the features one creature of your choice has as a bonus action.

Cursed Beam(Stage 5). When you reach Stage 5 in this form, your very cursed energy has been improved. As an action for 6 cursed energy, you launch a huge cursed energy beam in a 30-foot line, forcing every creature in that line to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 10d10 force damage and are blinded until the beginning of your next turn. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not blinded. You can spend up to 4 additional cursed energy, with each one adding 1d10 force damage and a +1 to its DC.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Lightning God’s Realm
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your control over your energy into a domain expansion. Starting at initiative 20, all creatures in your domain gains 3 positive charges without a charge limit.

You must make a DC:30 Constitution saving throw, on a failure you will gain 6 levels of exhaustion. On a success, you suffer only 5.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Lightning God’s Realm
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your control over your energy into a domain expansion. Starting at initiative 20, all creatures in your domain gains 3 positive charges without a charge limit.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Lôi Thần Linh Vực

feats.name: Defensive Surge
feats.description: Your Cursed Energy has gained a defensive property. As a reaction to being hit by a melee attack, you can spend 2 CE to force the attacker to make a Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

feats.name: Imbued Weapon
feats.description: You have learned how to further manipulate your lightning. On a hit with a melee attack using a weapon it also gains a charge, and as a bonus action you can release a bolt of lightning between the weapon and yourself. Those caught in that bolt of lightning must make a Dexterity save, taking your Lightning Discharge damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

feats.name: Grounded Charge
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Mythical Beast Amber Release
feats.description: Through repeated usage of your cursed technique's release your body has grown used to the manifestation of phenomena.  The side effects of using Mythical Beast Amber: Release are reduced by 1 stage. This causes stage 0 to have no side effects.

descriptionEn: You hold a technique that changes the very essence of your energy to electricity. However, its true power is unknown even to you.

name: New Shadow Style
description: Kiếm phái bí truyền do Kusakabe Sadatsuna sáng lập: làm chủ Giản Dị Lãnh Địa, Bạt Đao Thuật và Tịch Lưu để đối kháng lại Lãnh địa của kẻ mạnh.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: New Shadow Style: Simple Domain
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you gain the Simple Domain feat with the following benefits:

You can activate Simple Domain for free a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus each long rest

You can activate Simple Domain as a bonus action

The area of Simple Domain can be up to 15 feet instead of 10

features.name: Batto Sword Draw
features.description: At 3rd level, you have learned the fastest technique of the New Shadow Style. As an action for 3 CE while wielding a melee weapon, you can make one attack roll with advantage against a number of targets equal to your proficiency bonus within half of your movement speed and reach. You end your turn behind the farthest target without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Evening Moon Sword Drawing
features.cost: CE up to your cursed energy modifier to deal an additional damage die for each CE spent
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, you enter a crouched stance. When a creature willingly moves in or out of your Simple Domain you can make a weapon attack against them. On a hit, you can choose to either spend CE up to your cursed energy modifier to deal an additional damage die for each CE spent, or you can gain a bonus to your AC and saving throws equal to the CE spent until the beginning of your next turn. You can only make this attack once per round per creature, meaning you can use it once against each creature.

features.name: Moonlight Veil
features.description: Starting at 11th level, you can spend 1 cursed energy as a bonus action to imbue your weapon with your simple domain for 1 minute. You can add your Cursed Energy modifier to attack and damage rolls of melee weapon attacks or unarmed strikes. When you use this technique, you ignore any penalties for using a broken weapon.

features.name: Perfect Shadow Style
features.description:
Finally, at 18th level, you manage to reach the peak of New Shadow Style. Your Simple Domain gains the following benefits:

Simple Domain costs no cursed energy.

You can freely move and maintain Simple Domain.

The range of any of New Shadow Style techniques can be increased to up to 60 feet as a bonus action until the end of your turn

When you expand the range of your Simple Domain over a creature, you can make two weapon attacks against a single creature as a free action (regardless of range). You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus each long rest.

feats.name: True New Shadow Style
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have New Shadow Style: Simple Domain
feats.description: Your Simple Domain now has additional hit points equal to twice your Cursed Energy modifier.

feats.name: Instantaneous Attack
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Batto Sword Draw
feats.description: You have learned the fastest way to draw defensively. Once per round after activating Simple Domain, you can make a melee attack against someone who enters it.

feats.name: First Strike
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Evening Moon Sword Drawing
feats.description: You have honed your reaction speed to the finest edge. When you roll initiative you can activate Simple Domain or make an attack as a free action.

feats.name: Maculation
feats.description: As an action for up to 6 cursed energy, you create up to 6 smaller Simple Domains on the ground within 30 ft of yourself that each cover a 5 ft space for 1 minute. Each Maculation functions as a Simple Domain with hit points equal to 5 x your proficiency bonus. While standing in a space with Maculation, you can use your reaction to either gain a +3 bonus to AC or reduce incoming damage by your weapon's damage until the beginning of your next turn. A Maculation disappears if you end your turn more than 30 ft away from one.

descriptionEn: You are born with no innate technique, but in order to make up you learn a special secret. A domain for the weak.

name: Pachinko Fever
description: Bành trướng Lãnh địa sòng bạc Pachinko của Kinji Hakari: quay trúng Jackpot để bước vào 4 phút 11 giây bất tử với lượng Chú lực vô hạn.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Great Luck
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, luck has sided with you, and you can use it against your foes. Once per long rest you can force one of your rolls to be critical (cannot roll for black flash).

features.name: Domain Expansion: Idle Death Gamble
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain access to your domain expansion.  Once per long rest you can expand your domain for free bringing you and all creatures of your choice within 175 feet to a demiplane that resembles a subway station as music starts playing. This domain is Non-Lethal with Anti-Domain Clash as listed in Non-Lethal Domains and cannot be reacted to unless the opposing user has a domain with at least 400 refinement points and has higher refinement than you.

You gain three types of Pachinko attacks that can be used as a bonus action, each attack increases the "expectation" by a percentage.

Green Balls. As a bonus action for 1 cursed energy, make a ranged cursed energy attack roll against a target within 30ft. It deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage on a hit and raises expectations by 10%.

Red Rod. As a bonus action for 3 cursed energy, make a melee cursed energy attack roll against a target. It deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit and raises expectations by 25%.

Golden Train Door Attack. As a bonus action for 4 cursed energy, make a melee or ranged cursed energy attack roll against a target within 30ft. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage and must make a Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of your turn. This attack increases expectations by 50%.

You can consume the expectation at any time by using your bonus action to place your bet and causing an event to take place.

There are 4 possible types of events. To know which event will happen, you must roll a d20 + your expectation bonus. You get a +1 bonus for every 10% Expectation, to a maximum of +19 at 190%.

Once an event starts, roll a d10 to see how many rounds the event lasts. If your domain ends, you immediately roll.

At the end of the event, you must roll a d20 (also adding expectation to this roll, +1 per 10%) to find out if you win the multiplier bonus or the rare "Rainbow" bonus. You can reroll all jackpot dice an amount of times equal to your multiplier, if "Rainbow" lands you have an automatic jackpot in that event. At the end of the event you will roll 3dX, with the value of the dice defined by the event. If 3 of the same numbers land, you win a jackpot. When you hit a jackpot the domain expansion is undone without the effects of Technique Burnout, your cursed energy becomes infinite, and you become immortal.

You gain the following benefits for 4 Rounds:

Your cursed energy completely refuels at the beginning of your turn.

You will receive the effects of Reverse Cursed Technique as if you have spent cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier at the beginning of your turns. In addition, you cannot go below 1 hit point and heal all injuries.

You regain one free use of Idle Death Gamble.

After spending all of your uses, you can use your domain again for 20 Cursed Energy.

features.name: On a Roll
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, after activating Idle Death Gamble and getting a Jackpot, you gain advantage when making your Event roll or Multiplier roll within your next domain.

features.name: The Fever
features.description:
When you achieve the 11th level, after entering your jackpot, you start gathering fever points. Once per round when you are lowered to one hit point, you gain a fever point. You can have a number of them up to your proficiency bonus and unused fever points disappear at the end of combat. You can use one of your fever points to gain one of the following effects:

You can choose to land a critical hit (cannot black flash)

You gain an additional action

Add a +10 to a saving throw or ability check

features.name: Luckiest Sorcerer Alive
features.description:
At 18th level , you now roll 3d20 when deciding your multiplier, and can choose which roll you want. Your reverse cursed technique makes you regain hit points as if you had spent a number of cursed energy equal to twice your Cursed Energy modifier, and you can use Reverse Cursed Technique as a free action while you have the jackpot bonus.

In addition, your jackpot duration is now a number of minutes equal to your Cursed Energy modifier (min of 1).

tables: Can they get to the bathroom?

feats.name: Contagious Luck
feats.description: Your luck seems to spread to those around you. You can use Great Luck on another creature of your choice instead of yourself.

feats.name: Pachinko Manifest
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Idle Death Gamble
feats.description: Through thorough understanding of your domain, you can now manifest Pachinko Attacks outside your domain and have a 30 foot range when used this way. Whenever you use a Pachinko Attack, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage rolls. Additionally, you reduce the Cursed Energy cost of your Pachinko Attacks by 1 CE. This reduces the CE cost of Green Balls to 0 CE, but cannot reduce the CE cost of other Pachinko Attacks to 0 CE (minimum of 1). These attacks do not build Expectation.

feats.name: Maximum: Love Train
feats.description: You have fully understood the essence of your technique. As an action for 10 Cursed Energy, you can summon the Love Train. This is a 200 foot long, 20 feet wide Line attack in which a creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they are launched 200 feet and take 15d6 bludgeoning damage. The train is summoned on a space of your choice within 30ft, and the opponent is launched in the opposite direction.

descriptionEn: Did you know most gamblers stop before their big hit? Let's hope you don’t, as failing may mean death, but your luck has got you.

name: Pain Killer
description: Ngăn chặn cơn đau và khóa chặt vết thương không cho trở nên trầm trọng hơn, giúp bản thân và đồng đội tiếp tục chiến đấu ngoan cường.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Pain Killer
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you can use your technique to stop injuries from getting worse. As a bonus action for 1 CE, you can make a symbol with your hand and touch a creature within 5 feet. If a creature is taking damage over time, you cause that damage to stop and the creature gains temporary hit points equal to your CE modifier + your level for 1 hour. This does not stop new effects from affecting the target. You also gain proficiency in Medicine.

features.name: Practiced Hands
features.description: At 3rd level, you can use Pain Killer on all willing creatures within 5 feet as a free action on your turn, spending 1 CE for each creature. This increases to 10 feet at 6th level and 15 feet at 11th level.

features.name: Pain Breaker
features.description: At 6th level, when you use Pain Killer on a creature, they also lose one condition of your choice and if they are making death saves they are immediately stabilized. You now gain Expertise in Medicine.

features.name: Analgesic
features.description: At 11th level, when a creature that you can see within 10 feet would take damage, as a reaction for 4 CE you can halve the damage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Medical Clinic
features.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you and all creatures of your choice fall under the effects of Pain Killer. You can use Analgesic as a free action for no cursed energy without a reaction, but only once per damage instance.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Medical Clinic
domain.description: Finally at 18th level you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you and all creatures of your choice fall under the effects of Pain Killer. You can use Analgesic as a free action for no cursed energy without a reaction, but only once per damage instance.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Dã Chiến Y Viện

feats.name: Dull Pain
feats.description: A creature under the effects of Pain Killer now gains additional temporary hit points equal to 5 times your proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Long Lasting Medicine
feats.description: A creature now gains the benefits of Pain Killer for 24 hours and is automatically stabilized if they are reduced to 0 hit points while under the effect.

feats.name: Maximum: Panacea
feats.description: As a reaction to a creature within 10 feet (including yourself) falling to 0 hit points you can spend 4 CE and cause them to instead remain at 10 hit points and gain the benefits of Pain Killer.

descriptionEn: While you cannot heal, you can stop injuries from getting worse.

name: Paralyzing Gaze
description: Phóng thích Chú lực qua ánh nhìn thôi miên, làm tê liệt toàn thân và khóa cứng cử động của đối thủ khi hai ánh mắt chạm nhau.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Immobilizing Eyes
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to slow anyone you have within line of sight. As an action for 2 CE, you force a creature within 60 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, their movement speed is halved and their attack rolls and AC are reduced by your Cursed Energy modifier until the beginning of your next turn. At the beginning of your next turn, you can spend 1 CE as a bonus action to maintain the technique. If you lose line of sight, the technique automatically ends.

Using your technique places extreme strain on your eyes. Your eyes have a number of hit points equal to 1/3rd of your maximum hit points(rounded up). Your eyes take 1 damage for every 1 a creature rolls above your save DC to resist your technique. Your eyes regain 1 hit point at the beginning of your turn, unless at 0 hit points. Any HP you regain affects your eyes as well.  If your eyes reach 0 hit points, you are blinded and they can’t regain hit points unless by Reverse Cursed Technique or long rest.

features.name: Peripheral Vision
features.description: At 3rd level, you have trained your peripheral vision to lock down multiple targets at once. When you use Immobilizing Eyes, you instead spend a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) to affect a number of creatures up to your Cursed Energy modifier, spending 1 CE for every creature beyond the first. You must spend 1 CE for each targeted creature to maintain your technique against them.

features.name: Reactive Eye Movement
features.description: At 6th level, whenever a target you can see makes an attack roll while within 60 ft or the attack is against you, you can spend 2 CE to force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they have disadvantage on the attack roll. A creature under the effects of Immobilizing Eyes automatically fails this saving throw.

features.name: Maximum: Paralyzing Gaze
features.description: At 11th level, you have learned to completely paralyze targets with your technique. Your eyes' hit points increase to 1/2 of your maximum hit points (rounded up). As an action for 6 cursed energy, you force a creature you can see within 120 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are paralyzed and have their AC reduced by your Cursed Energy modifier. You must maintain concentration on the technique as if concentrating on a spell and at the beginning of your turn by spending 2 CE as a bonus action. However, focusing your power to this extent leaves you vulnerable. The target can make an Strength (Athletics) check at the end of their turn. On a success, your eyes take 2 damage for every 1 they rolled above your Cursed Energy save DC (damage to your eyes does not force a concentration check). A creature paralyzed by this technique cannot be physically moved, even remaining suspended in the air.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Chamber of Fractured Reflections
features.description: At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, three creatures of your choice within the domain suffer the effects of Immobilizing Eyes. At each initiative 20, you can change the target for your domain’s guaranteed hit effect. The domain takes the appearance of several mirrors that reflect your gaze from every angle, making line of sight impossible to break within the domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Chamber of Fractured Reflections
domain.description: At 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, three creatures of your choice within the domain suffer the effects of Immobilizing Eyes. At each initiative 20, you can change the target for your domain’s guaranteed hit effect. The domain takes the appearance of several mirrors that reflect your gaze from every angle, making line of sight impossible to break within the domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Vỡ Vụn Kính Thất

feats.name: Immobilized Limbs
feats.description:
When you use Immobilizing Eyes, you can spend 1 additional CE as part of activating the technique concentrate your eyes on a specific part of the creature, also causing one of the following restrictions while you maintain your technique:

Legs. The target’s speed is halved. If the target tries to move more than their movement speed, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

Arms. The target gains an additional -3 penalty to attack rolls and cannot take object interactions.

feats.name: Torso. You reduce the target’s AC by 3.
feats.description:
Destructive Gaze

As part of your bonus action while maintaining your technique on a creature, the target takes 2d8 psychic damage. This increases to 2d10 at 6th level, 4d8 at 11th level, and 6d8 at 18th level.

feats.name: Eye Drops
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Reactive Eye Movement
feats.description: Through constant exposure, your eyes have become surprisingly tough. Whenever your eyes take damage, the damage is halved. When your eyes’ hit points would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw for your eyes to stay at 1 hit point. If you have Reverse Cursed Technique, you automatically succeed. You can make this saving throw a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus each long rest.

descriptionEn: Your technique allows you to paralyze others with a mere gaze.

name: Prayer Song
description: Hòa quyện điệu nhảy cầu nguyện và nhịp phách khắc sâu vào xương tủy, thanh tẩy tâm trí và nâng bước đồng minh trên chiến trường.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Prayer
features.description: Starting at 1st level, as a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy you can start catching the beat of a fight. The effects depend on how long it has been active and end if you are stunned, paralyzed, grappled, restrained, or knocked prone.

features.name: Marcado
features.description: At 3rd level, you give certain blows more of a kick. Once per turn for 1 CE, you deal 2 additional damage dice on an attack.

features.name: Caesura
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you learn to make openings and stop your enemy’s tempo. As a reaction while dancing, you force a creature you see to reroll an attack roll, damage roll, or saving throw.

features.name: Crescendo
features.description: Starting at 11th level, your abilities improve and find new heights. Only you gain these benefits against a creature you are fighting.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Dance Dance Revolution
features.description: At 18th level, you gain the pinnacle of your technique. When inside your domain, you always count as if ten turns passed with Prayer activated.

tables: Your AC and Dex Saves increase by +2
You can add your Cursed Energy modifier to your attack rolls
Your opponent has disadvantage on attacks and you have advantage on saving throws
Your attacks deal additional damage equal to your proficiency
Your AC and Dex Saves increase by +3
You can add your Cursed Energy modifier to your attack and damage rolls
Your opponent has disadvantage on attacks and you have advantage on saving throws
Your attacks deal additional damage equal to your proficiency
Your opponent has their damage decreased by your proficiency
You gain an extra attack when you take the attack action
Your opponent's AC drops by a total of 5, and gains a -5 to saves.
Your opponent can only take an action, bonus action, or movement on their turn.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Dance Dance Revolution
domain.description: At 18th level, you gain the pinnacle of your technique. When inside your domain, you always count as if ten turns passed with Prayer activated.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Vũ Điệu Cách Mạng

feats.name: Fortissimo
feats.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack while Prayer is active, you can spend 3 CE to deal maximum damage.

feats.name: Cadence
feats.description: You put a full stop to the rhythm of your enemy. As a reaction, you can spend 3 CE to make an attack miss, or spend 5 CE to make a creature fail a saving throw.

feats.name: Maximum: Double Time
feats.description: As an action for 3 CE, you double the tempo of your song and the battle. You treat every turn as if two turns passed.

descriptionEn: Through dance and the beat engraved in your body, you gain the ability to buff yourself and debuff your opponent even without a domain.

name: Projection Sorcery
description: Thuật thức gia truyền của gia tộc Zen'in: chia 1 giây thành 24 khung hình chuyển động (24 FPS), di chuyển với tốc độ siêu thanh và đóng băng kẻ vi phạm quy tắc.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Projection
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you learn the projection technique, which gives you the possibility to divide 1 second into 24 frames which allows you to move faster. As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, your walking speed increases by 10 feet and you will gain an additional attack on your Attack Action. However, this cursed technique is not perfect as you cannot change your movement course once you start, so when your turn ends you pick the spot you want to move to, due to your speed it will be impossible to change course. If you do not end your turn in that space, your speed becomes 0 until the end of your next turn. You must spend 1 Cursed Energy at the beginning of your turns to keep this cursed technique active.

features.name: Acceleration
features.description: When you get to 3rd level, for every consecutive turn with Projection active your movement speed increases by 10 feet. If you charge in a straight line building momentum you can deal an additional d6 for every 10 feet on your next melee attack.

features.name: 24 Frame Rule
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, you have learned how to affect creatures with the 24 FPS rule, making them become stuck in one frame of animation. While your cursed technique is active, when you hit an unarmed strike on a creature you can choose to deal no damage by spending 2 Cursed Energy, forcing the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure they will be stuck in one frame of animation, making them stunned until the beginning of your next turn. The creature loses its stunned condition early if it is hit by an attack which will automatically count as a critical. This critical ignores damage resistance and treats damage immunity as resistance.

features.name: Fastest Sorcerer Alive
features.description:
At 11th level, due to your advanced studies, you can now reach a higher speed level than any sorcerer ever could. While your cursed technique is active, you will gain the following benefits:

You gain +30 feet to your walking speed.

You gain +20 feet to your walking speed at the beginning of your turns.

You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Your Dexterity score increases by +2 ignoring your maximum.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Lunar Palace Womb of Time
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you reach the pinnacle of Projection Sorcery. All creatures in your domain take 8d10 Necrotic damage when they move or take any type of action, since their cells don't follow the 24fps rule.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Lunar Palace Womb of Time
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level, you reach the pinnacle of Projection Sorcery. All creatures in your domain take 8d10 Necrotic damage when they move or take any type of action, since their cells don't follow the 24fps rule.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thời Bảo Nguyệt Cung Điện

feats.name: White Space
feats.description: As a reaction to an attack or damaging effect, you can spend 2 cursed energy to create a number of blank animation frames to absorb any damage. Roll a number of d10s equal to 2 + your CE modifier. Any damage you take before the start of your next turn instead damages these blank frames, but you take any remaining damage.

feats.name: Air Shatter
feats.description: As an action for 4 cursed energy, you create a 5 ft wide, 30 foot long line of frames in the air that you explosively break. All creatures in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw or take a number d10s in force damage equal to your CE modifier and are knocked prone. On a failed save, they take half as much damage.

feats.name: Maximum: Sakuga
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Fastest Sorcerer Alive
feats.description:
When you activate your cursed energy you can force it past its limit for short periods of time. For an additional cursed energy per round, you also gain the following effects in addition to the other effects of your technique:

Your speed is doubled

You gain advantage on Dexterity saves

Your Dexterity score increases by +2, ignoring your maximum

An additional action on each of your turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack action (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

descriptionEn: You were born with one of the praised techniques of the Zenin Clan, turning animation into reality.

name: Puppet Manipulation
description: Điều khiển đội quân rối chú thuật từ cự ly vạn dặm bằng Chú lực, đỉnh cao là cỗ máy khổng lồ Ultimate Mechamaru mang hỏa lực tối thượng.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Ultimate Mechamaru
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you gain mastery over puppets. You gain proficiency in Tinkerer’s Tools, and over a long rest, you can create a puppet. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can imbue a Puppet, this puppet can only have 2 Minor Traits. You can summon as many puppets as you want. Any Puppets can only take an action if you use your bonus action to command it. It cannot use its reaction unless you use your reaction to command it to. The puppet can use bonus actions on its own. You can speak, hear, and see through any of your Puppets. In case you have more than one puppet at once, you need to control them at the same time. Whenever you gain a puppet, use the following for its sheet:

Your Puppet's starting Strength, Constitution, and Dexterity scores are 15, 14, and 13 + bonus points to distribute between them equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. The Puppet's mental scores equal to your own.

Your Puppet is a Medium Construct.

Your Puppet has its hit dice based on what material they are made from, if the case is wood is a d4, stone is a d6, iron is a d8, and modern metal hit die is a d10. Your puppet has the same amount of hit die as you.

Your Puppet has a 30 feet walking speed.

You control your Puppet from afar, watching its every move and controlling it to dodge attacks. Your Puppet's AC is equal to 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

Your Puppet uses your proficiency bonus and is immune to the charmed and poisoned condition.

Your Puppet gains proficiency in Strength, Constitution, and Dexterity saving throws.

Your Puppet deals 1d6 + Strength modifier in bludgeoning with unarmed strikes.

features.name: Lesser Puppet
features.description: At 3rd level, you have begun to slowly improve your puppet. You will gain a Lesser Puppet and can summon it as an action for 3 Cursed Energy, though this Puppet can only have 2 Minor Traits and 2 Lesser Traits.

features.name: Advanced Puppet
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, through the constant use of your puppet, you have begun to fix some of its downfalls. You will gain an Advanced Puppet and can summon it as an action for 6 Cursed Energy, though this Puppet can only have 2 Minor Traits, 2 Lesser Traits, and 2 Advanced Traits.

features.name: Absolute Puppet
features.description: When you reach 11th level, you have perfected your puppet for its desired uses. You will gain a Master Puppet and can summon it as an action for 10 Cursed Energy, though this Puppet can only have 2 Minor Traits, 2 Lesser Traits, 2 Advanced Traits, and 2 Absolute Traits.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Puppet Show
features.description:
Finally, at 18th level, you reach the peak of your technique. Your manipulation is now no longer limited to puppets. You can now manipulate the creatures in your domain like puppets in a puppet show.

At initiative 20, all creatures take an action of your choice that does not cost cursed energy.

tables: Enhanced Defense. Your Puppet's defenses were increased so that he could fare better against attacks. Its armor class is increased to 10 + its Dexterity modifier + your Cursed Energy modifier. Basic Weapon Training. Your puppet gains proficiency in simple weapons and shields. Faster Movement. Your puppet is fast and cannot be caught so easily. Your puppet gains a +10 ft bonus to its walking speed. Stronger Strikes. Your puppet gains better natural weapons, changing its unarmed strikes to deal 1d8 piercing, slashing, or bludgeoning damage, based on the new weapons. Your puppet's unarmed strikes will now overcome resistance. Your puppet can use dexterity or strength for these attacks. Heightened Senses. Your puppet is always sharp and is a perfect detection machine. He will gain 60 ft. of Darkvision and will gain advantage in perception checks against living things.

Improved Reach. Your puppet's arms elongate, its agility heightens, or it grows tentacles, and your puppet's melee reach increases by 5 feet. Advanced Weapon Training. Your puppet gains proficiency in martial weapons. Hardened Shell. Your puppet's shell is thicker, scalier, or harder than normal. Your Puppet will gain resistance against non-magical Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing damage. Deflect Missiles. Your puppet has developed quick reaction skills, and can now defend itself from high-speed ranged projectiles. Using its reaction, your puppet can reduce an incoming projectile damage by 1d12 + your level. Minor Magic. Your puppet learns to cast one cantrip, and one 1st level spell, both from the wizard spell list(no healing). It uses its Cursed Energy modifier for the spellcasting ability and must take a long rest before casting the 1st-level spell again.

Colossus. Your puppet's body increases in size in all dimensions, changing its size to Large. This functions like the enlarge/reduce spell. Flying Behemoth. Your puppet gains wings, jets, or some other way of flight, giving it flight speed equal to its movement speed. Major Magic. Your puppet learns to cast one cantrip, one 1st level spell, one 2nd level spell, and one 3rd level spell, all from the wizard spell list (no healing). It uses its Cursed Energy modifier for the spellcasting ability, casts the three spells at 3rd level, and can only use each spell once before they must take a long rest to use it again. Armor Training. Your puppet gains proficiency in all armor. High Caliber Striker. Your puppet's natural weapons improve further, growing stronger, harder, or sharper. Your puppet's unarmed strikes now deal 2d8 piercing, slashing, or bludgeoning damage. Your puppet can use dexterity or strength for these attacks.

Mech. Your puppet's body increases in size in all dimensions, changing its size to Gargantuan. However, to control this puppet you must be inside it, but you are under full cover, and the puppet's Hit dice is a d12. Energy Cannon. As an action, you generate a large amount of cursed energy in the palm of one hand, blasting it at a target for 6 CE. Make a ranged attack with Dex + Proficiency + 3, This attack deals 20d6 Necrotic damage and recharges on a 5-6 d6. Energy Volley. As an action, you create 5 orbs made of cursed energy and blast them. Choose targets for each orb and make a ranged Cursed Energy attack with a +3 for 4 CE. On a hit, this attack Deals 6d6 Necrotic damage. Recharges on a 5-6 d6.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Puppet Show
domain.description:
Finally, at 18th level, you reach the peak of your technique. Your manipulation is now no longer limited to puppets. You can now manipulate the creatures in your domain like puppets in a puppet show.

At initiative 20, all creatures take an action of your choice that does not cost cursed energy.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Khôi Lỗi Kịch Trường

feats.name: Puppet Armor
feats.description: As an action, you can wear one of your puppets within 5 ft. This gives you your puppets HP as temporary hit points, as well as traits and physical ability scores and also increases your AC by 2. You can only wear one Puppet at a time and cannot command this Puppet.

feats.name: Communication Puppets
feats.description: After one long rest, you create a small puppet that can fit on the palm of your hand. This puppet holds a copy of consciousness when you created it and has enough charge for five minutes. You can have a number equal to your proficiency bonus and anything learned by one is shared to all. These can be activated as a free action or set to activate after a specific trigger.

feats.name: Maximum: Ultimate Puppet
feats.description: You gain the ability to make a puppet of your Ultimate Puppet. This puppet can have double the traits, however it also costs double the resources, time, and Cursed Energy to create.

descriptionEn: You gain the ability to control puppets with your Cursed Energy,

name: Ratio
description: Thuật thức của Kento Nanami: cưỡng ép chia mục tiêu theo tỷ lệ 7:3 để tạo ra điểm yếu chí mạng, biến đòn đánh vào điểm đó thành đòn bộc phát uy lực.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Critical Focus
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you gain a +1 to critical range. Additionally, you roll an additional damage dice on a critical hit.

features.name: Ratio
features.description:
Once you reach 3rd level, you have learned your technique that creates weak spots in enemies. Whenever you hit an attack, you can spend 1 cursed energy to roll a d10. If you roll a 3 or 7 the attack becomes a critical hit.

You now roll 2 additional damage dice on a critical hit.

features.name: Collapse
features.description:
When you reach 6th level, as an action for 4 Cursed Energy, you make an attack to destroy the ground around you in a 30 ft circle, applying your critical hit to the rubble. The area becomes difficult terrain and every creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take your attack’s damage + 3d10 bludgeoning damage. On a success, they take half as much damage.

You now roll 3 additional damage dice on a critical hit.

features.name: Improved Ratio
features.description: At 11th level, you have become more lethal and precise with your Ratio. When you use Ratio, you now roll 2d10 instead of one and you can spend additional CE up to your Cursed Energy modifier to roll an additional d10 per CE spent. You roll 4 additional damage dice on a critical hit.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Golden Ratio
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your skill with your technique to a fine edge. In your domain, all of your attacks count as critical hits and you deal an additional 5 damage dice on a critical hit.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Golden Ratio
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your skill with your technique to a fine edge. In your domain, all of your attacks count as critical hits and you deal an additional 5 damage dice on a critical hit.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tỷ Lệ Vàng

feats.name: Focused Attacks
feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your critical range.

feats.name: Weapon Breaker
feats.description: You focus your Ratio on your opponent’s weapon. When you are targeted by a weapon attack, you can spend 5 CE as a reaction to create and hit a vulnerable ratio point on their weapon, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the weapon breaks. If the weapon is a cursed tool, you must use a tool of equal or greater rank to break it, otherwise the attack fails. If used against an unarmed strike, it is treated as a limb damaging effect using the Limb Damage table. Roll critical damage with your weapon. If you deal the required damage, you break the limb. Either way, the target takes no damage and this feature cannot remove a limb.

feats.name: Maximum: Deadly Ratio
feats.description: For an additional 6 Cursed Energy, when you land a critical hit using ratio your target automatically loses a limb that is not the head or torso, using the limb damage table.

descriptionEn: You were born with a powerful technique that creates a weak spot on a 7:3 ratio

name: Regalia
description: Niêm phong linh hồn của chính mình vào bên trong một món Chú cụ hộ mệnh, biến cơ thể thành pháo đài thép kiên cố không thể xuyên thủng.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Regalia
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can manifest your Regalia as an action for 2 CE for a number of hours equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. Your Regalia takes the form of a simple or martial melee weapon of your choice, such as Dagger or a Shortsword. You are proficient with the weapon and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls using your Regalia. Once per turn on a hit you can spend 1 CE to deal an additional 1d8 necrotic damage. This becomes 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 6th level, 4d8 at 11th level and 6d8 at 18th level.

Your Regalia disappears if it is more than 30 feet away from you and cannot be wielded by other creatures.

features.name: Cursed Wave
features.description: At 3rd level, you have learned greater control over your Regalia. For 1 CE, you can make one of your attacks with your Regalia into a cutting wave of cursed energy. This creates a 5 ft wide 30 ft long line. Creatures in range must make a Dexterity save, taking the damage of your regalia in necrotic damage on a failed save.

features.name: Divine Protection
features.description:
At 6th level, the seal further loosens, granting you more abilities.

Your Regalia now has a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. This increases to a +3 bonus at 11th level and +4 at 18th level.

Your Regalia now has a pool of hit points equal to 5 times your level. When you take damage, you can spend 1 cursed energy as a reaction to damage to cause that damage to instead target the regalia’s pool.

If this hit point pool is reduced to 0 hit points, you take any remaining damage and your regalia breaks and must be resummoned. When broken, your regalia can be resummoned a number of times equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. Otherwise, you cannot summon your regalia until you complete a long rest.

features.name: Soul Bound Treasure
features.description:
At 11th level, your control over your Soul Regalia has loosened nearly all of the seal. Your regalia is now a special grade cursed tool. Work with your GM to decide what its technique is.

As an action, you can spend 10 cursed energy to cause your regalia to hover for 1 minute. Your regalia has an AC equal to 12 + your cursed energy modifier + your proficiency bonus and hit points equal to its pool while hovering. The regalia is destroyed if reduced to 0 hit points. You gain the following actions:

As an action you can command the weapon to move up to 100 feet and can make any attacks on your turn originate from the Regalia as if you were wielding it. You can use your cursed energy modifier for attack and damage rolls for these attacks.

As an action, you can cause your regalia to move in a 100 foot line attack, appearing at the end of the line if it is a melee weapon. All creatures within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your regalia damage on a hit.

After the minute is up, the Soul Regalia moves 100 ft towards you, attempting to return. If unable to, it falls to the ground.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Cursed Soul Armory
features.description: At 18th level, the seal is completely removed as you have perfected a domain expansion that you put your soul into. The domain is filled with numerous types of Lesser Regalia in the form of random weapons. At initiative 20, the Lesser Regalia will attack any enemies within the domain, dealing 8d10 necrotic damage. Additionally, you can use Soul Bound Treasure as an action without spending any cursed energy. In your domain it has immunity to all damage and you can use one of its actions once per turn as a free action.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Cursed Soul Armory
domain.description: At 18th level, the seal is completely removed as you have perfected a domain expansion that you put your soul into. The domain is filled with numerous types of Lesser Regalia in the form of random weapons. At initiative 20, the Lesser Regalia will attack any enemies within the domain, dealing 8d10 necrotic damage. Additionally, you can use Soul Bound Treasure as an action without spending any cursed energy. In your domain it has immunity to all damage and you can use one of its actions once per turn as a free action.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Chú Hồn Binh Khí Khố

feats.name: Regalia Versatility
feats.description: You have learned to alter your regalia and can change it to a different type of weapon as a bonus action, including ranged weapons and shields. While your Regalia is a ranged weapon, it creates its own ammunition. While it is a shield, you gain a bonus to AC while wielding equal to the bonus to attack and damage rolls your regalia has. Your GM may also choose to allow more unique weapons or items.

feats.name: Celestial RaimentPrerequisite: Must have Cursed Wave
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Soul Bound Treasure
feats.description:
While you have your Regalia manifested, you can spend 3 CE as a bonus action to summon a hagoromo scarf around your body that lasts until your Regalia disappears. As a reaction, you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC until the beginning of your next turn, or to a saving throw you make as the silken scarf protects you from harm.Maximum: Instrumentalization

You have learned to apply your soul control to a wide area, turning everything within your sight into a Lesser Regalia that obeys your will. As an action for 8 CE, you turn nonmagical objects around you that are not being worn or carried into Lesser Regalia that destroy what lies before you. This creates a 60 ft cone originating from you. Any creatures within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d10 necrotic damage and be pushed back 30 feet and knocked prone on a failed save or half as much and not pushed back or prone on a successful save. A creature that is pushed back and impacts a solid object or structure takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Objects and structures in range take maximum damage. A creature that fails their save against this technique has their maximum hit points reduced by the damage taken until they finish a long rest. If the creature failed their save, this damage cannot be reduced.

descriptionEn: Your very soul has become a cursed tool that has been sealed within. You have the ability to manifest it using cursed energy.

name: Retrograde
description: Đảo chiều dòng thời gian và phục hồi trạng thái vật lý của đồ vật hoặc cơ thể về vài giây trước đó để xóa bỏ tổn thương.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Reversion
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, when you make an attack roll or saving throw against an effect that you can see or are targeted by an attack roll, you can spend 1 cursed energy as a reaction to reverse time a few seconds, allowing you to reattempt a failed roll or make the attack reroll.

At 3rd level, this feature also grants you a +2 bonus to the second attempt this feature grants you. This increases to +3 at 6th level, +4 at 11th level, and +5 at 18th level. Also at 3rd level, you can use this feature on a creature within 30 ft of you that you can see for an additional 2 CE. Other creatures do not gain the bonus to rolls.

features.name: Regression
features.description:
At 3rd level, you can spend 3 cursed energy as a bonus action. You physically regress to the previous point you were standing at the start of your turn, tracing the path you moved. This completely reverses your movement and actions even defying the laws of physics, such as jumping up backwards or running on nothing if the ground or platform was removed. Any opportunity attacks for this reversed movement are made at disadvantage.

At 6th level, you can spend 3 additional cursed energy to continue regression to the point you started your previous turn.

If your movement is blocked, you can force your way through. If your path is blocked by a creature, they must make a Dexterity save or take your proficiency bonus in d8s of bludgeoning damage and are pushed to a different space out of your path if their size is Large or smaller (your choice). If your path is blocked by a structure or object that is not fixed in place, you can make a Cursed Energy check to move it (DC 10 + 3 for every size category above Medium). On a success, you move it out of the way. Otherwise you take 5 bludgeoning damage and the structure or object takes 10 times your proficiency bonus in bludgeoning damage. If this destroys the object, you continue moving, otherwise you stop moving.

features.name: Enhanced Reversion
features.description: At 6th level, you can use Reversion without using your reaction a number of times equal your proficiency bonus each round. Additionally, when you use Reversion you can spend an additional 3 CE to instead roll at advantage.

features.name: Invert Causality
features.description:
At 11th level, rather than reversing events you have learned to use a conceptual curse that inverts causality to rewrite the flow of events so your attack always lands first. After an attack or damaging effect made by a creature within 30 ft damages you, you can spend 8 CE as a reaction. Time is then rewound to before the attack is made or the effect happens.

You can immediately make one attack against the creature that ignores range and is guaranteed to hit by reversing causality, causing the triggering action to be wasted.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Requiem of Retrograde
features.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, choose one creature within your domain. The first thing that creature does on their turn (Eg. using movement, taking an action, etc) is automatically reversed back to their original point and the movement or action is wasted. At initiative 20, you can target a different creature by switching the effects of your domain to that creature.

Additionally, all creatures of your choice are under the base effects of Reversion. When you use Reversion on your own attack rolls, they are guaranteed to hit.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Requiem of Retrograde
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, choose one creature within your domain. The first thing that creature does on their turn (Eg. using movement, taking an action, etc) is automatically reversed back to their original point and the movement or action is wasted. At initiative 20, you can target a different creature by switching the effects of your domain to that creature.

Additionally, all creatures of your choice are under the base effects of Reversion. When you use Reversion on your own attack rolls, they are guaranteed to hit.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Nghịch Hành Trấn Hồn Khúc

feats.name: Retrograde Station
feats.description: As an action while touching part of a nonliving object that was destroyed an hour ago, you can spend 2 cursed energy to entirely repair it. Any other fragments or separated parts of it disappear and any destroyed parts reform for the object. At 6th level this increases to 1 day, at 8th level this increases to 7 days, at 11th level this increases to 1 month, at 18th level this becomes 1 year and at 20th level this increases to any point in time.

feats.name: Flash Regress
feats.description: What if we just went backwards, like really fast? When you use Regression, you no longer provoke opportunity attacks during your regressing movement. Additionally, you can instead spend up to your proficiency bonus in cursed energy. If you spend more than 1 CE, you gain a +1 bonus to the DC or Cursed Energy check per Cursed Energy spent. At 11th level, you can push creatures Huge or smaller out of your path.

feats.name: Maximum: Sword of Retrograde
feats.description: When you use Invert Causality, your guaranteed attack deals critical damage (cannot roll black flash) and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are stunned until the end of your next turn.

descriptionEn: The act of regression is the basis of your technique.

name: Rockstar
description: Biến cây đàn guitar thành bệ phóng Chú lực, khuếch đại sóng âm thanh thành những đợt sóng xung kích xé toạc màng nhĩ đối phương.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Sound Amplification
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you gain proficiency in Performance and one instrument of your choice. While holding an instrument you are proficient in, you can spend 1 CE as an action to play it and launch a Sound Blast at a target within 30 feet. Make a ranged Cursed Energy attack roll, on a hit you deal 2d10 thunder damage and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed back 10 feet. This technique's damage increases to 3d10 at 6th level, 4d10 at 11th level, and 6d10 at 18th level.

features.name: Jacked Audio
features.description:
At 3rd level, when you use your action to launch a Sound Blast, you can launch up to two Sound Blasts, spending 1 Cursed Energy for each. At 11th level you can make up to three Sound Blast attacks as part of your action.

Resonating Music At 6th level, you have learned to apply your Sound Blast to an area. As an action for 5 cursed energy, you can launch a Sound Wave in a 15 feet cone. All creatures within range must make a Constitution saving throw or take your Sound Blast damage + additional d10s equal to your proficiency bonus and be pushed back 20 feet and deafened until the end of their next turn on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

The range of your Sound Blast now increases to 60 feet. The range of your Sound Wave increases to 30 feet at 11th level.

features.name: Maximum: Epic Solo
features.description:
At 11th level, you can spend 8 cursed energy to start a solo. For the next minute, your attacks deal an additional 2d10 thunder damage and if a creature fails its saving throw against your technique it gains disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

You can also spend additional cursed energy up to half your proficiency bonus to deal an additional 2d10 thunder per CE spent. A hostile creature that ends its turn within 15 feet of you during your solo takes thunder damage equal to your CE modifier + your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of Fame
features.description: At 18th level, you mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take your Sound Amplification damage and are deafened for 1 minute.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Hall of Fame
domain.description: At 18th level, you mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take your Sound Amplification damage and are deafened for 1 minute.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Đại Sảnh Danh Vọng

feats.name: Musical ClimaxPrerequisite: Must have Sound Waves
feats.description: You've learned that just playing isn't enough, you need to build up to the best part. As an action you can start playing your instrument to charge up your technique. You can charge your technique using your action this way for a number of times equal to your CE modifier while concentrating, after which you must release your technique. You can use your reaction to launch either a Sound Blast or Sound Wave at any time while playing this way and add 2 damage die per action you use to play before releasing and ignore resistances.

feats.name: Emotional Melodies
feats.description:
As a bonus action for 5 cursed energy, you can introduce a vibe of your choice for 1 minute while concentrating. You can only have one Vibe active at a time. Deafened creatures automatically succeed.

Happy Vibes. Your music gives happy and upbeat vibes. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or be Charmed and only hear you and your music until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.

Sad Vibes. Your music gives sad and depressed vibes, bringing the mood down. On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or fall prone and their speed becomes 0 until the Vibe ends. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.

Angry Vibes. Your music gives off angry and rebellious vibes! On a hit with your Sound Blast, the target makes a Charisma saving throw or becomes berserk until the Vibe ends. A berserk creature uses their reaction to make a melee attack at the closest creature at the start of their turn and must use their action to attack. They can repeat the save at the beginning of their turn.

feats.name: Rock SquadPrerequisite: Must have Maximum: Epic Solo
feats.description: Looks like the band is getting back together! An epic guitar solo is always welcome, but people came for a show. When an allied creature ends their turn within 15 feet of you during your Epic Solo, their next attack or technique deals additional d4 in thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

descriptionEn: You can amplify sound and launch it as a blast of energy.

name: Rot
description: Sử dụng huyết dịch kịch độc ăn mòn da thịt của Eso và Kechizu: phát động Hủ Bại Bào Tử ăn mòn cơ thể nạn nhân từ trong ra ngoài.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Rotten Blood
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you possess toxic blood. You gain resistance to poison and acid damage and have advantage on saving throws against the poisoned condition. When you have less than your hit point maximum, you can cause your unarmed strikes or melee weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d8 acid damage once per turn. This increases to 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 6th level, and 4d8 at 11th level.

Once as part of a long rest, you can spend $100 and hit points up to your proficiency bonus to fill a Blood Bag with your own blood. This Blood Bag counts as a source of hit points for your Rot features. A Blood Bag lasts 5 days outside of refrigeration before it goes bad. You can have a number of Blood Bags equal to your Constitution modifier at once.

features.name: Rot Techniques
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your blood in a manner fit for battle. When you use a Rot technique or feature, you can ignore the HP cost if you have an alternate source of blood. You gain four techniques and two additional techniques at 6th and 11th level:

Blood Spit. As an action for 1 CE and 2 HP, you force a creature within 15 feet to make a Constitution save or take 2d6 acid damage and be blinded until the end of their turn on a fail.

Rot Burst. Once per turn on a hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 CE and 1 HP to deal an additional 2d8 acid damage.

Rotten Blood Beam. As an action for 3 CE and 4 HP, you can make a ranged cursed energy attack against a target within 30 feet. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 piercing and 2d10 acid damage and must make a Constitution saving throw or have their movement reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

Corrosive Wave. As an action for 3 CE and 5 HP, you launch waves of your rotten blood in a 15 feet cone. Creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw or take 5d8 acid damage or half as much damage on a success.

Blood Shield. As a reaction, you spend CE up to your modifier and twice that amount in HP. For each CE spent, the Blood Shield gains 10 hit points, which absorbs the damage and you take remaining damage. If this reduces a melee attack to 0, the attacker must make a Constitution save or take 2d8 acid damage.

Homing Blood Missile. As an action for 4 CE and 5 HP you can shoot a seeking blood missile at a target within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 5d10 + your CE modifier in acid damage. You can reroll the attack roll using your bonus action or reaction.

Blood Soak. As a bonus action for 3 CE and 3 HP, you can coat your limbs in your blood. For the next minute, your walking speed increases by 10 ft and your unarmed strikes deal 2d6 + CE modifier acid damage on a hit.

Crimson Spear. As an action for 2 CE and 3 HP, you form your blood into a spear. Make a ranged cursed energy attack roll with a range of 30/90 feet. On a hit the target takes 1d6 piercing and 2d10 + CE modifier acid damage.

Crimson Rain: As an action for 2 CE and 3 HP, you pick a point within 60 ft. Creatures within 15 feet must make a Dexterity Saving throw taking 1d10 piercing and 2d10 acid damage on failed save or half as much on a success.

features.name: Decay
features.description:
At 3rd level you have learned to use your blood infectiously. As a bonus action for 3 Cursed Energy, you can cause all creatures that have taken damage from your technique in the last minute to form black floral patterns on their body as they have been infected with your blood.

At the beginning of your turn, they take your Rotten Blood damage. This lasts for 1 minute unless you spend 3 cursed energy to continue the effect or end it as a free action.

At 6th level, creatures also gain the poisoned condition for the duration and Decay also reduces a creature’s hit point maximum. A creature’s maximum hit points return to normal after a long rest.

features.name: Scarlet Rot
features.description:
At 6th level, you have proved your mastery over your technique. Your technique now ignores resistance to acid damage and a creature that fails a saving throw against your technique is poisoned for 1 minute and can make a Constitution save at the end of their turn to end the effect on themselves.

You gain immunity to poison and acid damage as well as the poisoned condition. At 18th level, your technique treats immunity to acid damage as resistance.

features.name: Maximum: Wing King
features.description:
At 11th level, you learn to condense your blood into wings resembling veins as a bonus action for 8 CE, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

Your movement  is quadrupled

You gain a flying speed equal to half your movement

You gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws

You can replace an attack on your turn with a Rot Technique or one line of blood attack.

As a free action on your turn, you can unleash lines of blood.

These lines of blood take the shape of three ranged Cursed Energy attacks against a target within 60 feet. Each attack deals 4d10 + your CE modifier acid or necrotic damage. You can also replace an attack on your turn with a line of blood attack. While using Wing King, you cannot use Decay.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Mind Palace of Corrupted Ego
features.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. All creatures within your domain are under the effects of Decay and take additional Decay damage at initiative 20. Additionally, your Rot Techniques use hit points from other creatures within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Mind Palace of Corrupted Ego
domain.description: At 18th level you have mastered your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. All creatures within your domain are under the effects of Decay and take additional Decay damage at initiative 20. Additionally, your Rot Techniques use hit points from other creatures within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Hủ Bại Tâm Trí Cung Điện

feats.name: Blood Production
feats.description: You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Rot features. This does not regain HP.

feats.name: Condensed Decay
feats.description: You have learned to increase the potency of your blood’s properties. When you use a Rot Technique, you can spend additional HP up to twice your CE modifier to increase the damage dice of acid dealt by your technique by one tier for every 2 HP spent (d8<d10<d12) to a max of d12.

feats.name: Blackened Blood
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King
feats.description: Your blood has become bubbling and black. A creature that fails a Constitution saving throw against your technique by 5 or more gains a level of exhaustion. A creature cannot gain more than 3 levels of exhaustion from this feature.

feats.name: Wing King Improvement
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King
feats.description:
You have mastered your Maximum technique, granting you the following benefits while using Wing King:

You gain the Evasion feature

You can now make four lines of blood attacks as a free action on your turn

You can use a Rot Technique as a bonus action

descriptionEn: Utilize your toxic dark blood to devastating effectiveness.

name: Schrift X
description: Khắc dấu ấn chữ thập thần thánh lên không gian, cho phép đòn đánh đâm xuyên mọi lớp giáp chắn và cản phá đòn tấn công đối phương.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Piercing Schrift
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have a cursed mark somewhere on your body that molds your cursed energy automatically. When you make a ranged weapon attack, you can choose to use your Cursed Energy modifier for the attack or damage rolls. When you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 ce to ignore cover by phasing through a solid object. You can only pierce through 5 feet of one object. This increases to two objects at 3rd, three at 6th, and four at 11th.X-Axis Shot

At 3rd level, your technique has evolved and a cursed seal forms on your eye, providing near perfect accuracy. As an action for 3 cursed energy, you automatically hit a creature within range with a ranged weapon attack without rolling and deal an additional 2d6 necrotic damage. This increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 5d6 at 11th level, and 7d6 at 18th level.

You can use this technique only if you haven't moved this turn, and after you use it, your speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Cursed Mark
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to apply your cursed seals onto others, allowing for even more accurate and deadly shots. When you use a mark, any previous marks you have active ends.

Critical Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you can mark a target of your choice within 30 feet for 1 minute. If you hit the marked target with an attack, your next attack against the target is made at advantage. On a hit, the attack deals critical damage and the mark ends.

Multi-Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you can mark a number of targets up to your CE modifier within 30 feet for 1 minute. As an action, you can make a ranged attack and activate the marks, causing the attack to split and attack each marked target within range of your attack. You make a ranged weapon or cursed energy attack roll against each creature, dealing your normal damage on a hit and the mark ends.

features.name: Intangibility
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned to use your cursed seal to cause yourself to phase instead of your attacks. As a bonus action for 6 cursed energy, you release the cursed seal over your eye to activate your technique. You gain immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing and resistance to all other damage other than psychic for 1 minute and must maintain concentration.

While Intangibility is active, you cannot use your innate technique features. only allowing for normal attack actions. You can end the technique at any point as a free action to close your left eye.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Divine Sight
