features.description: At 18th level you have achieved the pinnacle of your innate technique. Within your domain, all your attacks benefit from Piercing Schrift and are a guaranteed hit. At initiative 20 every creature within your domain is given a Cursed Mark of your choice.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Divine Sight
domain.description: At 18th level you have achieved the pinnacle of your innate technique. Within your domain, all your attacks benefit from Piercing Schrift and are a guaranteed hit. At initiative 20 every creature within your domain is given a Cursed Mark of your choice.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thần Nhãn Thấu Suốt

feats.name: Piercing Burst
feats.description: You have perfected your accuracy and combined it with your piercing ability. When you use Piercing Schrift, you can also target additional targets up to your proficiency bonus that are either in front of or behind your target as long as they are within the path of the attack. You use the attack roll against the original target to determine if you would hit the additional targets.

feats.name: Cursed Seal ExpertPrerequisite: Must have Cursed Mark
feats.description:
Through diligent practice and creativity, you have created new types of cursed seals. You gain the following options:

Blinding Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, removing the blinded condition on a success.

Crippling Mark: As a bonus action for 3 CE, you mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. On a hit, the target must make  a Constitution saving throw or have either their movement speed halved for 1 minute or disadvantage on attacks for 1 minute (your choice). A creature can repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

feats.name: Maximum: Sancrosanct
feats.description: You have practiced and mastered your technique allowing you to utilize it flawlessly. When you activate Intangibility, you are instead resistant to all damage other than psychic, but are still able to use your Innate Technique features and for the duration you can use Piercing Schrift for free once per turn.

descriptionEn: You can create cursed seals that allow for permeation and your eyes are also cursed with a seal due to this technique.

name: Seance
description: Thuật chiêu hồn của bà lão Ogami: triệu hồi thông tin thể xác hoặc linh hồn của người chết nhập vào bản thân để sở hữu sức mạnh của họ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Seance
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you have a very powerful and dangerous technique, and you begin to learn its basics. As a Full Turn Action you can spend 2 CE per information you Seance. You can target yourself or another willing creature within 15 ft for the seance of a dead humanoid with a CR or level no more than 1 higher than your level. You must have a small body part such as a finger of the deceased humanoid that you or the willing participant must consume.

You or the target of the seance must spend 1 cursed energy at the beginning of the target’s turns while the technique is active to maintain its form, with the technique ending once the cursed energy runs out. You cannot use an alternate source of cursed energy, even with a binding vow. You lose access to your Innate Technique features while affected by this technique.

Physical Information. The target of the seance gains the appearance, racial traits, features, proficiencies, and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores of the deceased humanoid and temporary hit points equal to your proficiency.

Soul Information. The target gains access to the full information the body has including all memories and one of their Cursed Technique or Innate Technique features. While it is useful, this is also a dangerous method of utilizing this technique. At the beginning of their turns, the target must make a Charisma saving throw against the deceased person (DC 8 + their proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier). On a failure, the dead humanoid takes control until the target’s cursed energy runs out.

features.name: Blessing of the Grateful Dead
features.description:
At 3rd level, you have increased the potency of your seance.

When channeling Physical Information, the target gains temporary hit points equal to your level + your proficiency.

When channeling Soul Information, the target gains access to two Cursed Technique or Innate Technique features of your choice and does not lose access to their own Innate Technique features. The target cannot use Innate Technique features from different techniques at the same time.

Ritual of Resurrection At 6th level, you have learned how to create a prolonged ritual to make your technique more powerful. When you use your technique, you can start a ritual instead of immediately shapeshifting. You must make a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) every turn for 1 minute to perform this ritual while maintaining concentration. If you lose concentration, the ritual stops and you must start over. After you have finished the ritual, you or a willing creature within 30 ft can transform into the dead humanoid if the CR or level is equal to or lower than your level + your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Maximum: Black Seance
features.description:
At 11th level, when you complete Ritual of Resurrection you can spend an additional 5 cursed energy to cause the target of the Seance to gain one of the following benefits.

Physical Information Overload. The target gains the hit points of the dead humanoid as temporary hit points if channeling Physical Information.

Soul Information Overload. The target gains access to all the dead humanoid’s Cursed Technique and Innate Technique features if channeling Soul Information. You cannot use Domain Expansion this way and can only use the minimum required cursed energy for innate technique features. The target also cannot use the dead humanoid’s innate technique and its own at the same time.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Seance Parlor
features.description:
At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20 you can choose a willing creature to gain the benefits of Seance.

Although you must have the body part of the dead humanoid being called, you don’t need to consume it as long as you are holding it. Within your domain, you no longer have to spend cursed energy to maintain the seance and automatically succeed against a creature’s soul information. All innate technique features gained through Seance in your domain are imbued with your domain’s guaranteed hit. Seances caused by your domain end when your domain disappears.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Seance Parlor
domain.description:
At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20 you can choose a willing creature to gain the benefits of Seance.

Although you must have the body part of the dead humanoid being called, you don’t need to consume it as long as you are holding it. Within your domain, you no longer have to spend cursed energy to maintain the seance and automatically succeed against a creature’s soul information. All innate technique features gained through Seance in your domain are imbued with your domain’s guaranteed hit. Seances caused by your domain end when your domain disappears.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Chiêu Hồn Phòng Thất

feats.name: Bestial Seance
feats.description: You have learned to bring a bit of whimsy to your usually ghastly technique. When you use Seance on yourself, you can choose to instead channel the Physical Information of a Beast with a CR equal to or less than your proficiency bonus. You gain all the creature’s traits, senses, movements and actions in addition to the normal effects of Physical Information. To use this technique, you must be wearing a costume of that specific animal, costing $200 x the Beast’s CR. You can wear this costume with armor, but if it takes an amount of damage (other than psychic) equal to 3 x your level, it becomes unusable and you lose any benefits from this feature.

feats.name: Perfect Ritual
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Ritual of Resurrection
feats.description: You won’t allow anyone to interrupt your seance. You have advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration for your Seance technique and the time to complete your Ritual is decreased to 3 rounds. Additionally, you decrease the saving throw DC a target makes against the dead humanoid’s Soul Information by your CE modifier.

feats.name: Cling to Life
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Black Seance
feats.description: When a target runs out of cursed energy and can no longer maintain the seance, they can choose to forcefully hold the spirit within their body. At the beginning of the target’s turn, they instead spend 5 HP, reducing their maximum by the same amount. Your hit point maximum is restored by 15 after each long rest.

descriptionEn: You summon the dead into yourself or a willing vessel.

name: Shadow Killer
description: Hòa mình vào bóng tối của kẻ thù để ám sát từ cự ly không tiếp xúc, đâm xuyên bóng đen để gây sát thương thật vào cơ thể mục tiêu.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Shadow Strike
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can control your shadow and cast Minor Illusion through it in a 5 ft range around yourself.

You can also strike a creature through their shadow. When you make an attack roll, you can spend 1 cursed energy to target a creature’s shadow that exists within their space. If the creature is unaware of your technique, you automatically hit as they don’t guard their shadow. The target takes your attack in necrotic damage and you deal additional damage equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. This increases to twice your Cursed Energy modifier at 3rd level, thrice at 6th level, and four times at 11th level.

If your attack roll is higher than the creature’s passive Perception, they are unaware of how they were damaged. If your attack roll is lower, then they see you attack their shadow and become aware of your technique. A creature that is aware of your technique can make a Dexterity saving throw to try and avoid your assault on their shadow. On a failure, you automatically hit. On a success, you roll against their AC. You cannot use this technique if you cannot see the target’s shadow.

features.name: Dark Binding
features.description: At 3rd level, your ability to affect creatures through their shadows has improved. When you make a weapon attack, you can spend 3 cursed energy to target a creature’s shadow. On a hit, instead of dealing damage you release your grip on the weapon used to make the attack, leaving it to pin the target’s shadow in place. The creature is grappled and restrained and is unable to move or be moved until the weapon is removed. The weapon can be removed as an attack.

features.name: Void Steps
features.description: At 6th level, you have learned to become one with the shadows, gaining darkvision out to 200 ft and can see through magical darkness within this range. You can spend 2 CE to cast Pass Without Trace. When you take the Hide action in dim light or darkness, you become invisible until you attack, use a technique, or enter an area of bright light.

features.name: Shadows of Mortality
features.description: At 11th level, you have mastered the art of elimination without being seen. You can use Shadow Strike as a free action once per turn for 1 CE. This special attack deals critical damage on a hit if the target has not taken a turn in combat or is surprised. You cannot roll for a black flash in this way.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Zero Hour
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Within your domain, the shadows of all creatures are always visible to you and stretch towards you so they are always at your feet and able to be targeted. At initiative 20, three creatures of your choice suffer the full effect of Shadow Strike.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Zero Hour
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. Within your domain, the shadows of all creatures are always visible to you and stretch towards you so they are always at your feet and able to be targeted. At initiative 20, three creatures of your choice suffer the full effect of Shadow Strike.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Giờ Khắc Số Không

feats.name: Shadow User
feats.description:
You have furthered the uses of your shadow choosing one of the following features (This feat can be taken multiple times).

Shadow Skulker. As an action for 2 CE you physically enter the shadows gaining full cover for X rounds or until you exit from a shadow within 10 feet. As an action while the technique is active, you can move into a shadow within 10 ft. You can hear and see through the shadow you entered. If the shadow is sufficiently illuminated, you exit the shadow. (X = CE mod)

Shadow Envoy. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can imbue your cursed energy into a creature's shadow within 5 ft. To attempt this technique without them noticing, you must make a Cursed Energy check against their passive perception. You can imbue conditions for when the technique is triggered. You can choose to leave either a melee attack with a range of 10 ft using Shadow Strike or a simple message. If you choose to leave a Shadow Strike, it targets a specific creature under a condition you set, uses your Cursed Energy modifier and is made at advantage if the target is unaware. If you choose a message, you can choose to leave five words. When you create the message, you can choose any number of creatures who can see the message in the shadow.

Two shadow spells below 5th level. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

feats.name: Improved Bindings
feats.description:
You have improved your technique and can cause shadows to physically wrap around the target, giving you the following additional effects when you use your technique:

A creature must spend an attack to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to remove the weapon.

The target is treated as having two levels of exhaustion.

The target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of their turn or be stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

feats.name: Maximum: Heavenly Star of Darkness
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Shadows of Mortality
feats.description:
As an action for 10 cursed energy, you invoke primordial darkness, forming a dark sun 300 ft in the sky that inhabits a 30 ft sphere for 1 minute. A creature that enters the 30 ft sphere the dark sun inhabits takes 4d6 necrotic damage and and again at the start of their turns. At the end of the minute, you can spend 1 cursed energy to increase the duration by 1 minute. The technique ends if you become incapacitated. The dark sun radiates magical darkness within 600 ft of it that you can see normally in and any light from a technique costing less than 5 cursed energy is suppressed within this area. Any creature within that range with a Cursed Energy score or Passive perception higher than your Cursed Energy save DC can see through this magical darkness as if it were dim light.

You can use Shadow Strike against a creature within this area without spending cursed energy and the target has disadvantage on Dexterity saves to protect their shadow. If you spend cursed energy on Shadow Strike against a creature within this area, they are considered vulnerable to the damage.

descriptionEn: You possess the eerie ability to kill without touching.

name: Shrine
description: Thuật thức của Ryomen Sukuna: phóng xuất vô số nhát chém giải phẫu Đoạn (Dismantle) và Bát (Cleave), nghiền nát mọi sự sống thành từng mảnh vụn.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Dismantle
features.cost: Cursed Energy up to your proficiency bonus to replace your attack with Dismantle
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you learn the basics of your technique, which is cutting. When you take the attack action, you can spend Cursed Energy up to your proficiency bonus to replace your attack with Dismantle. Make a melee or ranged CE attack with a range of 120/250 ft. On a hit you deal 1d12 slashing damage per CE spent. The base damage becomes 2d12 at 6th level as long as you spend 1 CE. This increases to 3d12 at 11th and 4d12 at 18th level.

If you gain the Extra Attack feature, you can replace attacks with Dismantle, but must spend Cursed Energy for each attack. If a target cannot see Dismantle, you gain advantage on Dismantle attacks against that creature (passive Perception lower than your CE save DC cannot see Dismantle). You gain +1 bonus to Dismantle’s critical range at 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 18th level.

features.name: Cleave
features.description:
At 3rd level, you learn how to cleave living targets in one fell swoop. As an action for up to 10 Cursed Energy, you choose a target within 5 feet. Make a melee Cursed Energy attack. On a hit, the target takes a number of d10s equal to your proficiency bonus + Cursed Energy spent in slashing damage and must make a Constitution save.

On a failure, further uses against the same creature ignores resistances as Cleave adjusts to the target’s toughness.

features.name: Divine Flame Open
features.cost: Cursed Energy up to twice your proficiency bonus
features.description: At 6th level, you can utter an incantation to create an arrow of fire. As an action, you can spend Cursed Energy up to twice your proficiency bonus, choosing a point within 150/600 feet of you. Each creature within 15 ft of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, which is made at advantage if the creature is more than 150 feet away. On a failed save, they take a d12 of fire damage for each cursed energy spent. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.

features.name: Slicing and Severing
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, your body has adjusted to better handle your cursed technique. You can now use Dismantle as a bonus action or reaction (one attack each). Additionally, when using Cleave against a creature that has failed its save, it treats immunity as resistance. If using the maximum of 10 cursed energy on Cleave, you can target a limb from the limb damage table.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine
features.description:
At last at 18th level, you have reached the pinnacle of your innate technique, letting you finally expand your domain.

At initiative 20, the domain cuts everything, causing targets to suffer the effects of Cleave and Dismantle. Cleave targets creatures within cursed energy and Dismantle targets anything in the domain including objects. Cleave and Dismantle are treated as if the maximum amount of Cursed Energy was used.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine
domain.description:
At last at 18th level, you have reached the pinnacle of your innate technique, letting you finally expand your domain.

At initiative 20, the domain cuts everything, causing targets to suffer the effects of Cleave and Dismantle. Cleave targets creatures within cursed energy and Dismantle targets anything in the domain including objects. Cleave and Dismantle are treated as if the maximum amount of Cursed Energy was used.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Phục Ma Ngự Hạp Tử

feats.name: Chainsaw Dismantle
feats.description: Once per turn, you can spend 2 CE to apply Dismantle to your punches. When you make an unarmed strike you deal 1d12 additional slashing damage. This increases to 2d12 at 6th level, 3d12 at 11th level and 4d12 at 18th level. At 11th level, you can use Chainsaw Dismantle as a reaction to an attack. You roll the damage for your Dismantle based on the CE you spend and reduce the damage by that amount. If this reduces the damage to 0, the attack is nullified.

feats.name: Spiderweb
feats.description: Your Cleave has grown more versatile. For 1 extra Cursed energy you can touch an object or structure and make Cleave into a 30 ft cone which only damages objects and structures in contact with each other. This deals critical damage, creating difficult terrain and potentially destroying terrain and footholds causing creatures to fall. If this does not cause a creature within range to fall, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.

feats.name: Disassembly
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Slicing and Severing
feats.description: You have learned to further segment your attacks. When you spend more than 1 CE for Dismantle, you can instead fire multiple slashes splitting damage die between the slashes before attacking and making separate attack rolls for each.

feats.name: Maximum: World Cutting Slash
feats.description: You have broadened your understanding, cutting the area your target is in instead of the target itself. You can spend the maximum amount of cursed energy on Dismantle as an action to instead target one creature within 60 ft you can see. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure they take maximum damage, on a success they take half as much maximum damage. This damage ignores resistances, immunities,  temporary hit points, cover, obstacles, bonuses to saving throws (from techniques) and cursed techniques. This is a limb damaging effect and can target any limb on the limb damage table.

descriptionEn: Dissect and fillet, preparing your oven. Simple things like that are your cursed technique.

name: Sky Manipulation
description: Bí thuật của Takako Uro: nắm lấy không gian bầu trời như tấm lụa mỏng để uốn cong hướng tấn công và phóng phản kích Băng Thiên Liệt Không.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Sky Shape
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, your innate technique manifests, making you able to manipulate the sky around you. As a reaction to an attack roll, you can spend 1 Cursed Energy to add +4 to your AC by distorting the sky until the start of your next turn. If it makes a ranged attack miss, you can make a cursed energy attack roll against the attacker, redirecting the attack and dealing the attack's damage and effects on a hit. If it makes a melee weapon attack miss, it will render the limb used in the attack stuck and unusable until the beginning of the creature's next turn. If you have taken the dodge action, you can use this reaction on allies within 5 feet.

features.name: Sky Armor
features.description: Once you reach 3rd level, you have become better at manipulating the space around you. As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can cover part of your body with a part of the sky, making those parts covered invisible for 1 hour. While you have this armor equipped, your AC is 11 + Your Cursed Energy modifier + your proficiency bonus. You also gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed while under the effects of Sky Armor.

features.name: Sky Shape Improvement
features.description: When you reach 6th level, your manipulation has become so refined even techniques pass through you. You can now use your reaction against cursed energy attack rolls, and you can use this reaction for 3 Cursed Energy to redirect a cone or line saving throw, redirecting the attack if you pass the saving throw, making it not affect you or other creatures in the area.

features.name: Thin Ice Breaker
features.description: At 11th level, you have created an extension technique to your sky manipulation, literally breaking the sky as if it were ice. As an action for 5 Cursed Energy, you can force every creature in a 30 feet line to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they will take a number of d10s equal to twice your Cursed Energy modifier in force damage and be knocked prone, on a success they take half as much damage and are not prone. While you are flying, all creatures make their save at disadvantage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Heaven’s Gate
features.description: Finally, at 18th level,  you have learned the most powerful technique of your arsenal. Your domain is a beautiful blue sky full of clouds, with a shining sun illuminating everything. All hostile creatures inside the domain are considered falling unless they have flying speed. Once the domain is over, they take the maximum amount of falling damage.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Heaven’s Gate
domain.description: Finally, at 18th level,  you have learned the most powerful technique of your arsenal. Your domain is a beautiful blue sky full of clouds, with a shining sun illuminating everything. All hostile creatures inside the domain are considered falling unless they have flying speed. Once the domain is over, they take the maximum amount of falling damage.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thiên Môn Khai Mở

feats.name: Cloak of Invisibility
feats.description: As an action, for 3 Cursed Energy you can cast the invisibility spell as the sky surrounds you preventing others from seeing you. When you reach third level, you also gain the benefits of Sky Armor when invisible.

feats.name: Spatial Shatter
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Thin Ice Breaker
feats.description: You can spend 6 CE to make an attack on your turn into a melee cursed energy attack roll using a melee weapon or unarmed strike. On a hit, you deal damage as normal and the target also suffers the effects of Thin Ice Breaker.

feats.name: Maximum: Hurricane
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Thin Ice Breaker
feats.description: As an action, for 10 Cursed Energy you can spin the space around you forcing all creatures in a 30 foot radius to make a Strength saving throw or be launched 1000 feet into the air as the space rebounds upwards.

descriptionEn: A great technique allowing you to grab space and wield it to your command.

name: Solo Forbidden Zone
description: Bằng các điệu vũ thần thánh và chú văn vịnh xướng, tạo ra kết giới cấm khu đẩy hiệu suất và lượng Chú lực của đồng minh lên 120% tiềm năng tối đa.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Forbidden Zone
features.description: Starting at 1st level, through chanting, and dancing you bring out the maximum potential of those around you. As an action for 1 CE, you create a 30 ft sphere for up to 1 minute. Allies within the zone gain advantage on all rolls. You must use your bonus action on your turn to maintain the Zone.

features.name: Bless
features.description: At 3rd level, you gain better control over your Zone, allowing you to focus it on a single person. As an action for 3 CE you target a willing creature within 60 feet. That creature is under the effects of your Forbidden Zone for 1 minute or until you lose concentration.

features.name: Ritual Dance
features.cost: CE up to your CE modifier + your proficiency as a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) to make a 50 ft sphere centered on yourself into a Ritual Zone for 1 minute while concentrating
features.description:
Beginning at 6th level, you can spend CE up to your CE modifier + your proficiency as a Full Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement) to make a 50 ft sphere centered on yourself into a Ritual Zone for 1 minute while concentrating. You must maintain your Zone using your bonus action on your turn and cannot move more than 10 feet. You can choose to not allow hostile creatures to enter or leave your Zone, forcing them to make a Wisdom save, becoming unable to enter or leave for 1 minute on a failure. Allies gain your Zone’s normal effects and benefits depending on how much CE you spent to activate this technique:

Allies deal an additional 5 damage with techniques for each CE spent.

Allies gain temporary cursed energy equal to CE spent (doesn’t affect yourself).

If allies can spend additional cursed energy on a feature, they can spend additional cursed energy up to your CE modifier (min of 1).

features.name: Maximize Output
features.description: Starting at 11th level, after setting up your Zone, you can maximize an ally's output. Once per turn when a creature uses a cursed technique that deals damage while within your zone, you can spend 5 CE to cause them to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Hallowed Zone
features.description: At 18th level, you reach the peak of your technique, allowing you to open your domain. All allies in your domain are under your Ritual Zone as if you had spent the maximum CE and their techniques become sure hits, as if they were the ones who cast the domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Hallowed Zone
domain.description: At 18th level, you reach the peak of your technique, allowing you to open your domain. All allies in your domain are under your Ritual Zone as if you had spent the maximum CE and their techniques become sure hits, as if they were the ones who cast the domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thánh Vực Cấm Khu

feats.name: Blessing of Resilience
feats.description: You have mastered Blessing those within your Zone. Those in your Zone have their output and durability increased. When you create your Zone, all allies in range gain temporary hit points at the start of their turns equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

feats.name: Blessing of Combat
feats.description: When you use Forbidden Zone, you maximize a creature’s output offensively. Allies in your Zone can add a d4 to attack and damage rolls.

feats.name: Maximum: Shrine of The Gods
feats.description: When setting up your Ritual Zone as part of your full turn action, you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to roll a d10. Instead of you having to maintain your zone each turn, it instead lasts for a number of rounds equal to the number rolled + your Cursed Energy modifier.

descriptionEn: Through sacred dance, music, and incantations, creates a forbidden sanctuary that elevates the cursed energy output of allies to 120% of their utmost potential.

name: Star Dictator
description: Điều khiển quỹ đạo chuyển động của các Thức thần thiên thể, tạo nên một trường hấp dẫn khép kín giam hãm và đè bẹp kẻ thù.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Minor Star Shikigami
features.cost: cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus as an action
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you can spend cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus as an action. For every cursed energy, you summon a minor shikigami in an unoccupied space within 5 ft of you. As a bonus action, you can command any shikigami created with your technique, otherwise they take the dodge action. As an action, you can share senses with one of your minor shikigami. While sharing senses with your shikigami, you are blinded and deafened. You can only have up to your proficiency bonus in shikigami at a time.

features.name: Pseudo-Domain Constitution
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you have learned to form a pseudo-domain that follows the path of your shikigami. As a bonus action, you command any number of your minor shikigami to create your domain. They spend their action taking the dash action to orbit around a point, forming a circle within 5 ft of the center. On each of your turns, you can use your bonus action to increase the radius of the domain by 5 ft or command more shikigami to join the domain orbit.

The maximum range and damage of the domain depends on the number of shikigami making up the domain. A creature within the domain other than you must make a Dexterity saving throw at the end of your turn. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 slashing damage per orbiting shikigami or half as much on a success.

The maximum radius of the domain is 5 ft x the number of orbiting shikigami. If one of the orbiting shikigami is killed, the range and damage decreases. If all of your shikigami stop orbiting the domain path, the pseudo-domain ends.

features.name: Major Star Shikigami
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, you have learned how to keep your pseudo-domain active without sacrificing offensive power. Your pseudo-domain now deals 1d8 slashing damage per shikigami creating the domain. You gain the ability to summon your major star shikigami. You can summon your major star shikigami as an action for 6 CE and can command it as a bonus action, otherwise it takes the dodge action. You can only have one major star shikigami active at a time. Once your major star shikigami is killed, you cannot summon it again for 1 hour.

As a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement), you can command the major star shikigami to begin forming a special pseudo-domain. Once it has completed a full orbit, the special domain allows your Minor Star Shikigami to move freely within the domain while still maintaining the range and damage of your pseudo-domain. This special domain still follows the same maximum for range and damage, now scaling with the number of Minor Star Shikigami within the domain.

features.name: Army of the Dictator
features.description:
At 11th level, you have learned mass summoning. You can now maintain a number of Minor Star Shikigami equal to three times your proficiency bonus and can have two Major Star Shikigami active at once.

Additionally, the damage of your pseudo-domain increases to 1d10 slashing damage per shikigami orbiting and ignores immunity and resistance to slashing damage. The radius of your pseudo-domain increases to 10 ft x the number of orbiting shikigami.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Divine Mandate
features.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take 1d12 slashing damage for every star shikigami you have summoned within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Divine Mandate
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, you have learned to expand your domain. At initiative 20, all creatures of your choice within your domain take 1d12 slashing damage for every star shikigami you have summoned within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Thiên Mệnh Thần Dụ

feats.name: Domineering Shikigami
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Minor Star Shikigami
feats.description:
You have learned that strengthening cursed energy lets you summon stronger shikigami. Your Minor Star Shikigami gain the following benefits.

The Shikigami’s Bite attack increases to 1d6. It becomes 1d8 at 6th level and 1d10 at 11th level.

The Shikigami gains a +2 bonus to their Dexterity score and again at 6th, and 11th level (max of 20).

When the shikigami is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

feats.name: Tyrant Shikigami
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Major Star Shikigami
feats.description:
You have learned that strengthening cursed energy lets you summon stronger shikigami. You can spend 1 additional cursed energy when you summon your Major Star Shikigami to increase its size category to Large. This increases to 2 cursed energy to make it Huge at 11th level and 4 cursed energy to make it Gargantuan at 18th level. For every size category larger than medium, it gains the following:

+4 bonus to Strength score

+1d8 damage to Bite attacks

+30 hit points

feats.name: Judicial Amputation
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Army of the Dictator
feats.description: If a creature fails their saving throw against your pseudo-domain by 5 or more, the damage is treated as having the Limb Removing Effect and targets one of their arms or legs.

descriptionEn: The path of your shikigami constitutes the domain.

name: Star Rage
description: Thuật thức của Yuki Tsukumo: nạp khối lượng ảo khổng lồ vào bản thân và Thức thần Garuda mà không làm giảm tốc độ, tung ra những cú đấm ngang hố đen.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Virtual Mass Increase
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you have learned the most fundamental technique for a star rage user, the virtual mass increase. As a bonus action for an amount of Cursed Energy up to twice your Cursed Energy modifier, you gain a mass increase for each CE spent for a number of rounds equal to your Cursed Energy modifier. You gain the following benefits depending on your added mass:

Stronger Martial Arts. Your Unarmed Strike die increases by one tier per two mass increases. (1->d4->d6->d8->d10->d12->2d8)

Mass Impact. At one mass increase, whenever you roll a critical with an unarmed strike the target must make a Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. At two mass increases, a creature within 5 ft of the target must make a Constitution save or take half of the same damage. At three mass increases, if the target fails the Constitution saving throw upon a critical, it will also have its speed halved until the beginning of your next turn. At four mass increases their speed will be reduced to 0 if they fail.

Increased Damage. You gain a +1 to unarmed strikes damage rolls per mass increase.

Grappler. At one mass increase, you count as one size larger. You count as one size larger per 2 mass increases up to Gargantuan.

You can only activate this technique again after the full duration has passed.

features.name: Improved Duration
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you have honed your skills with your technique, learning how to make it last longer. Virtual Mass Increase now lasts for a number of rounds equal to twice your Cursed Energy modifier. This becomes three times at 11th level and four at 18th.

features.name: Virtual Mass Improvement
features.description:
Once you reach 6th level, you have gained experience in refining your technique and can now add three times your Cursed Energy modifier.

Increased Strength. When you spend at least 5 CE on virtual mass, you gain advantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saving throws and +1 to the rolls for each further mass improvement.

features.name: Virtual Mass Mastery
features.description:
At 11th level, you have refined and optimized your technique. You can now add up to four times your Cursed Energy modifier to your virtual mass and use your technique with melee weapon attacks.

Critical Power. Your critical range increases by 1 for every four mass increases and you deal maximum damage to objects and structures.

Quick Activation. You have learned how to instantly activate your technique. You can now activate Star Rage as a free action.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Event Horizon
features.description: Finally, 18th at level, you have learned to expand your domain. All in your domain are crushed by ground-shaking mass as every 1 ft cost 4 ft of movement. At initiative 20, all hostile creatures in your domain are knocked prone and take 8d8 force damage as they experience crushing mass. A creature must make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cursed Energy save DC at the beginning of their turn to stand up and again at the end of their turn to remain standing.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Event Horizon
domain.description: Finally, 18th at level, you have learned to expand your domain. All in your domain are crushed by ground-shaking mass as every 1 ft cost 4 ft of movement. At initiative 20, all hostile creatures in your domain are knocked prone and take 8d8 force damage as they experience crushing mass. A creature must make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cursed Energy save DC at the beginning of their turn to stand up and again at the end of their turn to remain standing.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Chân Trời Sự Kiện

feats.name: Massive Push
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Increase
feats.description: After landing a critical you can choose to also push the creature 30 feet away. If they hit a solid object or structure, they take the remaining distance as fall damage.

feats.name: Shooting Star
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Improvement
feats.description: When you have your mass increased, you can spend 3 Cursed Energy once per round to replace one of your attacks by kicking or throwing an object with massive strength. This creates a 5 foot wide, 60 feet long line, causing all creatures within range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking twice your unarmed strike damage on a failed save. This has the limb damaging effect on a failed save.

feats.name: Maximum: Black Hole
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Virtual Mass Mastery
feats.description: As an action you can sacrifice yourself, becoming a Black Hole for 1 minute, after which you die. This creates a 100 foot radius of difficult terrain where all creatures within range make a Strength saving throw at the end of your turn, being pulled 50 feet closer on a failed save or 25 feet on a success. If a creature or object gets within 5 feet of you, they are sucked into the black hole and die.

descriptionEn: The innate technique of Yuki Tsukumo: imbues virtual mass into oneself and the shikigami Garuda without decreasing speed, delivering devastating strikes capable of mimicking a black hole.

name: Starlight Symphony
description: Tạo ra làn sương mù Chú lực ánh sao lung linh, bẻ cong ánh sáng để che mắt kẻ thù và phóng xuất chùm tia tinh tú rực rỡ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Cursed Fog
features.cost: Cursed Energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier as an action
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can spend Cursed Energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier as an action. You create 10 feet of fog around yourself for each cursed energy. The fog lasts for 1 minute, spreads around corners, heavily obscures the area and you choose if the fog follows you or not as part of the action to create it. Creatures within your fog have disadvantage on Perception and Investigation checks and cannot detect cursed energy.

At 6th level, you can use your reaction to give advantage or disadvantage to a roll made by a creature within your cursed fog and can spend up to twice your Cursed Energy modifier when creating your cursed fog. You can spend up to thrice your Cursed Energy modifier at 11th level.

features.name: Kitsune Creation
features.description:
At 3rd level, you can summon a fox shikigami as an action for 2 cursed energy. The shikigami lasts for 24 hours or until dismissed as a free action. Your fox shikigami act on your turn and you can command all fox shikigami as a bonus action.

You can have a number of shikigami summoned equal to your proficiency bonus and always know if your shikigami has died.

features.name: Living Fog
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to become the fog itself. As an action for 3 Cursed Energy you transform yourself or one of your fox shikigami into a misty cloud for up to 1 hour while concentrating. While in this form, your only method of moving is a fly speed of 30 feet. You can enter and occupy the space of another creature. While occupying the space of another creature, you can force them to make a Constitution saving throw, taking Xd8 equal to your Cursed Energy modifier in cold damage on a failed save as they choke on your fog.

You have resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. You can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, though you treat liquids as though they were solid surfaces. You can’t fall and remain hovering in the air even when stunned or otherwise incapacitated.

While in the form of a misty cloud, you can’t manipulate objects, and any objects you were carrying or holding can’t be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. You can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to also become invisible for the duration.

features.name: Inari
features.description: At 11th level, as a full turn action for 8 cursed energy you can summon Inari in an unoccupied space within 10 feet. Inari disappears after 1 minute and uses your proficiency bonus. You can command Inari and your fox shikigami as an action on your turn. Inari is considered one of your fox shikigami for any of your features other than Living Fog.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Heaven and Earth
features.description: At 18th level, you have completed your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. Your domain is an expansive field of fog with two towering spirits at the north and south. All creatures other than you are completely blinded by the cursed fog within your domain and suffer the effects of your Cursed Fog. At initiative 20, all creatures take 5d10 cold damage as they struggle to breathe in the cursed fog.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Heaven and Earth
domain.description: At 18th level, you have completed your technique, allowing you to expand your domain. Your domain is an expansive field of fog with two towering spirits at the north and south. All creatures other than you are completely blinded by the cursed fog within your domain and suffer the effects of your Cursed Fog. At initiative 20, all creatures take 5d10 cold damage as they struggle to breathe in the cursed fog.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Tinh Tú Thiên Địa

feats.name: Enduring Shikigami
feats.description: You have learned to remove the time limit of your shikigami. Your fox shikigami (other than Inari) last until reduced to 0 hit points and you can add your proficiency bonus to any saving throws your shikigami make. You are still limited by the number of shikigami you can have active at once.

feats.name: Fox Fire
feats.description: You can create incredibly dense fog that can be triggered to erupt in a vapor explosion. For an additional 3 CE when you create an area of Cursed Fog, you make the fog incredibly thick. As an action, you can cause the fog to detonate in a vapor explosion. All creatures within the fog other than yourself must make a Constitution saving throw, taking twice your Cursed Energy modifier in d8s of cold damage or half as much damage on a success as a blue explosion rips through, igniting the fog.

feats.name: Maximum: Fog of Exorcism
feats.description: As an action for 10 cursed energy, you can blast a 60 ft cone with an erupting wave of destructive exploding fog. All creatures within range must make a Constitution saving throw, taking twice your CE modifier XD10 + 6d10 cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a success. If a creature is a cursed spirit, the damage ignores any resistance to cold damage and it makes the save at disadvantage. If used at Maximum Output, Cursed spirits automatically fail their saving throw.

descriptionEn: You can create and mold a shining cursed fog.

name: Straw Doll Technique
description: Thuật thức cổ truyền điều khiển đinh sắt, búa và hình nhân rơm của Nobara Kugisaki: truyền Chú lực xuyên qua đinh để đánh thẳng vào linh hồn đối thủ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Nail Projectile
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, due to your experience with your technique, you will start with 1 Hammer, 24 nails, and 1 straw doll. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you strike 2 nails by hitting them with your hammer. Make two melee or ranged cursed energy attack rolls with a range of 20/60 feet. On a hit, each nail deals 1d6 + your CE modifier piercing damage. You can also spend 2 additional Cursed Energy to make 2 additional attacks in this way.

At 6th level, you have become rather cheap with your nails, making sure to always recover as many as possible from the battlefield. As a bonus action while touching a creature that has taken damage from Nail Projectile, you can make a DC 10 Dexterity check. On a success, you regain the nail.

features.name: Resonance
features.description: At 3rd level, you have learned the true use of your technique. As a reaction while within 5 feet of a target that just took slashing or piercing damage, you make a Sleight of Hand check against the target’s AC. The damage dealt  determines the size of the piece. You can mix a body part from a creature into the straw doll for three cursed energy. While within 200 feet, you can use your action to damage the original creature through your straw doll, depending on the body part. At 18th level, your attacks using Resonance lowers the target’s maximum health.

features.name: Hair Pin
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, you learn a new way to damage your enemies. When you launch a Nail Projectile and hit a creature or as a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can stick a nail into an object. If hitting a creature, the initial attack deals no damage. As a bonus action or as a reaction to a creature coming within 5 feet of the nail, you can create cursed explosions. Creatures within 10 feet of the nails must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d8 necrotic damage for each nail, taking half as much damage on a success. You can spend additional Cursed Energy when you drive the nail, increasing the damage by 1d8 for every additional Cursed Energy spent.

features.name: Improved Resonance
features.description: When you reach 11th level, you’ve discovered a way to utilize Resonance. Instead of using the straw doll to target the creature, you can instead use the creature’s very body in place of it to dramatically increase its effectiveness. As an action for 6 cursed energy, you make an attack roll against a creature under one of the following conditions: incapacitated, restrained, stunned, petrified, or paralyzed. On a hit, the creature is knocked prone and struck by resonance with its body being used in place of the straw doll with the following effect:

features.name: Domain Expansion: Wara Ningyo
features.description: Finally, at 18th level, you have honed your technique. At initiative 20, you unleash a full-power Improved Resonance, on all creatures inside the domain.

tables: Minor Body Part: Target gains disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn.
Medium Body Part: The Target loses their reactions until the end of their next turn.

Major Body Parts: The creature has to make a Constitution saving throw; on failure, black spikes erupt from the creature’s body stunning them for 1 minute. They can repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on success.

For 1 minute, every time they try to use a feature that costs CE, they must make a Charisma saving throw at disadvantage. On a failure, the technique fails to activate and the cursed energy is wasted. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns, still at disadvantage, ending the effect on a success.

feats.name: Nail Volley
feats.description: As an action, for as much Cursed Energy as nails you unleash your nails in a cone equal to ten times the nails used you can force creatures in the area to do a Dexterity save or take a number of d6 equal to the nails used.

feats.name: 1000 Needles
feats.description: When you use Hairpin, you can spend an additional 1 cursed energy per nail. If the creature fails its saves, it becomes Restrained by needles of cursed energy. An affected creature can make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your cursed energy save at the end of their turn, freeing themselves on a success. On a failure, they take 1d8 piercing damage.

feats.name: Maximum: Last Nail in the Coffin
feats.description: You have mastered the Straw Doll Technique, when you use your action to damage a straw doll with Resonance, for 8 Cursed Energy you can choose to land an Improved Resonance.

descriptionEn: The traditional technique of Nobara Kugisaki: commands metal nails, a hammer, and straw effigies to channel cursed energy directly into the soul of the opponent.

name: Technique Extermination
description: Thuật thức mang quyền năng thiên sứ của Angel / Hana Kurusu: phóng xuất ánh sáng thanh tẩy Thang Jacob xóa sổ hoàn toàn mọi thuật thức và kết giới.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Extinguishment
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you have gained use of the essentials of your technique. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you can target a creature you can see within 30 ft as a trumpet of light appears and a beam of light falls from the sky. The target must succeed a Charisma save, if the creature fails it takes 2d12 radiant damage and loses the ability to use Cursed Energy for 1 minute. On a success, they take half as much damage and don't have their cursed energy features negated. They can repeat the saving throw at the beginning of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

features.name: Angel’s Blessing
features.description:
At 3rd level,  your technique makes you feel like a divine being made to help others, you are a true angel. As a bonus action for 1 cursed energy, you can gain flying speed equal to half your walking speed for 1 minute, as wings of light emerge from your back and a halo stands on top of your head. While you have the wings active, you can freely move through barriers such as curtains without breaking them. You can also pass through walls and barriers that were cast with CE equal to or lower than your proficiency bonus. When said minute ends, you can spend another 1 more cursed energy to keep your fly speed for another minute. This fly speed increases to your walking speed at 11th level.

In addition, due to your holy nature you gain resistance to radiant damage.

features.name: Improved Extinguishment
features.description: Once you reach 6th level, your Extinguishment increases to 5d12 radiant damage and cursed tools of the targeted creature are also suppressed for the duration.

features.name: Maximum: Jacob’s Ladder
features.description:
When you reach the 11th level, you have created an extension to your technique, one so powerful that you can burn your opponents as a radiant light falls upon them. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you summon a trumpet of light in your hands, blowing into it as you choose a point within 200 feet of you. A beam of light strikes down in a 10-foot radius circle centered on the point you choose, every creature in said area other than you has to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take 10d12 radiant damage and suffer the effects of Extinguishment for 2 minutes. On a success, they take half as much damage. Undead, cursed spirits and creatures of evil alignment make this saving throw at disadvantage.

You can also use this technique to destroy barriers and cursed objects. As an action for 6 cursed energy, you can summon a trumpet of light and blow into it, making a beam of light targeting a cursed object, cursed item, cursed tool, magic item, or any kind of barrier created by cursed energy or magic within 30 feet. Make a cursed energy attack roll against the cursed energy or spell save DC. On a hit you destroy the target, neutralizing barriers and power of cursed objects.

If you use this technique with Maximum Output, its beam of light increases to a 30-foot circle and ignores features that reduce damage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Garden of Eden
features.description: Finally, 18th level, your technique is honed to the finest of edges. At Initiative 20 all creatures suffer the full effects of Jacob’s Ladder.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Garden of Eden
domain.description: Finally, 18th level, your technique is honed to the finest of edges. At Initiative 20 all creatures suffer the full effects of Jacob’s Ladder.

feats.name: Blessed Blow
feats.description: On a hit you can spend 2 Cursed Energy to deal an additional 2d12 radiant damage. You can increase the damage by 1d12 by spending an additional Cursed Energy. You can only spend as much cursed energy as your Cursed Energy modifier using this feature.

feats.name: Archangel’s Present
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Angel’s Blessing, Breakthrough
feats.description: You gain a Blessing from the Dungeon Master’s Guide.

feats.name: Sword of Michael
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisites: Must have Maximum: Jacob’s Ladder
feats.description: Through rigorous effort and control, you have managed to convince the might of Jacob’s Ladder into a single blow. As an action for 8 Cursed Energy, you can make a melee Cursed Energy attack against a single creature. On a hit that creature will then suffer the full effects of Jacob’s Ladder without a saving throw.

descriptionEn: Your technique bestows its user with the gift of angelic power, capable of smiting villains and hampering enemy’s cursed techniques.

name: Teleportation
description: Đánh dấu tọa độ Chú lực lên không gian để dịch chuyển bản thân và đồng minh tức thời, thoắt ẩn thoắt hiện kiểm soát thế trận.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Teleport
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, your technique allows you to teleport to destinations you have marked. As a bonus action for 1 cursed energy, you can mark a person, location, or object which you can touch. You can have up to twice your CE modifier in marks at once and your marks remain for up to 12 hours. You can remove any of your marks at will.

As an action for 2 cursed energy, while not being viewed, you and any willing creatures within 5ft of you that are also not being viewed teleport up to 500 feet to a mark of your choice.

features.name: Improved Teleport
features.description: At 3rd level, you have improved your technique. The range of your teleport now increases to (your CE modifier + your proficiency bonus + your level) x 100 feet, and you can now teleport as a reaction to an attack or saving throw as long as you have a way to cause yourself to disappear from view (such as covering yourself with a sheet).

features.name: Mastered Teleport
features.description:
At 6th level, with great training, you have reached the pinnacle of your teleport. As an action for 8 cursed energy you cast Teleport. You can only go to marks and you always go to the exact mark you want to go to, regardless of how far away from you they are. You are now able to teleport others while you do not leave. You can now choose to only teleport other creatures when using any teleport feature.

Additionally, you can attempt to teleport an unwilling creature within 5 ft. They must make a Cursed Energy saving throw. If they fail, they are teleported to one of your marks.

Additionally, your markings now last for a week instead of 12 hours.

features.name: Improved Marking
features.description: At 11th level, you have learned to mark things more efficiently. You can now mark as a free action instead of a bonus action and your amount of markings is increased to 3 times your CE modifier. You can spend 5 CE to make a mark last indefinitely unless destroyed.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Crossroads of Instance
features.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. All space within your domain is treated as being marked by you. At initiative 20, you can change the locations of a number of creatures up to twice your CE modifier, teleporting them anywhere within your domain, regardless of whether they can be seen. Additionally, you can teleport a creature as a reaction.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Crossroads of Instance
domain.description: At 18th level, you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. All space within your domain is treated as being marked by you. At initiative 20, you can change the locations of a number of creatures up to twice your CE modifier, teleporting them anywhere within your domain, regardless of whether they can be seen. Additionally, you can teleport a creature as a reaction.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Ngã Tư Thời Gian

feats.name: Offensive Shunt
feats.description:
You have learned to use your technique offensively. When you mark an object that is Small size category or smaller, you can spend 3 CE to forcefully teleport it into a space occupied by a creature within 60 ft that you can see, which forces a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object teleports into their body and they take Xd6 force damage that ignores damage resistances (X = proficiency bonus). At 6th level, you can spend additional CE up to your proficiency bonus to increase the die tier of Offensive Shunt by 1 per CE spent up to a maximum of d12s (d6 > d8 > d10 > d12).

At 11th level, when teleporting a willing or unwilling creature, you can spend an additional 6 CE to teleport them into an area occupied by a Large size category object or structure or larger within 30 ft that you can see. Both the creature and the object or structure take double the damage of your Offensive Shunt. If this destroys the object or structure, the creature falls prone. Otherwise, the target is restrained in the item until removed or the obstruction is destroyed.

feats.name: Perfected Teleport
feats.description: You're grown more efficient with your teleports and have perfected their efficiency to reduce cursed energy costs. The cost to use your technique instead becomes 1 CE and the cost to cast Teleport is reduced by your CE modifier.

feats.name: Maximum: Soul Swap
feats.description:
With creative thinking you’ve figured out teleporting the souls of creatures. As an action for 6 CE with two willing creatures you touch, you mark and swap the souls of the creatures. For 1 hour or until you dismiss it (no action required), all of the creatures’ game statistics are swapped except for mental stats (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma) and any non-Physical feats. They lose access to their Innate Technique features and gain the other’s Technique and cursed energy, hit points, racial features, and weapon proficiencies.

Body Training. When the swap ends both creatures are returned to their original bodies, reverting all changes, but each creature can ignore one prerequisite of any feats the other creature used while in their body, except for prerequisites that require you to be or not be a certain race, have a certain cursed technique, require other feats, require a breakthrough, or require you to be a certain class. A creature can only be swapped twice in one month, after which you must wait one month before swapping that creature again. If a creature dies while swapped, the other dies once the duration ends.

RCT Training. Once per month if swapped with an RCT user, after training for the full duration and spending at least 20 CE utilizing RCT, a creature without can roll the d100 to attempt RCT Breakthrough with a +5 bonus to the success range. Even if the roll fails, the success range for future d100 rolls for RCT permanently increases by +1 to a maximum of +3. If you fail this roll 3 times, you can no longer make this roll using Soul Swap.

descriptionEn: You can teleport yourself and others to marked locations while not being viewed.

name: Ten Shadows
description: Bảo thuật gia truyền của gia tộc Zen'in: dùng bóng tối triệu hồi 10 loại Thức thần, đỉnh cao là Bát Kỳ Kiếm Dị Giới Ma Hư La với khả năng thích ứng vạn vật.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Divine Dogs
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you have the prized technique of the Zenin clan, the ten shadows earned to summon Shikigami from the shadows. As an action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can summon up to 2 Divine Dogs(1 CE per dog) within 10 ft of you. Your Divine Dogs last for 1 hour, until they are reduced to 0 hit points or you dismiss any summoned shikigami as a bonus action while within line of sight. As a reaction to seeing your shikigami reduced to 0 hit points, you can unsummon them and cannot summon them again until you finish a long rest.

Your shikigami cannot use actions on their own. You must spend a bonus action to command your shikigami or can spend an action to order them to do something more specific for longer, such as protect that creature, grab that, defend that area, etc. The number of Shikigami you can control at once is equal to half your level(rounded up).

features.name: Trial
features.description:
Once you reach the 3rd level, you have gained access to your other spirits, and you must face them in ritual combat alone to gain access to them. As an action, you can summon an untamed Shikigami within 30 ft of you without spending cursed energy. Any creature within 50 feet is considered participating in the ritual. An untamed shikigami will be berserk (attack the nearest creature), but if you have defeated the shikigami alone (not including your shikigami) and reduce it to 0 hit points, you can now summon the shikigami normally as an action for up to 1 hour and can dismiss them as a bonus action. You can summon a number of shikigami at a time equal to half your level rounded up (Divine Dogs and Rabbits each count as one entity).

If reduced to 0 hit points during a trial with multiple participants, you do not make death saving throws until all participants are unconscious.

features.name: Totality
features.description:
Any shikigami reduced to 0 hit points dies and cannot be summoned again. A destroyed shikigami is eligible for Totality, with the exception of Rabbit Escape or Mahoraga.

If one of your shikigami is killed, during a short or long rest you can perform a 1-hour ritual to pass on the strength of one deceased shikigami to a different Non-Totality (other than Rabbit Escape or Mahoraga), granting it a permanent Totality form. When you make a Totality, they gain the following changes:

Their Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become those of the creature who has the higher score. Then they gain a bonus to that ability score equal to the modifier of the creature with the smaller score.(Ex: Nue has 16 Strength while Divine Dog has 12, their Totality would have 17 Strength.) They also gain the higher AC of the shikigami used.

They receive the hit points of both creatures.

Their movement speed is added together.(2 with 30 would have 60)

They receive all features, traits, actions, bonus actions, reactions, legendary actions, skill, saving throw proficiencies, damage resistances, damage immunities and condition immunities from both creatures.

Their size can be either of the shikigami.

The CE cost becomes the higher shikigami + half of the lower shikigami’s cost.

Their CR equals the creature with a higher CR + half the CR of the creature with the smaller CR rounded up.(Ex: Nue's CR is 4, and Great Serpent's CR is 5, their totality's CR would be 7)

After calculating ability scores, the difference in the ability modifier of the original user of a damaging feature and the Totality is added to the amount of dice. For save effects damage, the score corresponding to the save is used.

(Ex: Mourn Tiger has a +5 in Dexterity and Nue has a +3. Mourn Tiger’s Dexterity Score increases by +3, meaning a +1 bonus to Dexterity modifier so you add 1 additional dice to the Totality's attack to the damage dice that use Dexterity as the ability modifier, changing Mourn Tiger’s bite attack from a 1d10+5 into a 2d10+6.) This increase only applies to direct attack rolls and saving throws.

As an optional ruling, your DM can choose to ignore Totality, instead having all shikigami come back on a long rest, rather than being killed and eligible for Totality.

features.name: Shadow Manipulation
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, you've learned to make use of your ability to manipulate shadows, allowing you to form an extra dimensional space to hide your things and even manipulate the shadows of others.

Shadow Storage. You can store objects in an extra-dimensional space within your shadow. You can physically place something into your shadow, costing no cursed energy. However you must spend 1 cursed energy to interact with an object in this space, potentially removing it. Everything in your shadow counts for your carrying capacity. Additionally, you can trap creatures within your shadow. As a bonus action for 2 ce, you can force a creature to make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your CE save DC. This check is made at Disadvantage if they are in complete darkness or inside a veil, and automatically fail within your domain. On a failure they are trapped inside your shadow, counting for carrying capacity. They can hold their breath for a number of minutes equal to their Constitution modifier (min of 1) before suffocating. They can make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw at the end of their turns, freeing themselves on a success and appearing prone in an unoccupied space within 5 ft.

features.name: Well’s Unknown Abyss
features.description:
When you reach 11th level, you can combine your shikigami into different forms. As an action, you can temporarily combine two of your living shikigami into a single type, granting the base shikigami an alteration feature from the other. You spend half the CE cost of the base shikigami to summon up to your proficiency bonus in altered shikigami at once, spending CE for each.

An altered shikigami has half the hit points of the base shikigami and you can reduce its size category by 1 to reduce the CE cost by 1. When reduced to 0 hit points, it does not affect the shikigami used in its creation and is not eligible for Totality. You cannot summon any unaltered shikigami while altered shikigami are summoned. If the base shikigami or alteration shikigami’s CR is 4 or higher, you can only create up to two altered shikigami with them at a time.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Chimera Shadow Garden
features.cost: cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to create a number of clones of yourself equal to the CE spent
features.description:
Finally, at 18th level you have learned how to expand your domain. Your domain is a huge shadow barrier, filling your surroundings with overwhelming darkness. Any hostile creatures that end their turn within your domain must make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or become restrained and sink. They can make a Strength (Athletics) check at the beginning of their turn to escape. The area is difficult terrain for creatures of your choice, and you are under the effects of Freedom of Movement within the domain.

Shadow Clones. While inside the domain, as a bonus action you can spend cursed energy up to your Cursed Energy modifier to create a number of clones of yourself equal to the CE spent. The clones have all your features and stats, but not weapons or hit points and cannot use Cursed Energy. Their hit points are equal to your Cursed Energy modifier and become a shadow puddle once reduced to 0 hit points. You can use your reaction to switch places with a clone when you are hit, making the clone take the hit instead.

Shikigami Clones. Your domain allows you to summon copies of your shikigami to overwhelm your opponents. Whenever you summon a shikigami, you can instead spend cursed energy equal to the shikigami's cost(treat its price as if you were outside your domain) to summon a perfect copy of the shikigami. You can spend CE to make a number of shikigami clones up to your Cursed Energy modifier on the same turn. You cannot create copies of Mahoraga with this feature.

In addition, your normal Shikigami won't cost you Cursed Energy within your domain.
