feats.name: Shadow User
feats.description:
You have furthered your use of shadows. Choose one of the following features (This feat can be taken multiple times).

Shadow Skulker. As an action for 2 CE you physically enter the shadows gaining full cover for a turn or until you exit from a shadow within 10 feet. At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 CE to remain in the shadow. You can hear and see through the shadow and can summon tamed shikigami within the shadow. If the shadow is sufficiently illuminated, you exit the shadow.

Shadow Ridge. As a reaction for 1 CE against a melee attack, you force a creature within 10 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the target rolls the attack at disadvantage as their legs fall into their shadow briefly and they fall prone. You can instead spend 3 CE to give the target disadvantage on the save.

Two shadow spells below 5th level. The CE cost equals the spell’s level.

feats.name: Chimerafication
feats.description:
You have learned how to better fuse the powers of your Shadows even at the cost of creating a monstrosity. When creating a Totality, you can sacrifice a tamed shikigami even if it is not destroyed. You can use a number of shikigami up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) + 1 that are eligible for Totality to fuse into an eligible Non-Totality shikigami, forming a Chimera. Chimeras can have humanoid forms, but cannot be used for Well’s Unknown Abyss.

You can also give an additional alteration to your altered shikigami created with Well’s Unknown Abyss, counting as part of the technique.

feats.name: Maximum: Embodiment
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Chimera Shadow Garden
feats.description: As an action, you can spend half the cost (min of 1) of one of your tamed shikigami (no Totality or Chimera). Rather than summoning, you instead gain their movement, actions, legendary actions, features and one ability score of your choice from the shikigami for 1 hour. (Eg. Divine Dog’s movement, Max Elephant’s Constitution, or Mahoraga’s Adaption.) You can embody one shikigami at a time.

descriptionEn: You have the Zenin Clan’s praised technique, said to rival the six eyes.

name: Tool Manipulation
description: Cưỡi trên cán chổi bay lượn trên không trung và truyền Chú lực điều khiển từ xa các loại vũ khí, phóng xuất những luồng gió chém gió bão.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Guided Control
features.cost: CE up to your CE modifier as a bonus action to imbue a tool you are holding with cursed energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can spend CE up to your CE modifier as a bonus action to imbue a tool you are holding with cursed energy. This imbuement lasts an hour for each cursed energy spent and gains the following benefits:

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls using this tool or a +1 bonus to AC if the tool is armor or used defensively

The damage die increases by 1 tier and again at 6th and 11th level (D4<D6<D8<D10<2d6<2d8)

features.name: Floating Tool
features.description:
At 3rd level, when you imbue a tool, you can spend an additional 2 CE to create a Floating Tool. You can command a Floating Tool as an action to hover up to 35 feet in any direction and make a melee attack using your CE modifier. The Floating Tool deals its normal weapon damage or 1d4 bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing if it is an improvised weapon. You can only have one floating tool at a time and it falls to the ground if it is more than 120 ft from you.

A Floating Tool has AC equal to your CE save DC and hit points equal to 5 x your proficiency bonus + 10 for each grade above 4th if it is a cursed tool. A Floating Tool reduced to 0 HP is destroyed unless it is a cursed tool, in which case it loses the benefits of Floating Tool. You can spend 2 CE as a bonus action to return the effect of Floating Tool to the cursed tool by touching it.

features.name: Wind Scythe
features.description:
At 6th level you have learned to use tools offensively. As an action for 3 CE, you can create a blast of wind from an imbued tool you are holding. Or from a Floating Tool within 60 ft for 1 additional CE.

This creates a 10 feet wide, 60 feet long line. Creatures within range must make a Strength saving throw, taking 3d10 bludgeoning damage and pushed back 10 feet on a failed save or half as much on a success.

At 11th level, your Wind Scythe now deals 6d10 bludgeoning damage and a creature that fails their save is pushed back 20 feet and knocked prone.

features.name: Tool Improvement
features.description: Additionally, your specialty grants you the following Tool Improvements.

features.name: Floating Tool Improvement
features.description:
The cost to create a Floating Tool becomes 1 CE

When you command a Floating Tool, they can move up to 40 feet

You gain a flying speed of 60 feet by mounting a Floating Tool

You can have 2 Floating Tools active at the same time, commanding both as part of the same action.

features.name: Combat Tool Improvement
features.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls when using an imbued tool for each CE spent.

As a reaction, you can cause one of your imbued tools to protect you. It grants you a bonus to AC or reduces damage depending on its size. If the tool has a bonus to AC or damage rolls, it is included in the AC and reduction respectively.

features.name: Tool Mastery
features.description:
At 11th level, you have mastered your respective style, granting you the following:

Floating Tool Mastery. You can command two Floating Tools using your bonus action or one Floating Tool as a free action on your turn. You and other creatures also gain advantage on Dexterity saves while riding a Floating Tool.

Combat Tool Mastery. Your mastery over imbued tools allows you to manipulate the flow of combat with exceptional precision. When you use Combat Tool Improvement, the AC bonus it grants increases by 1, and the damage reduction provided increases by one additional die. In addition, you gain one extra reaction each round that can only be used to activate Combat Tool Improvement.

When your or a creature you can see makes an attack using your imbued tool, you can use your reaction to grant that attack roll advantage.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Tsukumogami Spirit World
features.description:
Finally at 18th level you have learned to manifest your domain. All weapon attacks made by creatures other than you become a guaranteed miss as you can manipulate all tools within your domain, causing them to come to life and obey your commands.

At initiative 20, you choose one of your imbued tools to gain the benefits of Floating Tool and have all Floating Tools move 60 ft and attack a creature within range or have all creatures suffer the effects of Wind Scythe. You can control a number of Floating Tools equal to your CE modifier (min of 2) within your domain.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Tsukumogami Spirit World
domain.description:
Finally at 18th level you have learned to manifest your domain. All weapon attacks made by creatures other than you become a guaranteed miss as you can manipulate all tools within your domain, causing them to come to life and obey your commands.

At initiative 20, you choose one of your imbued tools to gain the benefits of Floating Tool and have all Floating Tools move 60 ft and attack a creature within range or have all creatures suffer the effects of Wind Scythe. You can control a number of Floating Tools equal to your CE modifier (min of 2) within your domain.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Phó Tang Thần Thế Giới

feats.name: Tools of the CraftPrerequisite: Must have Guided Control
feats.description: You can imbue a set of tools with your cursed energy, such as artisan’s tools or thieve’s tools. You can use your CE modifier for ability checks made using these tools and gain a +1 bonus for each CE spent on the imbuement up to a maximum of your CE modifier.

feats.name: Eyes in the Skies
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Floating Tool Improvement
feats.description: When you are riding your Floating Tool, you gain a +5 bonus to your passive Perception and Investigation and can use your CE modifier for Dexterity saving throws.

feats.name: Maximum: Tsukumogami
feats.description:
As an action for 8 CE, you can imbue a cursed tool with sentience, causing it to come to life and become a Tsukumogami for 1 hour. Your Tsukumogami is always under the effects of Floating Tool and can freely move by itself. It does not count against the number of Floating Tools you can have at once, but you can only have one Tsukumogami at a time.

The Tsukumogami can take an action on your turn while you are holding it. That action can be used only to take the Attack action (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action. If you use Wind Scythe or Combat Tool Improvement’s reaction with your Tsukumogami, you can roll three additional dice.

descriptionEn: You can control tools you imbue with cursed energy.

name: Triple Core
description: Cơ thể Chú hài mang 3 lõi linh hồn độc lập của Panda: chuyển đổi tự do giữa Thể Cân Bằng (Gấu Trúc), Thể Uy Lực (Gorilla) và Thể Tốc Độ (Khủng Long).

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Beginning at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: First Core
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, your cursed energy is gathered into a single core. As a bonus action, you can choose to enter a secondary form giving you access to a special ability for 1 minute. You gain one core option at this level:

Unblockable Blows: When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 CE to ignore resistances. If the creature is not resistant, they are considered vulnerable.

Energy Blast: As an action you spend CE up to your CE modifier to launch a blast of cursed energy. You make a ranged cursed energy attack against a target within 80 feet dealing 2d6 necrotic damage for each CE.

Defensive Form. As a bonus action, you assume this form for 1 minute, buffing your defense. You gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice your current cursed energy. You can spend 1 CE at the beginning of your turn to refresh the temporary hit points.

Divebomb. As part of the bonus action you take to enter this form, you spend CE up to your CE modifier. For the duration of this form, your speed increases by 10 ft per CE spent and you gain a +2 bonus to AC. You deal an additional 1d4 damage for every 15 ft you move in a straight line before hitting a target with a melee attack.

features.name: Triple Threat
features.description: At 3rd level, you can choose two more core options. You can only have one core option active at a time.

features.name: Upgraded Form
features.description:
At 6th level, you have learned to specialize in one of your forms, allowing it to become semi-permanent. Choose one of your core options you have access to and gain its upgraded option:

Unblockable Blows. Your strikes are imbued with unblockable power. Once per turn when you miss with a melee attack, you still deal damage equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

Energy Blast. Your cursed energy has become far more destructive. Once per turn when you deal damage with a ranged cursed energy attack, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll. If you already add your modifier to the roll, you add it a second time.

Defensive Form. Your body passively reinforces itself with cursed energy. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by your Cursed Energy modifier + your proficiency bonus.

Divebomb. Your body has adapted to improve its swiftness. You can spend 1 ce to take the dash, disengage, or dodge action as a bonus action.

Your upgraded options are always active even when you haven’t entered a core form. Though you can not benefit from an upgraded option while in a different core option’s form. You can gain an additional upgraded option at 11th and 18th level.

features.name: Core Exhaustion
features.description: Starting at 11th level, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can choose to lose access to one of your core forms for 1 week to return to half your maximum HP.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Rule of Three
features.description: At 18th level, you gain true understanding over your cores. When inside your domain, you are under the effect of all three cores.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: Rule of Three
domain.description: At 18th level, you gain true understanding over your cores. When inside your domain, you are under the effect of all three cores.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Quy Tắc Tam Hồn

feats.name: Maximum: Crippling Strikes
feats.description: You have mastered your Unblockable Blows core option. Your blows can now treat immunity as resistance by spending 1 additional CE. You can now spend more than 1 CE in an attack.

feats.name: Maximum: Blast Away
feats.description: You have improved your output. When you use your Energy Blast core option with at least 4 CE, the damage dice becomes d8 and creatures must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked 10ft back and fall prone.

feats.name: Maximum: Fortress
feats.description: When you use your Defensive Form core option, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to four times your current CE. While you have these temporary hit points, you are resistant to Piercing, Bludgeoning, and Slashing damage.

feats.name: Maximum: Blitz
feats.description: You have hastened yourself even further. When you use your Divebomb core option, you instead increase your speed by 15 ft per CE spent and you gain a +4 bonus to AC. You deal an additional 1d6 damage for every 10 ft you move in a straight line before hitting a target with a melee attack.

descriptionEn: 3 cores, 1 body, you have different forms with separate powers.

name: Vengeful Spirit Manipulation
description: Gắn kết linh hồn cùng Oán linh Nữ hoàng Rika của Yuta Okkotsu: trữ lượng Chú lực vô hạn, kho vũ khí Chú cụ và khả năng sao chép vô điều kiện thuật thức đối thủ.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Partial Manifestation
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, at some point in time, someone you cared about died. Unable to accept their death, you unconsciously cursed them and created a vengeful spirit of great power. Once per turn, you can call a part of the spirit to your aid. By spending 1 Cursed Energy, you manifest the spirit’s claw to make an additional melee attack as part of your Attack action. This claw attack deals 1d12 slashing damage. At 6th level, the number of attacks increases to two, and three 11th level. You cannot use this attack during manifestation.

features.name: Vengeful Spirit Manifestation
features.description:
At 3rd level, your life is very stressful, being a sorcerer is filled with danger and trouble. When times of danger come, your Vengeful Spirit may forcefully manifest. When you take damage above your level + your Cursed Energy modifier, you must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, you can handle the strain and don't let your spirit out. On a failure, your Vengeful Spirit manifests itself to protect you, going berserk (attacking the nearest creature to you). It acts on your turn, is charmed by you and cannot move more more than 200 feet from you. Once per round, as a free action you can make a DC 20 Persuasion check. On a success it will stop attacking and unmanifest. On a failure, it will keep attacking until there are no creatures within 200 feet. They will always focus on the last thing to damage you and then the closest creature to you. If killed, it respawns after finishing a long rest.

At 6th level, the DC for the Persuasion check becomes 15 and your Vengeful Spirit stays manifested for a number of rounds equal to your Cursed Energy modifier under your control before going berserk.

At 11th level, you have gained more control over your vengeful cursed spirit. You can now manifest your spirit as a bonus action for 1 minute, now obeying your verbal orders. You can summon the spirit a number of times equal to half your Cursed Energy modifier (rounded up), regaining expended uses on a long rest.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: When you reach 6th level, you begin to learn about your innate technique. As a bonus action, while your Vengeful Spirit is in the world, you can command it to make a claw attack against a creature within range. On a hit it can extract the creature's DNA with a claw attack. You can attempt to replicate it by spending 3 CE as an action to make an ability check using your Cursed Energy score. On a success you can copy one feature of the Cursed Technique you have seen that is of a level that you qualify for and fill prerequisites (such as RCT):

features.name: -Cursed Technique = User’s Cursed Energy save DC + 2
features.description:
You cannot copy Domain Expansions or CR 5+ Summons with Mimicry.

When you copy a cursed technique, you can only spend the base cost the technique requires. No matter what you copy, you can only use the technique in its base form. For example, a maximum output hollow purple would only come as a hollow purple. You cannot use different copied techniques at the same time if they are from different innate techniques.

You can have a number of copied techniques features equal to your Cursed Energy Modifier and can use them a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus before they disappear and you must copy them again. If you have a limb or body part of the user, the number of times you can use the technique is doubled. When you copy more than your limit, you remove a copied feature to make space for another.

In addition, you automatically pass the Cursed Energy check if you have already copied the cursed technique before.

features.name: Stronger Bond
features.description:
Once you reach 11th level, the bond between the binding object and the Vengeful Spirit becomes stronger. Your Vengeful Spirit gains the following benefits:

Two of its ability scores will be increased by 2, and so will their maximum.

You will gain +2 to your CE score, including its maximum while your spirit is summoned.

Whenever it is summoned the Vengeful Spirit will gain temporary hit points equal to half your current hit points.

features.name: Domain Expansion: True Mutual Love
features.description: Finally at 18th level, through many battles and copies, you have learned how to expand your domain. Inside this barrier, you are allowed to use all of the cursed techniques you currently have for no Cursed Energy. At initiative 20, you will also gain one additional action, which can only be used to activate a copied cursed technique, which affects all hostile creatures inside the barrier.

domain.name: Domain Expansion: True Mutual Love
domain.description: Finally at 18th level, through many battles and copies, you have learned how to expand your domain. Inside this barrier, you are allowed to use all of the cursed techniques you currently have for no Cursed Energy. At initiative 20, you will also gain one additional action, which can only be used to activate a copied cursed technique, which affects all hostile creatures inside the barrier.
domain.vietnameseName: Bành Trướng Lãnh Địa: Chân Ái Thuần Ái

feats.name: Partial Manifestation Versatility
feats.description: Your manipulation over the manifestation of limbs and such increase. The range of your partial manifestation attacks increases to 15 ft. Additionally, when you hit with one of these attacks, you can attempt to grapple or shove the target as part of the attack.

feats.name: Technique Storage
feats.description:
When you copy techniques, you can keep more in the Vengeful Spirit. You can store twice as many techniques, with any additional techniques being stored within your spirit. You must use an action to retrieve them while within 5 ft of the Vengeful Spirit while it is summoned.

While your Vengeful Spirit is summoned, the number of times you can use a copied technique feature before it disappears increases by your CE modifier. The increased number of uses does not reset when your Vengeful Spirit is resummoned.

feats.name: Free Spirit
feats.description: You and your spirit have finally made amends, making it finally pass on to the afterlife. However, the spirit left you a present before going. Your Vengeful Spirit is now fully under your control, not being berserk when you summon it. It is now a Shikigami instead of a Cursed Spirit. Although you can use your action to give it an order, making it act on its own to complete the order. While summoned, you can use your action to borrow its power, drawing cursed energy equal to your level into yourself from its pool once per day. The spirit can only be active for a number of minutes equal to your CE modifier per day, these minutes do not need to be consecutive.

descriptionEn: The Vengeful Cursed Spirit technique involves the use of the spirit of one you care about.

name: Voracity
description: Càng ngấu nghiến nuốt chửng thịt và Chú lực của kẻ thù, thể xác và lượng Chú lực của bản thân càng tiến hóa mạnh mẽ khôn cùng.

features.name: Cursed Energy
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you can harness your negative feelings into a usable source of energy, called cursed energy. These feelings can be harnessed into attacks or abilities. The number of cursed energy you possess is based on your class, some classes use a modifier that being charisma or wisdom (Player’s choice)

Your cursed energy DC is 8 + user cursed energy ability modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Hunger of the Accursed
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you are constantly filled with the hunger impulses that come with your technique. When you reduce a cursed spirit, shikigami, or cursed corpse to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to spend 3 cursed energy to devour its corpse. For 1 hour you gain a feature, action, movement, resistance, immunity, sense, AC, Ability Score or other statistic from the dead creature’s statblock such as Cursed Energy Affinity (Cannot take legendary actions, Cursed Energy or Domains). You can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to steal an additional ability and can steal a number of abilities from a single corpse up to your Cursed Energy modifier.

When you steal an ability that does not suit your body (such as fly speed), your body changes to fit the ability (eg. growing wings). For the duration, you count as the creature type your stolen abilities come from. If you have stolen abilities from multiple creatures, you count as the one you have the most abilities from. You can have stolen abilities equal to your Cursed Energy modifier active at once.

At 6th level, you can have stolen abilities from a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier +2 active at once and last for 24 hours. You cannot use different innate techniques at once.

features.name: Regurgitation
features.description: At 3rd level, you have learned to access previous abilities you have eaten. As a bonus action you can spend 4 cursed energy to gain an ability you have stolen in the past and can use it for 1 hour. This does not increase at 6th level.

features.name: Digestion
features.description:
At 6th level, your stomach calls for satiation and gives you the means to feed it. The amount of cursed energy required for Hunger of the Accursed and Regurgitation decreases by 1 (minimum cost of 1).

Additionally, you have learned to use cursed energy to enhance the abilities of the devoured. You can use one of the following benefits once per turn when you use a stolen ability:

Efficiency. When you use an ability with a base cursed energy cost, the cost of the feature decreases by 1 (minimum cost of 1).

Output. When you use an ability that lets you spend up to a certain amount of cursed energy, you can increase that amount by 2.

Speed. When using stolen movement, you can spend up to your proficiency bonus to increase it by 5 ft per cursed energy spent.

Reinforcement. When using stolen AC and are hit by an attack roll, you can spend 1 CE to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against that attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

Instinct. When using a feature, you can spend 2 cursed energy to decrease its action cost by one (Full-Turn Action > Action > Bonus Action > Reaction).

features.name: Maximum: Body of the Devourer
features.description:
At 11th level you have learned to draw the power of the devoured from your stomach and into your flesh. As an action you can transform into one of the creatures you have devoured, spending cursed energy equal to twice the Devoured’s CR (min of 1) or Level. Your statistics are replaced by the statblock of the chosen Devoured, but you retain your alignment, personality, mental scores, Cursed Energy and Hit Points.

You gain temporary hit points equal to the Hit Points of the Devoured. These Temporary Hit Points vanish if any remain when the technique ends. The technique ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points from this technique left.

You are limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of your new form and can only use your cursed techniques if your new form is capable of forming hand signs and chanting. This form lasts for a number of minutes equal to your level + your cursed energy modifier. You cannot use or benefit from Regurgitation while using this feature.

features.name: Domain Expansion: Tomb of the Devoured
features.description:
At 18th level you have mastered your technique allowing you to expand your domain. At initiative 20, you can regurgitate a creature whose corpse you devoured into an unoccupied space within 5 ft of you. The creature is friendly to you and your allies and acts immediately after your turn, attacking all enemies within your domain whether you command it to or not. If the creature was sentient in life, it is barely sentient within your domain as a mere husk of its former self. All regurgitated creatures disappear once your domain ends.

.

feats.name: Cannibalism
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Hunger of the Accursed
feats.description:
Your hunger has overwhelmed your humanity and led you to resort to this inhumane act. You can now devour the corpses of human races and use them for your innate technique features. You can take a Class Feature or Innate Technique feature using the rules of Hunger of the Accursed from a dead humanoid, changing parts of your appearance to resemble them when used. You cannot take Domain Expansions using this feature.

When you steal a cursed technique or innate technique feature from a dead humanoid, you can only take it if you are of the correct level and fulfill any prerequisites for using it. Additionally, you can only spend the base cost the technique requires. No matter what you copy, you can only use the technique in its base form. For example, a maximum output hollow purple would only come as a hollow purple. This changes if used with the Output option of Digestion at 6th level.

feats.name: Necrophage
feats.description: You have learned to more accurately extract the cursed energy from a corpse that is required for your technique. You can now devour a corpse as an action for 3 cursed energy that has been dead for a number of days equal to your Cursed Energy modifier and still have it usable for your technique if the creature’s CR equals your level. This increases to twice your Cursed Energy modifier at 11th level and three times at 18th level.

feats.name: Gourmand
feats.prerequisite: Prerequisite: Must have Body of the Devourer
feats.description: You have learned to appreciate the good food you have eaten. When you use Regurgitation, you gain temporary hit points equal to half the hit points of the creature whose devoured ability you are calling upon. The amount of temporary hit points cannot exceed half your hit point maximum.

descriptionEn: You get stronger by eating.
